# 第三年 · 高阶阶段语法课程全量导出

- 来源:`public/data/grammar/index.json + part-12..18.json`(stage=3)
- 总课数:1142 课 = 手写 15 课(g-301..g-315)+ 批量生成 1,127 课(28 主题 × 10 变体)
- 主题范围:长难句主干提取、非限制性定语从句、同位语从句、虚拟语气×5、倒装×3、强调句、省略、独立主格、衔接词综合演练
- 每课字段:要点 / 例句(英 + 中)/ 练习题(题干、选项 A–D、答案、解析)

## 第 1 课 · g-301:长难句主干提取:嵌套从句拆解

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:学会在多层嵌套从句里先找到主句谓语,再逐层剥离从句,读懂 B2 长难句的第一课。
- 要点:
  - 先找"主谓宾"主干,从句先用括号括起来
  - 一个句子只有一个主句谓语,其余动词都在从句或非谓语里
  - 定语从句紧跟先行词,名词性从句充当主/宾/表
  - 剥掉修饰成分(介词短语、插入语)再看句意
  - 读不懂时先问:谁?做了什么?
- 例句:
  - The idea that the committee proposed last week, which surprised everyone, was finally accepted.
    - 译:委员会上周提出的那个想法——它让所有人都吃了一惊——最终被接受了。
  - What the report suggests is that we rewrite the budget before Friday.
    - 译:报告的建议是我们在周五前重写预算。
  - The engineer who fixed the server that crashed twice won an award.
    - 译:修好那台崩了两次的服务器的工程师获了奖。
  - Analysts believe that the strategy the company chose will fail.
    - 译:分析师认为公司选定的策略会失败。
  - That she kept calm when the building shook was remarkable.
    - 译:大楼摇晃时她还能保持镇定,令人赞叹。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-301-q1)** Which of the following is the main clause in "The fact that he lied, which we proved later, destroyed the trust"?
    - A. The fact destroyed the trust
    - B. he lied
    - C. we proved later
    - D. the fact that he lied
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:主干是 The fact ... destroyed the trust;两个从句只是修饰。
  - **Q2(g-301-q2)** In "What matters most is how we respond", the underlined parts "what matters most" and "how we respond" function as ___.
    - A. subject and predicative
    - B. object and adverbial
    - C. attribute and object
    - D. subject and object
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:what 从句作主语,how 从句作表语。
  - **Q3(g-301-q3)** Choose the correct analysis of "The woman who called you said she would email the contract that you signed".
    - A. 两个定语从句 + 一个宾语从句
    - B. 三个宾语从句
    - C. 一个定语从句 + 一个宾语从句
    - D. 没有从句,只有并列句
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:who called you 和 that you signed 是定语从句,she would email... 是宾语从句。
  - **Q4(g-301-q4)** "___ surprised us was the speed of the change."
    - A. What
    - B. That
    - C. Which
    - D. It
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:句子缺主语且强调"内容",用 what 引导主语从句。
  - **Q5(g-301-q5)** Strip the modifiers: "The plan, despite its flaws, that the board approved in March has worked."
    - A. The plan has worked.
    - B. The board approved in March.
    - C. Despite its flaws.
    - D. The plan that the board approved.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:去掉插入语和定语从句,主干是 The plan has worked。
  - **Q6(g-301-q6)** The sentence "I think that the team who wins tonight will qualify" contains ___ clauses.
    - A. three
    - B. two
    - C. four
    - D. one
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:宾语从句 that the team... will qualify 内又嵌一个定语从句 who wins tonight,共三个谓语结构分属两层嵌套。

## 第 2 课 · g-302:非限制性定语从句与介词 + 关系代词

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:用逗号隔开的"补充说明"从句,以及介词提前后的 which/whom 用法,让书面表达更地道。
- 要点:
  - 非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开,切掉后主句仍完整
  - 非限制性从句不能用 that,指物用 which,指人用 who/whom
  - which 可以指代前面整个句子
  - 介词 + which/whom:介词可提前,关系代词不可省略
  - whose 在两种从句里都表示"谁的"
- 例句:
  - My laptop, which I bought in 2019, still runs perfectly.
    - 译:我 2019 年买的笔记本电脑至今运行流畅。
  - She passed the interview, which surprised nobody.
    - 译:她通过了面试,没人觉得意外。(which 指代整句)
  - The consultant with whom I worked has moved to Berlin.
    - 译:和我共事过的那位顾问搬去了柏林。
  - The house whose windows face south stays warm all winter.
    - 译:窗户朝南的那座房子整个冬天都暖和。
  - He gave three reasons, none of which convinced the board.
    - 译:他给了三条理由,没有一条能说服董事会。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-302-q1)** This dictionary, ___ I use almost daily, was a gift from my tutor.
    - A. that
    - B. which
    - C. what
    - D. who
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:非限制性定语从句不能用 that,指物用 which。
  - **Q2(g-302-q2)** The team lost in the final, ___ disappointed their fans deeply.
    - A. what
    - B. as
    - C. which
    - D. who
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:which 在这里指代"输掉决赛"整件事。
  - **Q3(g-302-q3)** The partner ___ the firm merged with has rebranded.
    - A. whom
    - B. which
    - C. whose
    - D. where
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:先行词是人,作介词 with 的宾语,用 whom。
  - **Q4(g-302-q4)** She mentioned a mentor, ___ advice changed her career path.
    - A. who
    - B. whose
    - C. which
    - D. whom
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:表示"他/她的建议",用 whose。
  - **Q5(g-302-q5)** Choose the sentence where "in which" is used correctly.
    - A. The report in which the data appear was withdrawn.
    - B. The report in which I believe it
    - C. The city in which is famous for food
    - D. The year in which we moved in it
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:"报告(数据出现在其中)被撤回",in which 指代 the report,结构正确。
  - **Q6(g-302-q6)** He tried yoga, ___ he had never done before.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. in which
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:非限制性从句中指代瑜伽这件事,只能用 which。

## 第 3 课 · g-303:同位语从句与名词性从句进阶

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:分清 that 同位语从句与 that 定语从句,掌握 whether/if、疑问词引导的名词性从句的细节。
- 要点:
  - 同位语从句解释名词内容,that 不作成分、不可省略
  - 定语从句中 that 作成分;同位语从句中 that 不作成分
  - 常见同位语名词:fact, news, idea, belief, suggestion, doubt
  - 主语从句可后置:It is clear that...
  - whether 引导从句可放句首,if 不行;介词后只用 whether
- 例句:
  - The news that the flight had been cancelled spread quickly.
    - 译:航班取消的消息传得很快。
  - It remains doubtful whether the funds will arrive on time.
    - 译:资金能否按时到位仍有疑问。
  - Whoever breaks the rule pays the fine.
    - 译:谁违规谁交罚款。
  - The suggestion that we postpone the launch was rejected.
    - 译:推迟发布的建议被否决了。
  - That is exactly what the survey revealed.
    - 译:那正是调查揭示的结果。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-303-q1)** The fact ___ he resigned shocked the whole office.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. whose
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:同位语从句,that 不作成分也不可省略。
  - **Q2(g-303-q2)** The promise ___ he made last year has been kept.
    - A. what
    - B. whose
    - C. that
    - D. who
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:定语从句:that 在从句中作 made 的宾语。
  - **Q3(g-303-q3)** ___ the delay was intentional is still unclear.
    - A. Whether
    - B. If
    - C. What
    - D. Which
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:句首的主语从句只能用 whether,不能用 if。
  - **Q4(g-303-q4)** It suddenly hit her ___ she had left the keys at the hotel.
    - A. that
    - B. what
    - C. which
    - D. whether
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:It hit her that... 中 that 引导真正的主语从句。
  - **Q5(g-303-q5)** We are debating ___ to invest in new equipment or keep the cash.
    - A. if
    - B. that
    - C. whether
    - D. what
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:whether...or 结构,且介词/不定式前不用 if。
  - **Q6(g-303-q6)** Choose the sentence with an appositive clause (同位语从句).
    - A. The belief that patience wins is old but true.
    - B. The book that she lent me is due.
    - C. The idea that you proposed sounds risky.
    - D. The man that called left a number.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:"耐心制胜"这一信念的内容,that 不作成分,是同位语从句;其余 that 都在从句中作成分。

## 第 4 课 · g-304:虚拟语气:与现在事实相反

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:从 if 条件句开始,掌握"现在不成立"的假设:从句过去式,主句 would + 动词原形。
- 要点:
  - 与现在相反:If + 过去式,主句 would/could/might + 原形
  - be 动词一律用 were(含 I/he/she)
  - 从句与主句时间一致,不能混搭
  - unless = if...not,同样适用
  - 省略 if 时 were 提前:Were I you, ...
- 例句:
  - If I had more free time, I would learn the cello.
    - 译:如果我有更多空余时间,我就去学大提琴。
  - If she were the manager, she would change the roster.
    - 译:如果她是经理,她会改排班表。
  - If cars flew, traffic reports would be much shorter.
    - 译:如果汽车会飞,路况播报会短得多。
  - I would fix it myself if I knew how.
    - 译:我要是会修,就自己动手了。
  - Were I in charge, I would cancel the meeting.
    - 译:我要是负责人,就取消这个会。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-304-q1)** If I ___ taller, I would play basketball professionally.
    - A. am
    - B. was
    - C. were
    - D. be
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:与现在事实相反,be 动词用 were。
  - **Q2(g-304-q2)** If we ___ a car, we would drive to the coast.
    - A. have
    - B. had
    - C. having
    - D. would have
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:从句用过去式 had。
  - **Q3(g-304-q3)** She would apply for the grant if she ___ the deadline.
    - A. knows
    - B. knew
    - C. known
    - D. would know
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:与现在相反,从句用过去式 knew。
  - **Q4(g-304-q4)** ___ I you, I would take the earlier train.
    - A. If
    - B. Were
    - C. Had
    - D. Should
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:省略 if 的倒装:Were I you, ...
  - **Q5(g-304-q5)** If he weren't so busy, he ___ join us for dinner.
    - A. will
    - B. would
    - C. had
    - D. is
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:主句用 would + 原形。
  - **Q6(g-304-q6)** Choose the sentence that correctly expresses an unreal present condition.
    - A. If dolphins ran the city, parking would be free.
    - B. If dolphins run the city, parking would be free.
    - C. If dolphins ran the city, parking will be free.
    - D. If dolphins have run the city, parking would be free.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:从句过去式 ran + 主句 would be,时间一致、结构正确。

## 第 5 课 · g-305:虚拟语气:与过去事实相反

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:谈"当时没发生"的假设:从句 had + 过去分词,主句 would have + 过去分词。
- 要点:
  - 与过去相反:If + had done,主句 would/could/might have done
  - 主句常见错误:would had done ❌
  - 省略 if:Had you asked, ...
  - 注意与"现在相反"区分:看时间状语
  - 事后诸葛式的遗憾、道歉、复盘常用此结构
- 例句:
  - If we had booked earlier, we would have got better seats.
    - 译:要是我们早点订票,座位会好得多。
  - If the alarm had rung, I wouldn't have missed the train.
    - 译:要是闹钟响了,我就不会误火车。
  - She could have won if she had entered the senior group.
    - 译:她要是报了成年组,本来是有机会赢的。
  - Had they listened to the pilot study, the launch would not have flopped.
    - 译:要是他们听取试点研究的意见,发布就不会翻车。
  - I would have called you, but my phone died.
    - 译:我本想给你打电话,可手机没电了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-305-q1)** If you ___ me, I would have helped immediately.
    - A. asked
    - B. had asked
    - C. have asked
    - D. would ask
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:与过去相反,从句用 had asked。
  - **Q2(g-305-q2)** If the map had been accurate, we ___ lost.
    - A. wouldn't get
    - B. hadn't got
    - C. wouldn't have got
    - D. won't get
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:主句用 would not have got。
  - **Q3(g-305-q3)** ___ she known the truth, she would have stayed.
    - A. If
    - B. Were
    - C. Had
    - D. Should
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:省略 if 的倒装:Had she known...
  - **Q4(g-305-q4)** He would have joined us if his flight ___ delayed.
    - A. isn't
    - B. weren't
    - C. hadn't been
    - D. wouldn't be
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:与过去相反,从句用 hadn't been。
  - **Q5(g-305-q5)** I ___ the deadline if you hadn't reminded me.
    - A. would miss
    - B. would have missed
    - C. had missed
    - D. missed
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:与过去相反,主句用 would have missed。
  - **Q6(g-305-q6)** Which sentence is grammatically correct?
    - A. If the team had practised more, they would have won.
    - B. If the team practised more, they would have won.
    - C. If the team had practised more, they would win.
    - D. If the team would have practised more, they had won.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:与过去相反:had practised + would have won。

## 第 6 课 · g-306:混合条件句与错综时间

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:当从句和主句的时间不一致:一个看过去,一个看现在,各用各的规则。
- 要点:
  - 从句过去 + 主句现在:If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
  - 从句现在 + 主句过去(少见):If he were braver, he would have spoken up yesterday.
  - 判断步骤:先定从句时间,再定主句时间
  - now, today, this week 提示主句指现在
  - yesterday, last year 提示指过去
- 例句:
  - If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
    - 译:我当年要是学了医,现在就是医生了。
  - If she weren't so shy, she would have introduced herself at the party.
    - 译:她要不是那么腼腆,昨晚聚会上早就自我介绍了。
  - If the bridge had been built, the village would have a link to the city today.
    - 译:桥要是当年修好了,村子今天就有进城的通道。
  - He would be running the department now if he had stayed.
    - 译:他要是没走,现在正管着这个部门。
  - If I were more organised, I would have filed the receipts last week.
    - 译:我要是更有条理,上周就把收据归档了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-306-q1)** If we ___ the turning, we would be there by now.
    - A. hadn't missed
    - B. didn't miss
    - C. wouldn't miss
    - D. haven't missed
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:错过岔路是过去的事,主句 by now 指现在:hadn't missed。
  - **Q2(g-306-q2)** If he ___ a lighter pack, he would have summited yesterday.
    - A. carried
    - B. had carried
    - C. carries
    - D. would carry
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:主句 yesterday 指过去,与过去相反,从句用 had carried。
  - **Q3(g-306-q3)** She would have the invoice by now if the post ___ on strike.
    - A. weren't
    - B. hadn't been
    - C. isn't
    - D. wouldn't be
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:罢工发生在过去,主句 by now 指现在。
  - **Q4(g-306-q4)** If I ___ better at maps, I wouldn't have walked the wrong way last night.
    - A. am
    - B. was
    - C. were
    - D. had been
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:方向感差是现在的长期状态,用 were;last night 只是主句时间。
  - **Q5(g-306-q5)** Which sentence mixes times correctly?
    - A. If you had saved the file, we wouldn't be panicking now.
    - B. If you saved the file, we wouldn't be panicking now.
    - C. If you had saved the file, we wouldn't have panicked now.
    - D. If you would save the file, we aren't panicking now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:过去没存文件(had saved)+ 现在正慌(wouldn't be panicking now)。
  - **Q6(g-306-q6)** If the museum ___ free on Mondays, we would have gone last week.
    - A. were
    - B. had been
    - C. is
    - D. would be
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:长期政策属现在/一般情况,用 were;last week 是主句时间。

## 第 7 课 · g-307:wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:四种表达"愿望与不满"的虚拟句式:对现在的遗憾、对过去的悔意、对未来的期望。
- 要点:
  - wish + 过去式:对现在的愿望
  - wish + had done:对过去的遗憾;wish + would:对将来的期望/抱怨
  - would rather + 过去式:宁愿别人/别的事怎样
  - if only 比 wish 更强烈,结构相同
  - It's (high) time + 过去式:早该做某事了
- 例句:
  - I wish I knew how to sail.
    - 译:真希望我会开帆船。
  - She wishes she had kept the receipt.
    - 译:她真希望当时留了收据。
  - I wish the neighbours would stop drilling at dawn.
    - 译:真希望邻居别在清晨钻孔。
  - I'd rather you didn't mention the budget today.
    - 译:我宁愿你今天别提预算。
  - It's high time we rewrote this manual.
    - 译:我们早该重写这本手册了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-307-q1)** I wish I ___ more about wine.
    - A. know
    - B. knew
    - C. had known
    - D. would know
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:对现在的愿望,用过去式 knew。
  - **Q2(g-307-q2)** I wish we ___ the early train yesterday.
    - A. catch
    - B. caught
    - C. had caught
    - D. would catch
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:对过去的遗憾,用 had caught。
  - **Q3(g-307-q3)** If only she ___ quieter in the library!
    - A. is
    - B. were
    - C. had been
    - D. would be
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:对现在的愿望,be 用 were。
  - **Q4(g-307-q4)** I'd rather he ___ the news in person.
    - A. tells
    - B. told
    - C. had told
    - D. would tell
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:would rather 接从句时用过去式 told 表现在/将来。
  - **Q5(g-307-q5)** It's time you ___ sending applications.
    - A. start
    - B. started
    - C. had started
    - D. would start
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:It's time + 过去式 started。
  - **Q6(g-307-q6)** Which wish refers to the past?
    - A. I wish I had taken her advice.
    - B. I wish I were braver.
    - C. I wish it would stop raining.
    - D. I wish dogs could talk.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:had taken 表对过去的遗憾。

## 第 8 课 · g-308:suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:建议、要求、命令、坚持类动词后的 that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形,不受时态影响。
- 要点:
  - 一类动词:suggest, demand, insist, require, request, order, propose, recommend
  - 从句谓语:should + 原形,should 常省略,只剩原形
  - 主句过去时也不改变:She insisted that he be told.
  - 相关名词(suggestion, demand)后的同位语从句同样用原形
  - insist on being right(坚持观点)不用虚拟:insist that he was honest
- 例句:
  - The doctor suggested that he (should) cut down on caffeine.
    - 译:医生建议他少摄入咖啡因。
  - She demanded that the contract be rewritten.
    - 译:她要求重写合同。
  - The panel recommended that the funding be extended.
    - 译:评审组建议延长资助。
  - It is essential that everyone arrive on time.
    - 译:每个人准时到场至关重要。
  - My request that he wait outside went ignored.
    - 译:我请他在外面等的要求被无视了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-308-q1)** The board demanded that the report ___ before Friday.
    - A. is submitted
    - B. be submitted
    - C. was submitted
    - D. were submitted
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:demand 后的从句用 (should) be done,选 be submitted。
  - **Q2(g-308-q2)** She suggested that he ___ the client first.
    - A. calls
    - B. called
    - C. call
    - D. would call
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:suggest 后从句用原形 call。
  - **Q3(g-308-q3)** It is vital that no one ___ the results early.
    - A. announces
    - B. announce
    - C. announced
    - D. would announce
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:It is vital that... 后用原形 announce。
  - **Q4(g-308-q4)** The general ordered that the bridge ___ .
    - A. destroy
    - B. be destroyed
    - C. was destroyed
    - D. destroyed
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:order 后从句用被动原形 be destroyed。
  - **Q5(g-308-q5)** Which sentence is correct?
    - A. The rule requires that each player wear a number.
    - B. The rule requires that each player wears a number.
    - C. The rule requires that each player is wearing a number.
    - D. The rule requires that each player wore a number.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:requires that + 主语 + (should) wear 原形。
  - **Q6(g-308-q6)** The manager insisted that the deadline ___ , and he was right to.
    - A. not be moved
    - B. was not moved
    - C. not moved
    - D. would not be moved
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:insist 表"坚决要求"时从句用 not be moved。

## 第 9 课 · g-309:完全倒装

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:整个谓语提到主语前面的倒装:方位副词开头、here/there 开头、直接引语等场景。
- 要点:
  - 方位/地点状语开头(Here, There, Now, Then, 地点介词短语)+ 不及物动词 + 主语
  - 主语是代词时不倒装:Here it comes.
  - 直接引语后:asked/said the visitor
  - 表"也"的 so/neither/nor 属部分倒装(下一课)
  - 完全倒装常用于描写,让画面先入眼
- 例句:
  - On the hill stands a lonely lighthouse.
    - 译:山上立着一座孤独的灯塔。
  - Here comes the night bus.
    - 译:夜班公交来了。
  - Behind the counter sat an old clockmaker.
    - 译:柜台后面坐着一位老钟表匠。
  - "There's the receipt," said the cashier.
    - 译:"收据在这儿。"收银员说。
  - Then came the announcement everyone feared.
    - 译:接着来了那个所有人都怕的通知。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-309-q1)** At the end of the pier ___ a small fish stall.
    - A. is standing
    - B. stands
    - C. does stand
    - D. standing
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:地点状语开头,完全倒装:stands a stall。
  - **Q2(g-309-q2)** Here ___ the results you asked for.
    - A. come
    - B. comes
    - C. coming
    - D. does come
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:主语是 the results(复数),倒装后动词跟主语:come。
  - **Q3(g-309-q3)** Under the old bridge ___.
    - A. a narrow path runs
    - B. runs a narrow path
    - C. does a narrow path run
    - D. running a narrow path
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:地点状语 + 不及物动词:runs a narrow path。
  - **Q4(g-309-q4)** There ___ the last ferry of the day.
    - A. goes
    - B. go
    - C. going
    - D. is going
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:There goes + 单数名词 the ferry。
  - **Q5(g-309-q5)** "Perfect timing," ___.
    - A. said the guide
    - B. the guide said
    - C. did the guide say
    - D. the guide says
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:直接引语后常用完全倒装 said the guide。
  - **Q6(g-309-q6)** Which sentence keeps normal order (不倒装)?
    - A. Here she comes at last.
    - B. Here comes she at last.
    - C. Here comes the bus at last.
    - D. There goes our train.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:主语是代词 she 时不倒装:Here she comes。

## 第 10 课 · g-310:部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:否定副词或 only 状语放在句首时,助动词提前形成部分倒装,以及 so/neither 表"也/也不"。
- 要点:
  - 否定词(Never, Seldom, Rarely, Hardly, Little, Not until, No sooner)开头 → 助动词提前
  - Only + 状语开头 → 部分倒装
  - So/Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语:表"某人也是/也不是"
  - Not until... did... ;No sooner had... than...
  - 主句倒装,从句不倒装:Not until he called did I relax.
- 例句:
  - Never had the village seen such a flood.
    - 译:村子从未见过这样的洪水。
  - Only after the audit did the truth emerge.
    - 译:直到审计之后真相才浮出水面。
  - Seldom does she miss a deadline.
    - 译:她很少误期。
  - I've tried the blue route; so has my colleague.
    - 译:我试过蓝线,我同事也试过。
  - Not until the fog lifted did the ferries restart.
    - 译:雾散之后渡轮才恢复。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-310-q1)** Never in my life ___ such a storm.
    - A. I have seen
    - B. have I seen
    - C. I saw
    - D. did I saw
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Never 开头,部分倒装:have I seen。
  - **Q2(g-310-q2)** Only when the results came in ___ the mistake.
    - A. we noticed
    - B. did we notice
    - C. we did notice
    - D. noticed we
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Only + 状语从句开头,主句倒装:did we notice。
  - **Q3(g-310-q3)** No sooner ___ the stage than the power failed.
    - A. she had stepped
    - B. had she stepped
    - C. did she step
    - D. she stepped
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:No sooner had... than 固定倒装。
  - **Q4(g-310-q4)** Hardly ___ the door when the phone rang.
    - A. he had closed
    - B. had he closed
    - C. he closed
    - D. did he closed
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Hardly had... when 倒装。
  - **Q5(g-310-q5)** I don't trust the forecast, and ___ my skipper.
    - A. so doesn't
    - B. neither does
    - C. neither do
    - D. so does
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:表"也不"用 neither + 助动词;主语 my skipper 是第三人称单数:neither does。
  - **Q6(g-310-q6)** Which sentence has the inversion in the right clause?
    - A. Not until she smiled did I sit down.
    - B. Not until she did smile I sat down.
    - C. Not until did she smile I sat down.
    - D. Not until she smiled I did sit down.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Not until 时间从句不倒装,主句倒装:did I sit down。

## 第 11 课 · g-311:as 引导的倒装与比较结构

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:as/though 让步从句的倒装,以及 the more... the more、no more... than 等比较句式。
- 要点:
  - as/though 让步:形容词/副词/名词提前 + as/though + 主谓
  - Try as I might...;Cold as it was...
  - the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...
  - no more... than = 和……一样不
  - 比较的对象要对应:than mine / than I did
- 例句:
  - Tired as she was, she kept the shop open.
    - 译:她虽然很累,还是让店开着门。
  - Try as he might, the engine wouldn't start.
    - 译:他怎么折腾,发动机就是不着火。
  - The higher we climbed, the thinner the air became.
    - 译:我们爬得越高,空气越稀薄。
  - Child as he was, he asked razor-sharp questions.
    - 译:他虽是个孩子,问题却尖刻犀利。
  - The new printer is no more reliable than the old one.
    - 译:新打印机和旧的一样不可靠。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-311-q1)** ___ as the night was, the café stayed full.
    - A. Cold
    - B. Coldly
    - C. Colder
    - D. Coldest
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:让步倒装:形容词原形提前,Cold as the night was。
  - **Q2(g-311-q2)** Try ___ she might, the jar refused to open.
    - A. as
    - B. though
    - C. if
    - D. that
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Try as sb might 是让步倒装的固定搭配。
  - **Q3(g-311-q3)** The more data we collect, ___ the pattern becomes.
    - A. clear
    - B. clearer
    - C. clearest
    - D. more clearly
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:the + 比较级,the + 比较级:clearer。
  - **Q4(g-311-q4)** ___ as he was, the apprentice spotted the flaw at once.
    - A. A child
    - B. Child
    - C. The child
    - D. Children
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:单数名词提前时省冠词:Child as he was。
  - **Q5(g-311-q5)** My commute is no shorter ___.
    - A. than mine
    - B. than yours
    - C. as yours
    - D. than you take the bus
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:比较对象要对应:than yours(your commute)。
  - **Q6(g-311-q6)** Which sentence uses concessive inversion correctly?
    - A. Much as I admire her, I disagree.
    - B. As much I admire her, I disagree.
    - C. Much I admire as her, I disagree.
    - D. I admire as much her, much I disagree.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:副词 Much 提前 + as + 主谓,是让步倒装的正确形式。

## 第 12 课 · g-312:强调句型:It is ... that ...

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分:强调主语、宾语、状语,让重点凸出来。
- 要点:
  - 强调人可用 who,其余一律用 that
  - 去掉 It is...that 句子仍完整——这是强调句的判断标准
  - 强调状语:It was in 2019 that...
  - 不能强调谓语;强调谓语用 do/does/did
  - 疑问式:Was it you that...? / Who was it that...?
- 例句:
  - It was the intern who spotted the error.
    - 译:正是那位实习生发现了错误。
  - It was on the night ferry that they first met.
    - 译:他们正是在夜班渡轮上初次相遇。
  - It isn't the price that worries me; it's the fit.
    - 译:让我担心的不是价格,是合不合身。
  - It was only last week that she changed her mind.
    - 译:就在上周她才改的主意。
  - I did send the reminder — twice.
    - 译:我确实发了提醒——发了两次。(do 强调)
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-312-q1)** It was the recipe ___ saved the dinner.
    - A. who
    - B. that
    - C. which
    - D. what
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:强调事物用 that。
  - **Q2(g-312-q2)** It was ___ who broke the silence, not me.
    - A. he
    - B. him
    - C. his
    - D. himself
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:强调句中用主格 he(后面 not me 是口语惯用补充)。
  - **Q3(g-312-q3)** ___ you that left the window open?
    - A. It was
    - B. Was it
    - C. There was
    - D. Is there
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:强调句的一般疑问式:Was it you that...?
  - **Q4(g-312-q4)** It was in the attic ___ the letters turned up.
    - A. where
    - B. that
    - C. which
    - D. when
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:强调地点状语用 that,不用 where。
  - **Q5(g-312-q5)** Which sentence is a cleft sentence (强调句)?
    - A. It was the coach that changed everything.
    - B. It was obvious that the coach was tired.
    - C. It was the coach who was tired that day.
    - D. It seems that the coach changed his mind.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:去掉 It was...that 后 The coach changed everything 仍完整,是强调句。
  - **Q6(g-312-q6)** I ___ warn them, but they laughed.
    - A. do
    - B. did
    - C. was
    - D. had
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:强调过去动作的谓语用 did。

## 第 13 课 · g-313:省略:让句子更简洁

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:状语从句中的主语 + be 省略、并列句的省略、不定式省略 to 等,书面口语都常用。
- 要点:
  - 状语从句:主语与主句一致且含 be 时,可省"主语 + be"
  - While waiting, ... = While (I was) waiting, ...
  - 并列句省略相同成分:She can cook; he can't (cook).
  - 不定式作表语/宾补时,省略 to do 只留 to
  - if so / if not / if necessary 常见省略式
- 例句:
  - When asked, she gave the same answer.
    - 译:被问到时,她的回答一模一样。
  - Though exhausted, the crew finished the night shoot.
    - 译:虽然筋疲力尽,剧组还是拍完了夜戏。
  - He wanted to protest, but didn't dare (to).
    - 译:他想抗议,但不敢。
  - Have you finished? If not, keep going.
    - 译:你做完了吗?没有的话就继续。
  - The advice was sound, if slightly late.
    - 译:建议是靠谱的,只是有点迟。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-313-q1)** When ___ for directions, point at the map, not the sky.
    - A. asking
    - B. asked
    - C. you asking
    - D. to ask
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:省略式:when (you are) asked。
  - **Q2(g-313-q2)** Though ___ of sleep, she drove carefully.
    - A. depriving
    - B. deprived
    - C. deprives
    - D. deprive
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Though (she was) deprived of sleep。
  - **Q3(g-313-q3)** —Will you join the board? —I'd like ___, but I can't.
    - A. do
    - B. to
    - C. doing
    - D. so
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:省略不定式,保留 to。
  - **Q4(g-313-q4)** The soup was tasty, if ___ salty.
    - A. slight
    - B. slightly
    - C. slightness
    - D. more slight
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:if 后省略 it was,保留副词 slightly。
  - **Q5(g-313-q5)** Which option correctly completes "If ___, call the duty desk"?
    - A. necessary
    - B. it necessity
    - C. necessarily
    - D. necessity
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:if (it is) necessary 是固定省略式。
  - **Q6(g-313-q6)** He can play the fiddle, and his sister can ___, too.
    - A. it
    - B. that
    - C. so
    - D. this
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:用 so 替代前面提到的动作。

## 第 14 课 · g-314:独立主格结构

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语构成的独立结构,作状语补充背景,让描写更有层次。
- 要点:
  - 结构:名词 + 分词/形容词/副词/介词短语,与主句主语不同
  - with 复合结构:with + 名词 + 分词/形容词,更口语
  - 表时间、原因、条件、伴随
  - 逻辑主语与主句主语必须不同,否则用从句/省略
  - 分词选 doing 还是 done:看与逻辑主语是主动还是被动
- 例句:
  - The fog lifting, the ferries resumed.
    - 译:雾散了,渡轮复航。
  - He stood at the helm, hands steady on the wheel.
    - 译:他站在舵轮前,双手稳稳把着轮。
  - The last guest gone, we stacked the chairs.
    - 译:最后一位客人走后,我们把椅子摞了起来。
  - With the generator off, the cabin went silent.
    - 译:发动机关掉后,船舱安静下来。
  - Her voice hoarse, the guide whispered the last legend.
    - 译:嗓子哑了,向导低声讲完最后一个传说。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-314-q1)** The meeting ___, everyone drifted to the buffet.
    - A. over
    - B. was over
    - C. is over
    - D. to be over
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:独立主格保留名词 + 形容词/副词原形,不再带动词:over。
  - **Q2(g-314-q2)** Weather ___, the match will go ahead.
    - A. permitting
    - B. permitted
    - C. permits
    - D. to permit
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:weather permitting 是独立主格:主动关系用 permitting。
  - **Q3(g-314-q3)** ___ her shoes caked in mud, she tiptoed across the floor.
    - A. With
    - B. As
    - C. For
    - D. Of
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:with 复合结构:with + 名词 + 分词。
  - **Q4(g-314-q4)** The coach sat motionless, his eyes ___ on the scoreboard.
    - A. fixed
    - B. fixing
    - C. to fix
    - D. fix
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:eyes 与 fix 是被动关系,用过去分词 fixed。
  - **Q5(g-314-q5)** Which sentence contains a nominative absolute (独立主格)?
    - A. The signal given, the divers dropped.
    - B. The divers dropped when the signal was given.
    - C. Giving the signal, the divers dropped.
    - D. The signal was given and the divers dropped.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:名词 + 过去分词独立结构作时间状语,是独立主格。
  - **Q6(g-314-q6)** ___, the choir dispersed after the final chord.
    - A. The anthem sung
    - B. The anthem singing
    - C. Sung the anthem
    - D. The anthem to sing
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:逻辑主语 + 过去分词(被动)构成独立主格:The anthem sung。

## 第 15 课 · g-315:衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:用 however、therefore、in contrast 等衔接词把长难句、虚拟、倒装、强调串成连贯语篇,并做全年综合自测。
- 要点:
  - 转折:however, nevertheless, on the contrary, in contrast
  - 因果:therefore, consequently, as a result, hence
  - 递进/补充:moreover, furthermore, what is more
  - 顺序与总结:first, then, finally, in short, to sum up
  - 衔接词选错会颠倒逻辑:先判断两句关系再选词
- 例句:
  - The pilot was delayed; therefore, the whole schedule slipped.
    - 译:飞行员迟到,因此整个日程都顺延了。
  - The data looked solid; however, the sample was tiny.
    - 译:数据看起来扎实,然而样本极小。
  - Moreover, the trend has repeated in three markets.
    - 译:此外,这一趋势已在三个市场重演。
  - In short, the campaign worked despite the budget.
    - 译:总之,尽管预算有限,活动还是奏效了。
  - Had we known the risks, we would never have set sail; nevertheless, the voyage taught us plenty.
    - 译:早知风险我们绝不会出海;不过这趟航行让我们学到很多。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-315-q1)** The hotel was fully booked; ___, we found a room nearby.
    - A. therefore
    - B. however
    - C. moreover
    - D. hence
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:前后是转折关系(订满了却找到房),用 however。
  - **Q2(g-315-q2)** Sales doubled; ___, the board doubled the marketing budget.
    - A. consequently
    - B. nevertheless
    - C. in contrast
    - D. instead
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:因果:销量翻倍,于是预算翻倍,用 consequently。
  - **Q3(g-315-q3)** The instructions were clear. ___, the volunteers needed a briefing.
    - A. Moreover
    - B. Similarly
    - C. Nevertheless
    - D. Therefore
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:前后转折:清晰但志愿者仍需培训,用 Nevertheless。
  - **Q4(g-315-q4)** ___, let me thank the crew and recap tonight's plan.
    - A. In contrast
    - B. To begin with
    - C. To sum up
    - D. Even so
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:结尾总结场景,用 To sum up。
  - **Q5(g-315-q5)** ___ the delays, the festival broke even.
    - A. Despite
    - B. Although
    - C. However
    - D. Nevertheless
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:后接名词短语 the delays,用介词 Despite。
  - **Q6(g-315-q6)** Had the alarm worked, the warehouse ___ .
    - A. would not burn
    - B. would not have burned
    - C. did not burn
    - D. had not burned
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:综合演练:与过去相反的虚拟 + 结尾语篇,选 would not have burned。

## 第 16 课 · g-316:分词完成式与被动式:having done / being done

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:having done 表分词动作先于谓语且主动;being done 表进行中被动的含义,多作状语或介词宾语。
- 要点:
  - having done:主动且先发生(Having finished, he left.)
  - having been done:被动且先发生
  - being done:正在被…,作状语或介词宾语
  - done(过去分词):被动或完成,无时间先后强调
  - doing 与谓语同时发生
  - 独立使用时注意逻辑主语与主句主语一致
- 例句:
  - Having signed the contract, the manager shook hands with us.
    - 译:签完合同后,经理和我们握手。
  - The problem being discussed is far from simple.
    - 译:正在讨论的问题绝不简单。
  - Having been warned twice, he still made the same mistake.
    - 译:被警告过两次,他仍然犯同样的错误。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-316-q1)** ___ the whole novel, she wrote a detailed review.
    - A. Reading
    - B. Having read
    - C. Being read
    - D. Read
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:读完在写评论之前,主动完成用 Having read。
  - **Q2(g-316-q2)** ___ many times, the song sounds familiar to everyone.
    - A. Hearing
    - B. Having heard
    - C. Having been heard
    - D. Heard
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:歌被听了很多次,被动完成作状语。
  - **Q3(g-316-q3)** ___ in public made him nervous.
    - A. Correcting
    - B. Being corrected
    - C. Having corrected
    - D. Correct
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:动名词被动式作主语:Being corrected。
  - **Q4(g-316-q4)** ___ his homework, the boy went out to play football.
    - A. Finishing
    - B. Having finished
    - C. To finish
    - D. Finished
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:先完成作业再出去,用 Having finished。
  - **Q5(g-316-q5)** The bridge ___ now will open next spring.
    - A. built
    - B. being built
    - C. having built
    - D. to build
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:正在被修建,用 being built。
  - **Q6(g-316-q6)** ___ from space, the earth looks like a blue ball.
    - A. Seeing
    - B. Having seen
    - C. Seen
    - D. Being seen
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:地球被看,一般被动用 Seen。

## 第 17 课 · g-317:主谓一致进阶:就近与就远原则

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:or/nor/not only...but also 就近一致;as well as/with/along with/together with 就远一致;集体名词看语境。
- 要点:
  - 就近原则:either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also, or
  - 就远原则:as well as, with, along with, together with, except
  - 集体名词(family/team/class)强调整体用单数,强调成员用复数
  - a number of + 复数动词;the number of + 单数动词
  - each/every/many a + 单数动词
  - one of + 复数名词 + 单数动词
- 例句:
  - Not only the students but also the teacher was invited.
    - 译:不仅学生,连老师也被邀请了。
  - Tom, as well as his brothers, enjoys swimming.
    - 译:汤姆和他的兄弟们都喜欢游泳。
  - The number of tourists is rising this year.
    - 译:今年游客数量在上升。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-317-q1)** Neither the manager nor the workers ___ satisfied with the plan.
    - A. is
    - B. was
    - C. were
    - D. be
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:neither...nor 就近原则,workers 复数 → were。
  - **Q2(g-317-q2)** The teacher, together with his students, ___ going camping.
    - A. are
    - B. is
    - C. were
    - D. been
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:together with 就远原则,主语 teacher 单数 → is。
  - **Q3(g-317-q3)** The number of private cars ___ increasing rapidly.
    - A. are
    - B. is
    - C. have been
    - D. were
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:the number of + 单数动词。
  - **Q4(g-317-q4)** A number of students ___ failed the exam this time.
    - A. has
    - B. have
    - C. is
    - D. was
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:a number of + 复数动词。
  - **Q5(g-317-q5)** Every man and every woman ___ asked to attend.
    - A. are
    - B. is
    - C. were
    - D. have been
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:every...and every... 仍接单数动词。
  - **Q6(g-317-q6)** My family ___ a big dinner every Spring Festival Eve.
    - A. has
    - B. have
    - C. having
    - D. are having
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:强调整体习惯,用单数 has。

## 第 18 课 · g-318:替代与省略:one / that / do so

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:one 替代泛指单数可数名词;that 替代特指不可数/可数名词且带后置定语;do so 替代前面提到的动作。
- 要点:
  - one = a + 单数可数名词,泛指
  - ones 复数;it 特指同一物
  - that = the + 名词,后常接 of/against 等介词短语
  - those = the + 复数
  - do so 替代"动词+宾语"的重复
  - so 替代表语/宾语从句:I think so
- 例句:
  - I need a pen. Can you lend me one?
    - 译:我需要一支笔。能借我一支吗?
  - The population of China is larger than that of the US.
    - 译:中国人口比美国多。
  - He asked me to hand in the report and I did so at once.
    - 译:他让我交报告,我立刻照做了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-318-q1)** The weather in Beijing is colder than ___ in Guangzhou.
    - A. it
    - B. one
    - C. that
    - D. this
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:替代特指的 weather,用 that。
  - **Q2(g-318-q2)** I've lost my umbrella; I must buy ___.
    - A. it
    - B. one
    - C. that
    - D. ones
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:泛指任意一把,用 one。
  - **Q3(g-318-q3)** The roofs of the cottages are older than ___ of the church.
    - A. this
    - B. that
    - C. those
    - D. ones
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:替代复数 roofs,用 those。
  - **Q4(g-318-q4)** — Will you join the club? — I believe ___.
    - A. so
    - B. one
    - C. that
    - D. it
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:I believe so 替代宾语从句。
  - **Q5(g-318-q5)** She asked me to close the door, and I ___.
    - A. did so
    - B. did one
    - C. made so
    - D. so did
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:照做用 did so。
  - **Q6(g-318-q6)** My shoes are worn out. I'll buy new ___.
    - A. it
    - B. one
    - C. ones
    - D. that
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:替代复数 shoes,用 ones。

## 第 19 课 · g-319:插入语与同位语:长难句打断点

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:双逗号/双破折号间的插入语可先跳过;同位语对名词进一步说明,帮助拆解长难句。
- 要点:
  - 插入语:however, in fact, of course, as a result 等独立成分
  - 同位语(名词短语):my friend Tom
  - 同位语从句:the fact/news/idea that...(that 不作成分)
  - 非限制性定语从句也起插入打断作用
  - 拆句技巧:先去插入语找主干,再逐层还原
  - 破折号与冒号后的内容常为解释说明
- 例句:
  - The news that our team won the match excited everyone.
    - 译:我们队获胜的消息让所有人兴奋。
  - Mr Smith, our headmaster, will give a speech tomorrow.
    - 译:史密斯先生——我们的校长——明天将发表演讲。
  - This solution, in my opinion, is the most practical.
    - 译:依我看,这个方案最实用。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-319-q1)** The fact ___ he failed the exam surprised nobody.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. who
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:同位语从句,that 不作成分。
  - **Q2(g-319-q2)** Word came ___ the mayor would visit our school.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. where
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:word(消息)后的同位语从句用 that。
  - **Q3(g-319-q3)** The proposal ___ the two sides discussed yesterday was accepted.
    - A. that
    - B. which
    - C. what
    - D. whose
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:discussed 缺宾语,是定语从句,用 which。
  - **Q4(g-319-q4)** Tom, ___ opinion I value most, disagreed with the plan.
    - A. who
    - B. whose
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:whose opinion 定语从句表所属。
  - **Q5(g-319-q5)** ____, the experiment turned out to be a success.
    - A. To our surprise
    - B. To we surprise
    - C. For our surprising
    - D. Surprising us
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:To our surprise 为固定插入语。
  - **Q6(g-319-q6)** The thought ___ he might be wrong never crossed his mind.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. if
    - D. unless
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:thought 后同位语从句,句子成分完整,用 that。

## 第 20 课 · g-320:比较结构进阶:the more...the more 与倍数表达

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:成比例增长用"the + 比较级,the + 比较级";倍数用"倍数 + as...as / 比较级 than / the size of"。
- 要点:
  - The more..., the more...:越…越…(成比例变化)
  - The harder you work, the luckier you get.
  - 倍数 + as + 原级 + as:twice as large as
  - 倍数 + 比较级 + than:three times larger than
  - 倍数 + the size/length/number of
  - 比较对象要对应:The weather here is colder than that there.
- 例句:
  - The more you practise, the better you speak.
    - 译:练习越多,说得越好。
  - This hall is twice as large as that one.
    - 译:这个厅是那个厅的两倍大。
  - The sooner, the better.
    - 译:越快越好。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-320-q1)** ___ you learn, ___ you realise how little you know.
    - A. More; more
    - B. The more; the more
    - C. The most; the most
    - D. Much; much
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:"越…越…"结构:the + 比较级。
  - **Q2(g-320-q2)** This rope is three times ___ that one.
    - A. as long as
    - B. longer as
    - C. as longer as
    - D. so long than
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:倍数 + as + 原级 + as。
  - **Q3(g-320-q3)** The new bridge is ___ the old one.
    - A. twice the width of
    - B. twice wider of
    - C. twice width of
    - D. two time the width of
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:倍数 + the width of 结构。
  - **Q4(g-320-q4)** ___ you climb, ___ the air becomes.
    - A. More; thinner
    - B. The higher; the thinner
    - C. The more high; the more thin
    - D. Highest; thinnest
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:成比例变化用 the + 比较级结构。
  - **Q5(g-320-q5)** The output this year is ___ last year.
    - A. 50 percent higher than
    - B. 50 percent as high than
    - C. 50 percent higher as
    - D. as 50 percent high as
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:倍数/百分比 + 比较级 + than。
  - **Q6(g-320-q6)** The population of Shanghai is larger than ___ of London.
    - A. those
    - B. it
    - C. that
    - D. one
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:替代 population 用 that。

## 第 21 课 · g-321:情态动词完成式:must / should / could have done

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:对过去的推测与评价:must have done(肯定发生过)、should have done(本应)、needn't have done(本不必)。
- 要点:
  - must have done:过去一定发生过(肯定推测)
  - can't/couldn't have done:过去不可能
  - should/ought to have done:本应做而未做(责备)
  - shouldn't have done:本不该做却做了
  - could have done:本能够做却没做
  - needn't have done:本不必做却做了
- 例句:
  - The ground is wet; it must have rained last night.
    - 译:地面是湿的,昨晚一定下过雨。
  - You should have told me earlier.
    - 译:你本应早点告诉我。
  - You needn't have brought so much food.
    - 译:你本不必带这么多吃的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-321-q1)** She looks pale. She ___ ill.
    - A. must be
    - B. must have been
    - C. should be
    - D. can be
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:对过去状态的肯定推测:must have been(此刻看起来苍白是过去生病导致)。
  - **Q2(g-321-q2)** You ___ the letter; I had already posted it for you.
    - A. must post
    - B. should post
    - C. needn't have posted
    - D. can't post
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:本不必做却做了:needn't have done。
  - **Q3(g-321-q3)** He ___ the exam; he never opened the book.
    - A. can pass
    - B. could have passed
    - C. can't have passed
    - D. should pass
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:不可能通过:can't have passed。
  - **Q4(g-321-q4)** I'm sorry I was late; I ___ earlier.
    - A. should start
    - B. should have started
    - C. must start
    - D. could start
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:本应早点出发:should have started。
  - **Q5(g-321-q5)** With a bit more effort, we ___ the match.
    - A. could win
    - B. could have won
    - C. must have won
    - D. should win
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:本能够赢却没赢:could have won。
  - **Q6(g-321-q6)** You ___ him the news; it made him so sad.
    - A. shouldn't have told
    - B. shouldn't tell
    - C. mustn't tell
    - D. needn't tell
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:本不该告诉(已发生):shouldn't have told。

## 第 22 课 · g-322:含蓄条件句:without / but for / otherwise

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:不用 if 也能暗示条件:介词短语 without/but for 与副词 otherwise 暗含虚拟条件,时态按虚拟规则选。
- 要点:
  - Without/But for + 名词 = If it were not for / had not been for
  - 与现在事实相反:would/should + 动词原形
  - 与过去事实相反:would have + 过去分词
  - otherwise = if not(否则),暗含前句条件
  - but that + 从句也表"若不是"
  - 判断技巧:看暗含条件指向现在还是过去
- 例句:
  - Without your help, I would have failed.
    - 译:没有你的帮助,我就失败了。
  - But for the rain, we would have arrived on time.
    - 译:要不是下雨,我们就准时到了。
  - I was busy that day; otherwise I would have come.
    - 译:那天我很忙,否则我就来了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-322-q1)** ___ your advice, we would have taken the wrong road.
    - A. Without
    - B. If
    - C. Unless
    - D. Because of
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:要不是你的建议,用 Without 表含蓄条件。
  - **Q2(g-322-q2)** But for the storm, the ship ___ on time.
    - A. arrives
    - B. would arrive
    - C. would have arrived
    - D. arrived
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:对过去的含蓄虚拟:would have arrived。
  - **Q3(g-322-q3)** I didn't know your number; otherwise I ___ you.
    - A. called
    - B. would call
    - C. would have called
    - D. had called
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:otherwise 指过去:would have called。
  - **Q4(g-322-q4)** Without air, there ___ no living things on earth.
    - A. is
    - B. would be
    - C. will be
    - D. were
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:与现在事实相反的含蓄虚拟:would be。
  - **Q5(g-322-q5)** ___ the heavy traffic, we would have caught the train.
    - A. But for
    - B. If
    - C. Though
    - D. As for
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:要不是堵车,用 But for。
  - **Q6(g-322-q6)** He was not free yesterday; otherwise he ___ to the meeting.
    - A. would come
    - B. came
    - C. would have come
    - D. had come
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:otherwise 指过去,用 would have come。

## 第 23 课 · g-3023:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - if + past (be uniformly were)
  - main clause would/could/might + base verb
  - expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
  - were is used for all persons
  - if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go
- 例句:
  - If I were you, I would take the chance.
    - 译:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - If he had more time, he would learn music.
    - 译:如果他有更多时间,他会学音乐。
  - If I were a bird, I could fly to Rome.
    - 译:如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到罗马。
  - If we started now, we would catch the train.
    - 译:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - 译:如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。
  - If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - 译:如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3023-q1)** If I _____ you, I would take the chance.
    - A. would be
    - B. were
    - C. was
    - D. am
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 were。句意:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - **Q2(g-3023-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If he had more time, he would learn music.
    - B. If he had more time, he will learn music.
    - C. If he had more time, he learned music.
    - D. If he had more time, he would learned music.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn music.
  - **Q3(g-3023-q3)** 「如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到罗马。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I were a bird, I can fly to Rome.
    - B. If I were a bird, I will fly to Rome.
    - C. If I were a bird, I could fly to Rome.
    - D. If I were a bird, I could flew to Rome.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were a bird, I could fly to Rome.
  - **Q4(g-3023-q4)** If we _____ now, we would catch the train.
    - A. start
    - B. started
    - C. would start
    - D. will start
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 started。句意:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - **Q5(g-3023-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - B. If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
    - C. If she has known the answer, she would tell us.
    - D. If she knows the answer, she would tell us.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
  - **Q6(g-3023-q6)** 「如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - B. If I had the money, I bought a new computer.
    - C. If I had the money, I would bought a new computer.
    - D. If I had the money, I will buy a new computer.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.

## 第 24 课 · g-3024:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
- 要点:
  - if + had + past participle
  - main clause would/could have + past participle
  - expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
  - if omitted, invert: Had I known...
  - mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb
- 例句:
  - If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - 译:如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。
  - If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - 译:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。
  - If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
    - 译:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - 译:如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。
  - Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - 译:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。
  - If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
    - 译:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3024-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
    - B. If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
    - C. If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
    - D. If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
  - **Q2(g-3024-q2)** 「如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If he had left earlier, he will have caught the train.
    - B. If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - C. If he had left earlier, he had caught the train.
    - D. If he had left earlier, he would catch the train.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
  - **Q3(g-3024-q3)** If we had taken a map, we _____ lost.
    - A. won't get
    - B. wouldn't have got
    - C. wouldn't get
    - D. hadn't got
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 wouldn't have got。句意:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - **Q4(g-3024-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If she had studied harder, she could pass.
    - B. If she had studied harder, she had passed.
    - C. If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
    - D. If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
  - **Q5(g-3024-q5)** 「要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Have I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - B. Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - C. If I would see you, I would have said hello.
    - D. Did I see you, I would have said hello.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
  - **Q6(g-3024-q6)** If it _____, we would have gone out.
    - A. hasn't rained
    - B. wouldn't rain
    - C. didn't rain
    - D. hadn't rained
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 hadn't rained。句意:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

## 第 25 课 · g-3025:Subjunctive mood after wish · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
- 要点:
  - wish + subject + past (a present wish)
  - wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
  - wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
  - were is used for all persons
  - if only = how I wish
- 例句:
  - I wish I had more free time.
    - 译:真希望我有更多空闲时间。
  - She wishes she had studied harder before.
    - 译:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - 译:真希望我和哥哥一样高。
  - He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - 译:他真希望自己会开飞机。
  - If only I had taken your advice!
    - 译:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - We wish we had visited Tokyo last year.
    - 译:真希望我们去年去了东京。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3025-q1)** 「真希望我有更多空闲时间。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I wish I would have more free time.
    - B. I wish I having more free time.
    - C. I wish I have more free time.
    - D. I wish I had more free time.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I had more free time.
  - **Q2(g-3025-q2)** She wishes she _____ harder before.
    - A. has studied
    - B. would study
    - C. studied
    - D. had studied
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had studied。句意:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - **Q3(g-3025-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I wish I am as tall as my brother.
    - B. I wish I was as tall as my brother.
    - C. I wish I will be as tall as my brother.
    - D. I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I were as tall as my brother.
  - **Q4(g-3025-q4)** 「他真希望自己会开飞机。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He wishes he can fly a plane.
    - B. He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - C. He wishes he could flew a plane.
    - D. He wishes he flew a plane.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:He wishes he could fly a plane.
  - **Q5(g-3025-q5)** If only I _____ your advice!
    - A. would take
    - B. have taken
    - C. had taken
    - D. took
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had taken。句意:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - **Q6(g-3025-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We wish we would visit Tokyo last year.
    - B. We wish we visited Tokyo last year.
    - C. We wish we have visited Tokyo last year.
    - D. We wish we had visited Tokyo last year.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited Tokyo last year.

## 第 26 课 · g-3026:Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
- 要点:
  - suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
  - should can be omitted
  - the negative is (should) not + base verb
  - the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
  - insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense
- 例句:
  - The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
    - 译:医生建议他多锻炼。
  - She insisted that we be there on time.
    - 译:她坚持要我们准时到。
  - The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
    - 译:老师要求今天交作业。
  - It is important that everyone follow the rules.
    - 译:每个人都遵守规则很重要。
  - He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - 译:他命令立刻完成工作。
  - My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
    - 译:我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3026-q1)** The doctor suggested that he _____ more exercise.
    - A. takes
    - B. take
    - C. took
    - D. taking
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 take。句意:医生建议他多锻炼。
  - **Q2(g-3026-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She insisted that we being there on time.
    - B. She insisted that we are there on time.
    - C. She insisted that we were there on time.
    - D. She insisted that we be there on time.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:She insisted that we be there on time.
  - **Q3(g-3026-q3)** 「老师要求今天交作业。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The teacher demanded that the homework is handed in today.
    - B. The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
    - C. The teacher demanded that the homework been handed in today.
    - D. The teacher demanded that the homework was handed in today.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
  - **Q4(g-3026-q4)** It is important that everyone _____ the rules.
    - A. follow
    - B. followed
    - C. follows
    - D. following
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 follow。句意:每个人都遵守规则很重要。
  - **Q5(g-3026-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He ordered that the work is finished at once.
    - B. He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - C. He ordered that the work been finished at once.
    - D. He ordered that the work was finished at once.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:He ordered that the work be finished at once.
  - **Q6(g-3026-q6)** 「我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。」的正确英文是?
    - A. My mother suggested that I not watching too much TV.
    - B. My mother suggested that I not to watch too much TV.
    - C. My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
    - D. My mother suggested that I didn't watch too much TV.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.

## 第 27 课 · g-3027:Mixed subjunctive moods · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - past condition + present result
  - if + had done, main clause would do
  - present condition + past result is rare
  - judge the time by the context
  - were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted
- 例句:
  - If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
    - 译:如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在东京了。
  - If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - 译:如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。
  - If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - 译:如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。
  - Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - 译:如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。
  - If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
    - 译:如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。
  - If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
    - 译:如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3027-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
    - B. If I had taken that job, I will be in Tokyo now.
    - C. If I had taken that job, I would have been in Tokyo now.
    - D. If I had taken that job, I had been in Tokyo now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
  - **Q2(g-3027-q2)** 「如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - B. If he didn't miss the bus, he would be here now.
    - C. If he wouldn't miss the bus, he would be here now.
    - D. If he hasn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
  - **Q3(g-3027-q3)** If I _____ smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - A. had been
    - B. were
    - C. would be
    - D. was
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 were。句意:如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。
  - **Q4(g-3027-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If you would ask me then, I would help you even now.
    - B. Have you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - C. Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - D. Did you ask me then, I would help you even now.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
  - **Q5(g-3027-q5)** 「如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If she had gone to bed early, she won't be tired now.
    - B. If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
    - C. If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't have been tired now.
    - D. If she had gone to bed early, she hadn't been tired now.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
  - **Q6(g-3027-q6)** If I had saved money then, I _____ it today.
    - A. could buy
    - B. had bought
    - C. can buy
    - D. could have bought
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 could buy。句意:如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。

## 第 28 课 · g-3028:Inversion with fronted negative words · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
  - Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
  - Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
  - Little did he know the truth.
  - the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary
- 例句:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - 译:我从未见过这么美的日落。
  - Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
    - 译:我们刚出发就开始下雨了。
  - Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - 译:他不仅工作努力,还很善良。
  - Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - 译:她一点也不知道答案是错的。
  - Not once has he been late this year.
    - 译:今年他一次也没迟到过。
  - Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - 译:我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3028-q1)** 「我从未见过这么美的日落。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - B. Never did I saw such a beautiful sunset.
    - C. Never I saw such a beautiful sunset.
    - D. Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
  - **Q2(g-3028-q2)** Hardly _____ when it began to rain.
    - A. we started
    - B. had we started
    - C. did we start
    - D. we had started
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 had we started。句意:我们刚出发就开始下雨了。
  - **Q3(g-3028-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Not only he does work hard, but he is also kind.
    - B. Not only he works hard, but he is also kind.
    - C. Not only works he hard, but he is also kind.
    - D. Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
  - **Q4(g-3028-q4)** 「她一点也不知道答案是错的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - B. Little she did know that the answer was wrong.
    - C. Little she knew that the answer was wrong.
    - D. Little knew she that the answer was wrong.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
  - **Q5(g-3028-q5)** Not once _____ late this year.
    - A. he was
    - B. did he was
    - C. he has been
    - D. has he been
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 has he been。句意:今年他一次也没迟到过。
  - **Q6(g-3028-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - B. Seldom we see such old buildings now.
    - C. Seldom see we such old buildings now.
    - D. Seldom we do see such old buildings now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Seldom do we see such old buildings now.

## 第 29 课 · g-3029:only + adverbial inversion · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Only then did I understand.
  - Only in this way can we solve it.
  - Only when the rain stopped did we go out.
  - only modifying the subject does not invert: Only Tom knows.
  - the inversion occurs in the clause after only
- 例句:
  - Only then did I understand his words.
    - 译:直到那时我才明白他的话。
  - Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - 译:只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。
  - Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - 译:直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。
  - Only at night does the city become quiet.
    - 译:只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。
  - Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - 译:直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。
  - Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - 译:只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3029-q1)** Only then _____ his words.
    - A. understood I
    - B. did I understand
    - C. I did understand
    - D. I understood
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did I understand。句意:直到那时我才明白他的话。
  - **Q2(g-3029-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only in this way we finish can the work on time.
    - B. Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - C. Only in this way finish we can the work on time.
    - D. Only in this way we can finish the work on time.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
  - **Q3(g-3029-q3)** 「直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only when the teacher came they stopped talking.
    - B. Only when the teacher came they did stop talking.
    - C. Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - D. Only when the teacher came stopped they talking.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
  - **Q4(g-3029-q4)** Only at night _____ quiet.
    - A. the city does become
    - B. the city becomes
    - C. does the city become
    - D. becomes the city
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 does the city become。句意:只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。
  - **Q5(g-3029-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only after the meeting he did call me.
    - B. Only after the meeting he called me.
    - C. Only after the meeting called he me.
    - D. Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only after the meeting did he call me.
  - **Q6(g-3029-q6)** 「只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - B. Only with your help I can pass the exam.
    - C. Only with your help I pass can the exam.
    - D. Only with your help pass I can the exam.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only with your help can I pass the exam.

## 第 30 课 · g-3030:so / neither partial inversion · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
- 要点:
  - So do I = I do too
  - Neither do I = I don't either
  - the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
  - So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
  - the tense agrees with the previous sentence
- 例句:
  - I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - 译:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。
  - He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - 译:他不会开车,我也不会。
  - They went to the museum, and so did we.
    - 译:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。
  - I have never been to Toronto, and neither has he.
    - 译:我没去过多伦多,他也没去过。
  - She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - 译:她是护士,我也是。
  - You won't give up, and neither shall we.
    - 译:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3030-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I like traveling, and so do my sister.
    - B. I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - C. I like traveling, and so is my sister.
    - D. I like traveling, and does so my sister.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I like traveling, and so does my sister.
  - **Q2(g-3030-q2)** 「他不会开车,我也不会。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He can't drive, and can neither I.
    - B. He can't drive, and neither do I.
    - C. He can't drive, and neither can't I.
    - D. He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:He can't drive, and neither can I.
  - **Q3(g-3030-q3)** They went to the museum, and _____ we.
    - A. did so
    - B. so were
    - C. so do
    - D. so did
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so did。句意:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。
  - **Q4(g-3030-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I have never been to Toronto, and neither does he.
    - B. I have never been to Toronto, and neither has he.
    - C. I have never been to Toronto, and neither haven't he.
    - D. I have never been to Toronto, and has neither he.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I have never been to Toronto, and neither has he.
  - **Q5(g-3030-q5)** 「她是护士,我也是。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She is a nurse, and am so I.
    - B. She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - C. She is a nurse, and so do I.
    - D. She is a nurse, and so is I.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:She is a nurse, and so am I.
  - **Q6(g-3030-q6)** You won't give up, and _____ we.
    - A. neither do
    - B. shall neither
    - C. neither will not
    - D. neither shall
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither shall。句意:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

## 第 31 课 · g-3031:Cleft sentences It is...that · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
- 要点:
  - emphasizing a person: It is...who...
  - emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
  - not the predicate can be emphasized
  - the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
  - distinguished from the formal subject It is...that
- 例句:
  - It was Tom who broke the window.
    - 译:是汤姆打破了窗户。
  - It is English that we practice every morning.
    - 译:我们每天早上练的是英语。
  - It was in November that they first met.
    - 译:他们是在十一月初次见面的。
  - It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - 译:每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。
  - It was at the station that I lost my bag.
    - 译:我是在车站丢的包。
  - It is hard work that leads to success.
    - 译:是努力通向成功。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3031-q1)** 「是汤姆打破了窗户。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It was Tom who broke the window.
    - B. It was Tom that whom broke the window.
    - C. It was Tom which broke the window.
    - D. It was Tom whom broke the window.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was Tom who broke the window.
  - **Q2(g-3031-q2)** It is English _____ we practice every morning.
    - A. that
    - B. who
    - C. which
    - D. what
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:我们每天早上练的是英语。
  - **Q3(g-3031-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It was in November when they first met.
    - B. It was in November which they first met.
    - C. It was in November that they first met.
    - D. It was in November what they first met.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was in November that they first met.
  - **Q4(g-3031-q4)** 「每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is my mother which cooks for us every day.
    - B. It is my mother whose cooks for us every day.
    - C. It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - D. It is my mother whom cooks for us every day.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
  - **Q5(g-3031-q5)** It was at the station _____ I lost my bag.
    - A. when
    - B. where
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:我是在车站丢的包。
  - **Q6(g-3031-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is hard work which leads to success.
    - B. It is hard work who leads to success.
    - C. It is hard work that leads to success.
    - D. It is hard work what leads to success.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is hard work that leads to success.

## 第 32 课 · g-3032:Formal subject it · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
- 要点:
  - It is important to learn English.
  - It takes time to master a skill.
  - It is said that... reportedly
  - It is + adjective + for sb to do
  - It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)
- 例句:
  - It is important to keep a diary in English.
    - 译:用英语写日记很重要。
  - It takes about an hour to get to the bookstore.
    - 译:到书店大约需要一个小时。
  - It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - 译:据说这座桥历史悠久。
  - It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
    - 译:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。
  - It is kind of you to help me with math.
    - 译:你帮我学数学,真是太好了。
  - It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - 译:事后后悔是没有用的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3032-q1)** It is important _____ a diary in English.
    - A. keeping
    - B. to keep
    - C. keep
    - D. to keeping
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 to keep。句意:用英语写日记很重要。
  - **Q2(g-3032-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It takes about an hour to get to the bookstore.
    - B. It takes about an hour to getting to the bookstore.
    - C. It takes about an hour get to the bookstore.
    - D. It takes about an hour getting to the bookstore.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It takes about an hour to get to the bookstore.
  - **Q3(g-3032-q3)** 「据说这座桥历史悠久。」的正确英文是?
    - A. That is said the bridge has a long history.
    - B. It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - C. It is say that the bridge has a long history.
    - D. It says that the bridge has a long history.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is said that the bridge has a long history.
  - **Q4(g-3032-q4)** It is necessary _____ notes in class.
    - A. of us to take
    - B. for us to take
    - C. for us taking
    - D. us to take
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 for us to take。句意:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。
  - **Q5(g-3032-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is kind of you to help me with math.
    - B. It is kind you to help me with math.
    - C. It is kind of you helping me with math.
    - D. It is kind for you to help me with math.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is kind of you to help me with math.
  - **Q6(g-3032-q6)** 「事后后悔是没有用的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - B. It is no use to cry over spilt milk.
    - C. It is no use cry over spilt milk.
    - D. It is no use to crying over spilt milk.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is no use crying over spilt milk.

## 第 33 课 · g-3033:Formal object it · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。
- 要点:
  - find it + adjective + to do
  - think it + noun + to do
  - make it + adjective + that
  - it refers to the real object placed later
  - common verbs: find, think, make, consider
- 例句:
  - I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - 译:我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。
  - She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - 译:她认为列清单是个好习惯。
  - We make it a rule to clean the room on Friday.
    - 译:我们规定星期五打扫房间。
  - Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - 译:你认为值得再试一次吗?
  - The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - 译:噪音让人难以入睡。
  - I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
    - 译:我相信一周内完成是可能的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3033-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I find that helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - B. I find it's helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - C. I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - D. I find it helpful read aloud every morning.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
  - **Q2(g-3033-q2)** 「她认为列清单是个好习惯。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - B. She thinks it's a good habit to make lists.
    - C. She thinks that a good habit to make lists.
    - D. She thinks it good habit to make lists.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
  - **Q3(g-3033-q3)** We make _____ to clean the room on Friday.
    - A. it rule
    - B. it's a rule
    - C. it a rule
    - D. that a rule
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it a rule。句意:我们规定星期五打扫房间。
  - **Q4(g-3033-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Do you consider it worth to try again?
    - B. Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - C. Do you consider that worth trying again?
    - D. Do you consider it's worth trying again?
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:Do you consider it worth trying again?
  - **Q5(g-3033-q5)** 「噪音让人难以入睡。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The noise made it hard fall asleep.
    - B. The noise made that hard to fall asleep.
    - C. The noise made it's hard to fall asleep.
    - D. The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
  - **Q6(g-3033-q6)** I believe _____ finish it in a week.
    - A. that possible to
    - B. it's possible to
    - C. it possible to
    - D. it possible
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it possible to。句意:我相信一周内完成是可能的。

## 第 34 课 · g-3034:with compound structures · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。
- 要点:
  - with + noun + adjective: with the door open
  - with + noun + V-ing: active ongoing
  - with + noun + past participle: passive or completed
  - with + noun + prepositional phrase
  - independent of the sentence's subject
- 例句:
  - He slept with the window open.
    - 译:他开着窗户睡觉。
  - With the sun rising, the city became bright.
    - 译:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。
  - She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - 译:她闭着眼睛站在那里。
  - With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,我们出去玩了。
  - The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
    - 译:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。
  - He left with the lights on.
    - 译:他没关灯就走了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3034-q1)** 「他开着窗户睡觉。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He slept with the window opened.
    - B. He slept with the window opens.
    - C. He slept with the window open.
    - D. He slept with the window opening.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He slept with the window open.
  - **Q2(g-3034-q2)** With the sun _____, the city became bright.
    - A. risen
    - B. rises
    - C. rising
    - D. rose
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 rising。句意:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。
  - **Q3(g-3034-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She stood there with her eyes closes.
    - B. She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - C. She stood there with her eyes closing.
    - D. She stood there with her eyes close.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:She stood there with her eyes closed.
  - **Q4(g-3034-q4)** 「做完作业后,我们出去玩了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - B. With the homework did, we went out to play.
    - C. With the homework do, we went out to play.
    - D. With the homework doing, we went out to play.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:With the homework done, we went out to play.
  - **Q5(g-3034-q5)** The girl _____ a book in her hand is my sister.
    - A. of
    - B. which has
    - C. with
    - D. has
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 with。句意:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。
  - **Q6(g-3034-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He left with the lights opened.
    - B. He left with the lights open.
    - C. He left with the lights opening.
    - D. He left with the lights on.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He left with the lights on.

## 第 35 课 · g-3035:Absolute constructions · 要点精讲

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。
- 要点:
  - the logical subject differs from the main clause subject
  - noun + past participle: the work finished, ...
  - noun + adjective: the floor wet, ...
  - with the absolute can be preceded by with
  - generally not used in spoken language, common in written expression
- 例句:
  - The work finished, we went home happily.
    - 译:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。
  - The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - 译:太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。
  - Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 译:天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。
  - Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
    - 译:她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。
  - All things considered, it was a good plan.
    - 译:通盘考虑,这是个好计划。
  - There being no bus, we had to walk home.
    - 译:没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3035-q1)** The work _____, we went home happily.
    - A. finish
    - B. finished
    - C. was finished
    - D. finishing
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 finished。句意:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。
  - **Q2(g-3035-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The sun setting, we walked back in the dark.
    - B. The sun has set, we walked back in the dark.
    - C. The sun set, we walked back in the dark.
    - D. The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
  - **Q3(g-3035-q3)** 「天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Weather to permit, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - B. Weather permitted, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - C. Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - D. Weather permits, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 答案:C
