    - 解析:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:That the earth is round is a fact.
  - **Q6(g-3377-q6)** 「据报道雨很快会停。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is reported that the rain will stop soon.
    - B. It is reported which the rain will stop soon.
    - C. It is reported what the rain will stop soon.
    - D. It is reported whether the rain will stop soon.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:It is reported that the rain will stop soon.

## 第 378 课 · g-3378:Present participles as adverbials · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A present participle phrase as adverbial; its logical subject must agree with the sentence's subject.本课为典型例句练习,核心:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。
- 要点:
  - Hearing the news, she smiled.
  - expresses accompanying state: sitting there, ...
  - having done expresses a completed action
  - the negative is not doing
  - a dangling participle occurs when the logical subject is inconsistent
- 例句:
  - Hearing the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - 译:听到这个好消息,我们都高兴得跳了起来。
  - Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
    - 译:沿着街走时,我遇到了一位老朋友。
  - Having finished the homework, he went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,他出去玩了。
  - The children ran out of the classroom, talking and laughing.
    - 译:孩子们说着笑着跑出了教室。
  - Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
    - 译:因为不认识路,他问了警察。
  - Sitting by the window, she watched the rain.
    - 译:她坐在窗边看着雨。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3378-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. To hear the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - B. Hear the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - C. Heard the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - D. Hearing the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Hearing the good news, we all jumped with joy.
  - **Q2(g-3378-q2)** 「沿着街走时,我遇到了一位老朋友。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
    - B. Walk along the street, I met an old friend.
    - C. To walk along the street, I met an old friend.
    - D. Walked along the street, I met an old friend.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
  - **Q3(g-3378-q3)** _____ the homework, he went out to play.
    - A. Finished
    - B. To finish
    - C. Have finished
    - D. Having finished
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。此处应为 Having finished。句意:做完作业后,他出去玩了。
  - **Q4(g-3378-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The children ran out of the classroom, talking and laughing.
    - B. The children ran out of the classroom, talked and laughing.
    - C. The children ran out of the classroom, to talk and laughing.
    - D. The children ran out of the classroom, talk and laughing.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:The children ran out of the classroom, talking and laughing.
  - **Q5(g-3378-q5)** 「因为不认识路,他问了警察。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Not know the way, he asked a policeman.
    - B. Not to know the way, he asked a policeman.
    - C. Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
    - D. Didn't know the way, he asked a policeman.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
  - **Q6(g-3378-q6)** _____ by the window, she watched the rain.
    - A. Sat
    - B. To sit
    - C. Seat
    - D. Sitting
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。此处应为 Sitting。句意:她坐在窗边看着雨。

## 第 379 课 · g-3379:Past participles as adverbials · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A past participle phrase as adverbial, the logical subject passively receives the action.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。
- 要点:
  - Seen from the hill, the city looks small.
  - expressing a completed state
  - having been done emphasizes a completed passive
  - the negative is not done
  - the relation to the subject is passive
- 例句:
  - Seen from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - 译:从飞机上看,田野像方块。
  - Given more time, we could do it better.
    - 译:如果给我们更多时间,我们能做得更好。
  - Tired from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - 译:旅途劳累,她早早睡了。
  - Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - 译:这本书是用简单英语写的,容易读。
  - Not invited to the party, he stayed at home.
    - 译:由于没被邀请参加聚会,他待在家里。
  - Lost in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - 译:陷入沉思,他没听到铃声。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3379-q1)** 「从飞机上看,田野像方块。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Seen from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - B. Seeing from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - C. See from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - D. To see from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Seen from the plane, the fields look like squares.
  - **Q2(g-3379-q2)** _____ more time, we could do it better.
    - A. To give
    - B. Give
    - C. Given
    - D. Giving
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。此处应为 Given。句意:如果给我们更多时间,我们能做得更好。
  - **Q3(g-3379-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Tiring from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - B. To tire from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - C. Tired from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - D. Tire from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Tired from the trip, she went to bed early.
  - **Q4(g-3379-q4)** 「这本书是用简单英语写的,容易读。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - B. Wrote in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - C. To write in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - D. Writing in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
  - **Q5(g-3379-q5)** _____ to the party, he stayed at home.
    - A. Didn't invite
    - B. Not inviting
    - C. Not invited
    - D. Not to invite
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。此处应为 Not invited。句意:由于没被邀请参加聚会,他待在家里。
  - **Q6(g-3379-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Lose in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - B. To lose in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - C. Losing in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - D. Lost in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Lost in thought, he didn't hear the bell.

## 第 380 课 · g-3380:Perfect infinitives · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The perfect infinitive expresses an action that happened before the predicate verb.本课为典型例句练习,核心:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。
- 要点:
  - I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
  - seems/appears + to have done
  - would like to have done (an unrealized wish)
  - the passive of the perfect infinitive to have been done
  - it is the action order that is being examined
- 例句:
  - I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
    - 译:很抱歉让你等了这么久。
  - He seems to have forgotten my name.
    - 译:他似乎忘记了我的名字。
  - She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
    - 译:她是第一个登上这座山的人。
  - I would like to have joined your trip.
    - 译:我本想参加你们的旅行的。
  - The novel is said to have been translated into many languages.
    - 译:据说这部小说已被翻译成多种语言。
  - We are glad to have finished the work on time.
    - 译:我们很高兴按时完成了工作。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3380-q1)** I am sorry _____ you waiting so long.
    - A. to have kept
    - B. keeping
    - C. to keeping
    - D. to keep
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。此处应为 to have kept。句意:很抱歉让你等了这么久。
  - **Q2(g-3380-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He seems forgetting my name.
    - B. He seems to have forgotten my name.
    - C. He seems to forget my name.
    - D. He seems to forgetting my name.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:He seems to have forgotten my name.
  - **Q3(g-3380-q3)** 「她是第一个登上这座山的人。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
    - B. She was the first climbing the mountain.
    - C. She was the first climb the mountain.
    - D. She was the first to climb the mountain.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
  - **Q4(g-3380-q4)** I would like _____ your trip.
    - A. to have joined
    - B. join
    - C. to join
    - D. joining
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。此处应为 to have joined。句意:我本想参加你们的旅行的。
  - **Q5(g-3380-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The novel is said to translate into many languages.
    - B. The novel is said translated to into many languages.
    - C. The novel is said to be translating into many languages.
    - D. The novel is said to have been translated into many languages.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:The novel is said to have been translated into many languages.
  - **Q6(g-3380-q6)** 「我们很高兴按时完成了工作。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We are glad finishing the work on time.
    - B. We are glad to finish the work on time.
    - C. We are glad to have finished the work on time.
    - D. We are glad to finishing the work on time.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:We are glad to have finished the work on time.

## 第 381 课 · g-3381:as concession inversion · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The as-concession inversion: Young as he is, he knows a lot.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。
- 要点:
  - adjective + as + subject + verb
  - the noun is singular and takes no article: Child as he is, ...
  - the adverb can also be fronted
  - equivalent to although
  - though can replace as in this structure, but not although
- 例句:
  - Young as he is, he knows a lot.
    - 译:他虽然年轻,但懂得很多。
  - Tired as she was, she kept working.
    - 译:她虽然累了,仍继续工作。
  - Child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - 译:他虽然是个孩子,但能自己穿衣服。
  - Hard as he tried, he failed again.
    - 译:尽管他很努力,还是又失败了。
  - Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
    - 译:虽然我很喜欢它,但不会买。
  - Strange as it sounds, the story is true.
    - 译:这故事虽然听起来奇怪,但是真实的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3381-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Young as is he, he knows a lot.
    - B. As he is young, he knows a lot.
    - C. Young as he is, he knows a lot.
    - D. As young he is, he knows a lot.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Young as he is, he knows a lot.
  - **Q2(g-3381-q2)** 「她虽然累了,仍继续工作。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Tired as was she, she kept working.
    - B. As she was tired, she kept working.
    - C. Tired as she was, she kept working.
    - D. As tired she was, she kept working.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Tired as she was, she kept working.
  - **Q3(g-3381-q3)** _____, he can dress himself.
    - A. Child as he is
    - B. Child as is he
    - C. A child as he is
    - D. As he is child
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。此处应为 Child as he is。句意:他虽然是个孩子,但能自己穿衣服。
  - **Q4(g-3381-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Hard as he tried, he failed again.
    - B. Hard as did he try, he failed again.
    - C. As hard he tried, he failed again.
    - D. As he tried hard, he failed again.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Hard as he tried, he failed again.
  - **Q5(g-3381-q5)** 「虽然我很喜欢它,但不会买。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
    - B. As I like much it, I won't buy it.
    - C. Much as I do like it, I won't buy it.
    - D. As much I like it, I won't buy it.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
  - **Q6(g-3381-q6)** _____, the story is true.
    - A. Strange as it sounds
    - B. Strange as does it sound
    - C. As it sounds strange
    - D. As strange it sounds
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。此处应为 Strange as it sounds。句意:这故事虽然听起来奇怪,但是真实的。

## 第 382 课 · g-3382:while / whereas contrast · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:while used at the start of a sentence means 'whereas', connecting two contrasting clauses.本课为典型例句练习,核心:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。
- 要点:
  - Whereas some like tea, others like coffee.
  - while + continuous action
  - whereas is more formal than while
  - while can express 'as long as'
  - note the distinction from the time sense
- 例句:
  - While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - 译:有些学生喜欢运动,而另一些更喜欢阅读。
  - He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
    - 译:他很高,而他哥哥很矮。
  - While I understand you, I can't agree.
    - 译:尽管我理解你,但不能同意。
  - She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
    - 译:她喜欢城市生活,而他热爱乡村。
  - While the phone is old, it works well.
    - 译:这部手机虽然旧,但很好用。
  - Some plants need much water, whereas others need little.
    - 译:有些植物需要大量水,而另一些几乎不需要。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3382-q1)** 「有些学生喜欢运动,而另一些更喜欢阅读。」的正确英文是?
    - A. As some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - B. When some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - C. Whenever some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - D. While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
  - **Q2(g-3382-q2)** He is tall, _____ his brother is short.
    - A. whereas
    - B. when
    - C. as
    - D. wherever
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。此处应为 whereas。句意:他很高,而他哥哥很矮。
  - **Q3(g-3382-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. When I understand you, I can't agree.
    - B. While I understand you, I can't agree.
    - C. As I understand you, I can't agree.
    - D. Since I understand you, I can't agree.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:While I understand you, I can't agree.
  - **Q4(g-3382-q4)** 「她喜欢城市生活,而他热爱乡村。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
    - B. She enjoys city life, whilst that he loves the countryside.
    - C. She enjoys city life, as he loves the countryside.
    - D. She enjoys city life, when he loves the countryside.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
  - **Q5(g-3382-q5)** _____ the phone is old, it works well.
    - A. While
    - B. Unless
    - C. When
    - D. As
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。此处应为 While。句意:这部手机虽然旧,但很好用。
  - **Q6(g-3382-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Some plants need much water, wherever others need little.
    - B. Some plants need much water, as others need little.
    - C. Some plants need much water, when others need little.
    - D. Some plants need much water, whereas others need little.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:Some plants need much water, whereas others need little.

## 第 383 课 · g-3383:Compound sentences and semicolons · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。
- 要点:
  - S1; S2 two parallel clauses
  - S1; however, S2
  - a comma alone cannot join two complete sentences
  - therefore/thus express result
  - meanwhile/moreover express simultaneity or addition
- 例句:
  - The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
    - 译:这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。
  - He tried his best; therefore, he won the prize.
    - 译:他尽了最大努力;因此,他获奖了。
  - Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
    - 译:时间紧迫;因此,我们必须立刻出发。
  - I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
    - 译:我喜欢阅读;然而,我妹妹喜欢画画。
  - The rain stopped; meanwhile, the sun came out.
    - 译:雨停了;与此同时,太阳出来了。
  - It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.
    - 译:天黑了,所以我们只好停下来休息。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3383-q1)** The plan sounds good; _____, it costs too much.
    - A. however
    - B. moreover
    - C. therefore
    - D. besides
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。此处应为 however。句意:这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。
  - **Q2(g-3383-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He tried his best; otherwise, he won the prize.
    - B. He tried his best; therefore, he won the prize.
    - C. He tried his best; besides, he won the prize.
    - D. He tried his best; however, he won the prize.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:He tried his best; therefore, he won the prize.
  - **Q3(g-3383-q3)** 「时间紧迫;因此,我们必须立刻出发。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Time is short; however, we must start at once.
    - B. Time is short; meanwhile, we must start at once.
    - C. Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
    - D. Time is short; instead, we must start at once.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
  - **Q4(g-3383-q4)** I like reading; my sister, _____, likes drawing.
    - A. thus
    - B. however
    - C. therefore
    - D. hence
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。此处应为 however。句意:我喜欢阅读;然而,我妹妹喜欢画画。
  - **Q5(g-3383-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The rain stopped; meanwhile, the sun came out.
    - B. The rain stopped; otherwise, the sun came out.
    - C. The rain stopped; however, the sun came out.
    - D. The rain stopped; therefore, the sun came out.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:The rain stopped; meanwhile, the sun came out.
  - **Q6(g-3383-q6)** 「天黑了,所以我们只好停下来休息。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It was getting dark, but we had to stop and rest.
    - B. It was getting dark, because we had to stop and rest.
    - C. It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.
    - D. It was getting dark, or we had to stop and rest.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.

## 第 384 课 · g-3384:Appositives · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为典型例句练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。
- 要点:
  - Tom, my best friend, ...
  - a noun of identity directly follows
  - the appositive clause that explains an abstract noun: the news that ...
  - that in the appositive clause has no meaning and cannot be omitted
  - an appositive can be introduced by namely
- 例句:
  - Mr. Wang, our English teacher, is very humorous.
    - 译:我们的英语老师王先生非常幽默。
  - The news that our team won made us excited.
    - 译:我们队获胜的消息让我们兴奋。
  - We have one goal, namely to win.
    - 译:我们只有一个目标,即获胜。
  - The fact that he lied surprised everyone.
    - 译:他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。
  - Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
    - 译:北京,中国的首都,是一座大城市。
  - My friend Lily lives near the cinema.
    - 译:我的朋友莉莉住在电影院附近。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3384-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Mr. Wang, he is our English teacher, is very humorous.
    - B. Mr. Wang, our teacher English, is very humorous.
    - C. Mr. Wang, ours English teacher, is very humorous.
    - D. Mr. Wang, our English teacher, is very humorous.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:Mr. Wang, our English teacher, is very humorous.
  - **Q2(g-3384-q2)** 「我们队获胜的消息让我们兴奋。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The news what our team won made us excited.
    - B. The news who our team won made us excited.
    - C. The news that our team won made us excited.
    - D. The news which our team won made us excited.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:The news that our team won made us excited.
  - **Q3(g-3384-q3)** We have one goal, _____ to win.
    - A. namable
    - B. it is
    - C. that is to saying
    - D. namely
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 namely。句意:我们只有一个目标,即获胜。
  - **Q4(g-3384-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The fact that he lied surprised everyone.
    - B. The fact which he lied surprised everyone.
    - C. The fact whom he lied surprised everyone.
    - D. The fact what he lied surprised everyone.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:The fact that he lied surprised everyone.
  - **Q5(g-3384-q5)** 「北京,中国的首都,是一座大城市。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Beijing, it the capital, is a big city.
    - B. Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
    - C. Beijing, which the capital of China, is a big city.
    - D. Beijing, capital of China it, is a big city.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
  - **Q6(g-3384-q6)** My friend _____ lives near the cinema.
    - A. she Lily
    - B. who Lily
    - C. Lily she
    - D. Lily
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 Lily。句意:我的朋友莉莉住在电影院附近。

## 第 385 课 · g-3385:Parentheticals · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
- 要点:
  - I think / I believe inserted in the middle
  - to be frank frankly speaking
  - believe it or not believe it or not
  - as a result / in fact
  - a parenthetical is separated from the sentence by commas
- 例句:
  - This book, I think, is worth reading.
    - 译:这本书,我认为,值得一读。
  - To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - 译:坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。
  - Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - 译:信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。
  - The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
    - 译:答案,事实上,非常简单。
  - He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
    - 译:他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。
  - This way, I believe, is much better.
    - 译:这种方法,我相信,要好得多。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3385-q1)** 「这本书,我认为,值得一读。」的正确英文是?
    - A. This book, I do think, is worth reading.
    - B. This book, do I think, is worth reading.
    - C. This book, I think, is worth reading.
    - D. This book, think I, is worth reading.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This book, I think, is worth reading.
  - **Q2(g-3385-q2)** _____, the plan is too expensive.
    - A. To be frank
    - B. Frankly to
    - C. Being frank
    - D. To frank
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 To be frank。句意:坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。
  - **Q3(g-3385-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Believing it or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - B. Believe or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - C. Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - D. Believed it or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
  - **Q4(g-3385-q4)** 「答案,事实上,非常简单。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
    - B. The answer, on fact, is quite simple.
    - C. The answer, in the fact, is quite simple.
    - D. The answer, at fact, is quite simple.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
  - **Q5(g-3385-q5)** He was late again, _____, he missed the train.
    - A. in result
    - B. as a result of
    - C. as result
    - D. as a result
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 as a result。句意:他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。
  - **Q6(g-3385-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. This way, I believe, is much better.
    - B. This way, I do believe, is much better.
    - C. This way, do I believe, is much better.
    - D. This way, believe I, is much better.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This way, I believe, is much better.

## 第 386 课 · g-3386:Ellipsis in adverbial clauses · 典型例句(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Ellipsis in adverbial clauses: when the subject is the same and be is present, omit 'subject + be', keeping only the conjunction + complement.本课为典型例句练习,核心:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。
- 要点:
  - When (you are) in doubt, ask the teacher.
  - While (I was) reading, I fell asleep.
  - as if a child as if a child
  - if possible / if necessary are fixed ellipses
  - only when the subject is the same as the main clause can ellipsis occur
- 例句:
  - When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - 译:遇到困难时,向朋友求助。
  - While reading the book, I took many notes.
    - 译:读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。
  - If necessary, I will come earlier.
    - 译:如果有必要,我会早点来。
  - He stood as if rooted to the ground.
    - 译:他站在那里,像生了根一样。
  - Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
    - 译:除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。
  - Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - 译:报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3386-q1)** _____, ask your friends for help.
    - A. When being trouble
    - B. When in trouble
    - C. When you in trouble
    - D. When are in trouble
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 When in trouble。句意:遇到困难时,向朋友求助。
  - **Q2(g-3386-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. While was reading the book, I took many notes.
    - B. While reading the book, I took many notes.
    - C. While I reading the book, I took many notes.
    - D. While read the book, I took many notes.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:While reading the book, I took many notes.
  - **Q3(g-3386-q3)** 「如果有必要,我会早点来。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If it necessary, I will come earlier.
    - B. If necessary, I will come earlier.
    - C. If is necessary, I will come earlier.
    - D. If being necessary, I will come earlier.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:If necessary, I will come earlier.
  - **Q4(g-3386-q4)** He stood _____ to the ground.
    - A. as if rooted
    - B. as if root
    - C. as if was rooted
    - D. as if rooting
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 as if rooted。句意:他站在那里,像生了根一样。
  - **Q5(g-3386-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Unless invite, I won't go to the party.
    - B. Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
    - C. Unless inviting, I won't go to the party.
    - D. Unless am invited, I won't go to the party.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
  - **Q6(g-3386-q6)** 「报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Once is printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - B. Once printing, the report cannot be changed.
    - C. Once print, the report cannot be changed.
    - D. Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:Once printed, the report cannot be changed.

## 第 387 课 · g-3387:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - if + past (be uniformly were)
  - main clause would/could/might + base verb
  - expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
  - were is used for all persons
  - if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go
- 例句:
  - If I were you, I would take the chance.
    - 译:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - If he had more time, he would learn history.
    - 译:如果他有更多时间,他会学历史。
  - If I were a bird, I could fly to Xi'an.
    - 译:如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到西安。
  - If we started now, we would catch the train.
    - 译:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - 译:如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。
  - If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - 译:如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3387-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I were you, I would take the chance.
    - B. If I would be you, I would take the chance.
    - C. If I am you, I would take the chance.
    - D. If I was you, I would take the chance.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were you, I would take the chance.
  - **Q2(g-3387-q2)** 「如果他有更多时间,他会学历史。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If he had more time, he learned history.
    - B. If he had more time, he will learn history.
    - C. If he had more time, he would learn history.
    - D. If he had more time, he would learned history.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn history.
  - **Q3(g-3387-q3)** If I were a bird, I _____ to Xi'an.
    - A. could flew
    - B. will fly
    - C. could fly
    - D. can fly
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 could fly。句意:如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到西安。
  - **Q4(g-3387-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If we start now, we would catch the train.
    - B. If we would start now, we would catch the train.
    - C. If we started now, we would catch the train.
    - D. If we will start now, we would catch the train.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If we started now, we would catch the train.
  - **Q5(g-3387-q5)** 「如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - B. If she knows the answer, she would tell us.
    - C. If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
    - D. If she has known the answer, she would tell us.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
  - **Q6(g-3387-q6)** If I had the money, I _____ a new computer.
    - A. will buy
    - B. bought
    - C. would bought
    - D. would buy
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 would buy。句意:如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。

## 第 388 课 · g-3388:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
- 要点:
  - if + had + past participle
  - main clause would/could have + past participle
  - expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
  - if omitted, invert: Had I known...
  - mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb
- 例句:
  - If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - 译:如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。
  - If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - 译:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。
  - If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
    - 译:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - 译:如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。
  - Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - 译:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。
  - If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
    - 译:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3388-q1)** 「如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
    - B. If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - C. If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
    - D. If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
  - **Q2(g-3388-q2)** If he had left earlier, he _____ the train.
    - A. had caught
    - B. will have caught
    - C. would catch
    - D. would have caught
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 would have caught。句意:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。
  - **Q3(g-3388-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If we had taken a map, we wouldn't get lost.
    - B. If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
    - C. If we had taken a map, we won't get lost.
    - D. If we had taken a map, we hadn't got lost.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
  - **Q4(g-3388-q4)** 「如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If she had studied harder, she could pass.
    - B. If she had studied harder, she had passed.
    - C. If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - D. If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
  - **Q5(g-3388-q5)** _____ you, I would have said hello.
    - A. Did I see
    - B. Had I seen
    - C. If I would see
    - D. Have I seen
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 Had I seen。句意:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。
  - **Q6(g-3388-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If it wouldn't rain, we would have gone out.
    - B. If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
    - C. If it didn't rain, we would have gone out.
    - D. If it hasn't rained, we would have gone out.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.

## 第 389 课 · g-3389:Subjunctive mood after wish · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
- 要点:
  - wish + subject + past (a present wish)
  - wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
  - wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
  - were is used for all persons
  - if only = how I wish
- 例句:
  - I wish I had more free time.
    - 译:真希望我有更多空闲时间。
  - She wishes she had studied harder before.
    - 译:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - 译:真希望我和哥哥一样高。
  - He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - 译:他真希望自己会开飞机。
  - If only I had taken your advice!
    - 译:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - We wish we had visited Xi'an last year.
    - 译:真希望我们去年去了西安。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3389-q1)** I wish I _____ more free time.
    - A. would have
    - B. had
    - C. have
    - D. having
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had。句意:真希望我有更多空闲时间。
  - **Q2(g-3389-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She wishes she had studied harder before.
    - B. She wishes she would study harder before.
    - C. She wishes she studied harder before.
    - D. She wishes she has studied harder before.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:She wishes she had studied harder before.
  - **Q3(g-3389-q3)** 「真希望我和哥哥一样高。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I wish I am as tall as my brother.
    - B. I wish I will be as tall as my brother.
    - C. I wish I was as tall as my brother.
    - D. I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I were as tall as my brother.
  - **Q4(g-3389-q4)** He wishes he _____ a plane.
    - A. could fly
    - B. can fly
    - C. could flew
    - D. flew
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 could fly。句意:他真希望自己会开飞机。
  - **Q5(g-3389-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If only I took your advice!
    - B. If only I have taken your advice!
    - C. If only I had taken your advice!
    - D. If only I would take your advice!
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:If only I had taken your advice!
  - **Q6(g-3389-q6)** 「真希望我们去年去了西安。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We wish we have visited Xi'an last year.
    - B. We wish we visited Xi'an last year.
    - C. We wish we would visit Xi'an last year.
    - D. We wish we had visited Xi'an last year.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited Xi'an last year.

## 第 390 课 · g-3390:Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
- 要点:
  - suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
  - should can be omitted
  - the negative is (should) not + base verb
  - the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
  - insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense
- 例句:
  - The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
    - 译:医生建议他多锻炼。
  - She insisted that we be there on time.
    - 译:她坚持要我们准时到。
  - The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
    - 译:老师要求今天交作业。
  - It is important that everyone follow the rules.
    - 译:每个人都遵守规则很重要。
  - He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - 译:他命令立刻完成工作。
  - My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
    - 译:我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3390-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The doctor suggested that he takes more exercise.
    - B. The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
    - C. The doctor suggested that he took more exercise.
    - D. The doctor suggested that he taking more exercise.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
  - **Q2(g-3390-q2)** 「她坚持要我们准时到。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She insisted that we are there on time.
    - B. She insisted that we being there on time.
    - C. She insisted that we be there on time.
    - D. She insisted that we were there on time.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:She insisted that we be there on time.
  - **Q3(g-3390-q3)** The teacher demanded that the homework _____ in today.
    - A. is handed
    - B. be handed
    - C. been handed
    - D. was handed
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be handed。句意:老师要求今天交作业。
  - **Q4(g-3390-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is important that everyone follow the rules.
    - B. It is important that everyone follows the rules.
    - C. It is important that everyone following the rules.
    - D. It is important that everyone followed the rules.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:It is important that everyone follow the rules.
  - **Q5(g-3390-q5)** 「他命令立刻完成工作。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He ordered that the work was finished at once.
    - B. He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - C. He ordered that the work is finished at once.
    - D. He ordered that the work been finished at once.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:He ordered that the work be finished at once.
  - **Q6(g-3390-q6)** My mother suggested that I _____ too much TV.
    - A. not watch
    - B. not watching
    - C. not to watch
    - D. didn't watch
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 not watch。句意:我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

## 第 391 课 · g-3391:Mixed subjunctive moods · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - past condition + present result
  - if + had done, main clause would do
  - present condition + past result is rare
  - judge the time by the context
  - were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted
- 例句:
  - If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
    - 译:如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在东京了。
  - If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - 译:如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。
  - If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - 译:如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。
  - Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - 译:如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。
  - If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
    - 译:如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。
  - If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
    - 译:如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3391-q1)** 「如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在东京了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I had taken that job, I had been in Tokyo now.
    - B. If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
    - C. If I had taken that job, I will be in Tokyo now.
    - D. If I had taken that job, I would have been in Tokyo now.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had taken that job, I would be in Tokyo now.
  - **Q2(g-3391-q2)** If he _____ the bus, he would be here now.
    - A. didn't miss
    - B. hadn't missed
    - C. wouldn't miss
    - D. hasn't missed
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 hadn't missed。句意:如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。
  - **Q3(g-3391-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I had been smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - B. If I was smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - C. If I would be smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - D. If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
  - **Q4(g-3391-q4)** 「如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If you would ask me then, I would help you even now.
    - B. Have you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - C. Did you ask me then, I would help you even now.
    - D. Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
  - **Q5(g-3391-q5)** If she had gone to bed early, she _____ tired now.
    - A. won't be
    - B. wouldn't be
    - C. wouldn't have been
    - D. hadn't been
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 wouldn't be。句意:如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。
  - **Q6(g-3391-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
    - B. If I had saved money then, I had bought it today.
    - C. If I had saved money then, I can buy it today.
    - D. If I had saved money then, I could have bought it today.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.

## 第 392 课 · g-3392:Inversion with fronted negative words · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
  - Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
  - Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
  - Little did he know the truth.
  - the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary
- 例句:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - 译:我从未见过这么美的日落。
  - Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
    - 译:我们刚出发就开始下雨了。
  - Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - 译:他不仅工作努力,还很善良。
  - Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - 译:她一点也不知道答案是错的。
  - Not once has he been late this year.
    - 译:今年他一次也没迟到过。
  - Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - 译:我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3392-q1)** Never _____ such a beautiful sunset.
    - A. I have seen
    - B. I saw
    - C. did I saw
    - D. have I seen
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 have I seen。句意:我从未见过这么美的日落。
  - **Q2(g-3392-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Hardly did we start when it began to rain.
    - B. Hardly we had started when it began to rain.
    - C. Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
    - D. Hardly we started when it began to rain.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
  - **Q3(g-3392-q3)** 「他不仅工作努力,还很善良。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Not only works he hard, but he is also kind.
    - B. Not only he works hard, but he is also kind.
    - C. Not only he does work hard, but he is also kind.
    - D. Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
  - **Q4(g-3392-q4)** Little _____ that the answer was wrong.
    - A. she knew
    - B. she did know
    - C. knew she
    - D. did she know
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did she know。句意:她一点也不知道答案是错的。
  - **Q5(g-3392-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Not once he was late this year.
    - B. Not once has he been late this year.
    - C. Not once did he was late this year.
    - D. Not once he has been late this year.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not once has he been late this year.
  - **Q6(g-3392-q6)** 「我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - B. Seldom we see such old buildings now.
    - C. Seldom see we such old buildings now.
    - D. Seldom we do see such old buildings now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Seldom do we see such old buildings now.

## 第 393 课 · g-3393:only + adverbial inversion · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Only then did I understand.
  - Only in this way can we solve it.
  - Only when the rain stopped did we go out.
  - only modifying the subject does not invert: Only Tom knows.
  - the inversion occurs in the clause after only
- 例句:
  - Only then did I understand his words.
    - 译:直到那时我才明白他的话。
  - Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - 译:只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。
  - Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - 译:直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。
  - Only at night does the city become quiet.
    - 译:只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。
  - Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - 译:直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。
  - Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - 译:只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3393-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only then I did understand his words.
    - B. Only then understood I his words.
    - C. Only then I understood his words.
    - D. Only then did I understand his words.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only then did I understand his words.
  - **Q2(g-3393-q2)** 「只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only in this way we can finish the work on time.
    - B. Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - C. Only in this way finish we can the work on time.
    - D. Only in this way we finish can the work on time.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
  - **Q3(g-3393-q3)** Only when the teacher came _____ talking.
    - A. they did stop
    - B. did they stop
    - C. they stopped
    - D. stopped they
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did they stop。句意:直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。
  - **Q4(g-3393-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only at night does the city become quiet.
    - B. Only at night the city becomes quiet.
    - C. Only at night the city does become quiet.
    - D. Only at night becomes the city quiet.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only at night does the city become quiet.
  - **Q5(g-3393-q5)** 「直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - B. Only after the meeting he called me.
    - C. Only after the meeting he did call me.
    - D. Only after the meeting called he me.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only after the meeting did he call me.
  - **Q6(g-3393-q6)** Only with your help _____ the exam.
    - A. I pass can
    - B. I can pass
    - C. can I pass
    - D. pass I can
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 can I pass。句意:只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。

## 第 394 课 · g-3394:so / neither partial inversion · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
- 要点:
  - So do I = I do too
  - Neither do I = I don't either
  - the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
  - So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
  - the tense agrees with the previous sentence
- 例句:
  - I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - 译:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。
  - He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - 译:他不会开车,我也不会。
  - They went to the museum, and so did we.
    - 译:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。
  - I have never been to Tokyo, and neither has he.
    - 译:我没去过东京,他也没去过。
  - She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - 译:她是护士,我也是。
  - You won't give up, and neither shall we.
    - 译:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3394-q1)** 「我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I like traveling, and so do my sister.
    - B. I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - C. I like traveling, and so is my sister.
    - D. I like traveling, and does so my sister.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I like traveling, and so does my sister.
  - **Q2(g-3394-q2)** He can't drive, and _____ I.
    - A. can neither
    - B. neither can
    - C. neither do
    - D. neither can't
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither can。句意:他不会开车,我也不会。
  - **Q3(g-3394-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. They went to the museum, and so were we.
    - B. They went to the museum, and did so we.
    - C. They went to the museum, and so did we.
    - D. They went to the museum, and so do we.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:They went to the museum, and so did we.
  - **Q4(g-3394-q4)** 「我没去过东京,他也没去过。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I have never been to Tokyo, and neither does he.
    - B. I have never been to Tokyo, and neither has he.
    - C. I have never been to Tokyo, and neither haven't he.
    - D. I have never been to Tokyo, and has neither he.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I have never been to Tokyo, and neither has he.
  - **Q5(g-3394-q5)** She is a nurse, and _____ I.
    - A. am so
    - B. so am
    - C. so do
    - D. so is
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so am。句意:她是护士,我也是。
  - **Q6(g-3394-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. You won't give up, and shall neither we.
    - B. You won't give up, and neither shall we.
    - C. You won't give up, and neither will not we.
    - D. You won't give up, and neither do we.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:You won't give up, and neither shall we.

## 第 395 课 · g-3395:Cleft sentences It is...that · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
- 要点:
  - emphasizing a person: It is...who...
  - emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
  - not the predicate can be emphasized
  - the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
  - distinguished from the formal subject It is...that
- 例句:
  - It was Tom who broke the window.
    - 译:是汤姆打破了窗户。
  - It is English that we practice every morning.
    - 译:我们每天早上练的是英语。
  - It was in November that they first met.
    - 译:他们是在十一月初次见面的。
  - It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - 译:每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。
  - It was at the station that I lost my bag.
    - 译:我是在车站丢的包。
  - It is hard work that leads to success.
    - 译:是努力通向成功。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3395-q1)** It was Tom _____ broke the window.
    - A. whom
    - B. who
    - C. which
    - D. that whom
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 who。句意:是汤姆打破了窗户。
  - **Q2(g-3395-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is English which we practice every morning.
    - B. It is English what we practice every morning.
    - C. It is English who we practice every morning.
    - D. It is English that we practice every morning.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is English that we practice every morning.
  - **Q3(g-3395-q3)** 「他们是在十一月初次见面的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It was in November what they first met.
    - B. It was in November that they first met.
    - C. It was in November which they first met.
    - D. It was in November when they first met.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was in November that they first met.
  - **Q4(g-3395-q4)** It is my mother _____ cooks for us every day.
    - A. which
    - B. whom
    - C. who
    - D. whose
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 who。句意:每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。
  - **Q5(g-3395-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It was at the station that I lost my bag.
    - B. It was at the station which I lost my bag.
    - C. It was at the station when I lost my bag.
    - D. It was at the station where I lost my bag.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was at the station that I lost my bag.
  - **Q6(g-3395-q6)** 「是努力通向成功。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is hard work which leads to success.
    - B. It is hard work that leads to success.
    - C. It is hard work what leads to success.
    - D. It is hard work who leads to success.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is hard work that leads to success.

## 第 396 课 · g-3396:Formal subject it · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
- 要点:
  - It is important to learn English.
  - It takes time to master a skill.
  - It is said that... reportedly
  - It is + adjective + for sb to do
  - It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)
- 例句:
  - It is important to keep a diary in English.
    - 译:用英语写日记很重要。
  - It takes about an hour to get to the cinema.
    - 译:到电影院大约需要一个小时。
  - It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - 译:据说这座桥历史悠久。
  - It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
    - 译:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。
  - It is kind of you to help me with English.
    - 译:你帮我学英语,真是太好了。
  - It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - 译:事后后悔是没有用的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3396-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is important keep a diary in English.
    - B. It is important to keeping a diary in English.
    - C. It is important keeping a diary in English.
    - D. It is important to keep a diary in English.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is important to keep a diary in English.
  - **Q2(g-3396-q2)** 「到电影院大约需要一个小时。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It takes about an hour getting to the cinema.
    - B. It takes about an hour to get to the cinema.
    - C. It takes about an hour get to the cinema.
    - D. It takes about an hour to getting to the cinema.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It takes about an hour to get to the cinema.
  - **Q3(g-3396-q3)** _____ the bridge has a long history.
    - A. It is said that
    - B. It is say that
    - C. It says that
    - D. That is said
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 It is said that。句意:据说这座桥历史悠久。
  - **Q4(g-3396-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
    - B. It is necessary of us to take notes in class.
    - C. It is necessary for us taking notes in class.
    - D. It is necessary us to take notes in class.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
  - **Q5(g-3396-q5)** 「你帮我学英语,真是太好了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is kind of you helping me with English.
    - B. It is kind you to help me with English.
    - C. It is kind for you to help me with English.
    - D. It is kind of you to help me with English.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is kind of you to help me with English.
  - **Q6(g-3396-q6)** It is no use _____ over spilt milk.
    - A. to crying
    - B. cry
    - C. to cry
    - D. crying
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 crying。句意:事后后悔是没有用的。

## 第 397 课 · g-3397:Formal object it · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。
- 要点:
  - find it + adjective + to do
  - think it + noun + to do
  - make it + adjective + that
  - it refers to the real object placed later
  - common verbs: find, think, make, consider
- 例句:
  - I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - 译:我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。
  - She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - 译:她认为列清单是个好习惯。
  - We make it a rule to clean the room on Saturday.
    - 译:我们规定星期六打扫房间。
  - Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - 译:你认为值得再试一次吗?
  - The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - 译:噪音让人难以入睡。
  - I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
    - 译:我相信一周内完成是可能的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3397-q1)** 「我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I find that helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - B. I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - C. I find it helpful read aloud every morning.
    - D. I find it's helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
  - **Q2(g-3397-q2)** She thinks _____ to make lists.
    - A. it a good habit
    - B. it good habit
    - C. that a good habit
    - D. it's a good habit
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it a good habit。句意:她认为列清单是个好习惯。
  - **Q3(g-3397-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We make that a rule to clean the room on Saturday.
    - B. We make it a rule to clean the room on Saturday.
    - C. We make it rule to clean the room on Saturday.
    - D. We make it's a rule to clean the room on Saturday.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:We make it a rule to clean the room on Saturday.
  - **Q4(g-3397-q4)** 「你认为值得再试一次吗?」的正确英文是?
    - A. Do you consider that worth trying again?
    - B. Do you consider it worth to try again?
    - C. Do you consider it's worth trying again?
    - D. Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:Do you consider it worth trying again?
  - **Q5(g-3397-q5)** The noise made _____ fall asleep.
    - A. it's hard to
    - B. that hard to
    - C. it hard
    - D. it hard to
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it hard to。句意:噪音让人难以入睡。
  - **Q6(g-3397-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I believe that possible to finish it in a week.
    - B. I believe it possible finish it in a week.
    - C. I believe it's possible to finish it in a week.
    - D. I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:I believe it possible to finish it in a week.

## 第 398 课 · g-3398:with compound structures · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。
- 要点:
  - with + noun + adjective: with the door open
  - with + noun + V-ing: active ongoing
  - with + noun + past participle: passive or completed
  - with + noun + prepositional phrase
  - independent of the sentence's subject
- 例句:
  - He slept with the window open.
    - 译:他开着窗户睡觉。
  - With the sun rising, the city became bright.
    - 译:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。
  - She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - 译:她闭着眼睛站在那里。
  - With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,我们出去玩了。
  - The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
    - 译:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。
  - He left with the lights on.
    - 译:他没关灯就走了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3398-q1)** He slept with the window _____.
    - A. opening
    - B. opens
    - C. open
    - D. opened
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 open。句意:他开着窗户睡觉。
  - **Q2(g-3398-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. With the sun rising, the city became bright.
    - B. With the sun risen, the city became bright.
    - C. With the sun rises, the city became bright.
    - D. With the sun rose, the city became bright.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:With the sun rising, the city became bright.
  - **Q3(g-3398-q3)** 「她闭着眼睛站在那里。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She stood there with her eyes closes.
    - B. She stood there with her eyes closing.
    - C. She stood there with her eyes close.
    - D. She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:She stood there with her eyes closed.
  - **Q4(g-3398-q4)** With the homework _____, we went out to play.
    - A. doing
    - B. done
    - C. did
    - D. do
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 done。句意:做完作业后,我们出去玩了。
  - **Q5(g-3398-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
    - B. The girl which has a book in her hand is my sister.
    - C. The girl of a book in her hand is my sister.
    - D. The girl has a book in her hand is my sister.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
  - **Q6(g-3398-q6)** 「他没关灯就走了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He left with the lights opened.
    - B. He left with the lights open.
    - C. He left with the lights on.
    - D. He left with the lights opening.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He left with the lights on.

## 第 399 课 · g-3399:Absolute constructions · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。
- 要点:
  - the logical subject differs from the main clause subject
  - noun + past participle: the work finished, ...
  - noun + adjective: the floor wet, ...
  - with the absolute can be preceded by with
  - generally not used in spoken language, common in written expression
- 例句:
  - The work finished, we went home happily.
    - 译:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。
  - The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - 译:太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。
  - Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 译:天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。
  - Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
    - 译:她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。
  - All things considered, it was a good plan.
    - 译:通盘考虑,这是个好计划。
  - There being no bus, we had to walk home.
    - 译:没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3399-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The work finish, we went home happily.
    - B. The work finishing, we went home happily.
    - C. The work was finished, we went home happily.
    - D. The work finished, we went home happily.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:The work finished, we went home happily.
  - **Q2(g-3399-q2)** 「太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - B. The sun has set, we walked back in the dark.
    - C. The sun set, we walked back in the dark.
    - D. The sun setting, we walked back in the dark.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
  - **Q3(g-3399-q3)** Weather _____, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - A. to permit
    - B. permits
    - C. permitted
    - D. permitting
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 permitting。句意:天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。
  - **Q4(g-3399-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Her voice trembled, she told us the news.
    - B. Her voice trembles, she told us the news.
    - C. Her voice to tremble, she told us the news.
    - D. Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
  - **Q5(g-3399-q5)** 「通盘考虑,这是个好计划。」的正确英文是?
    - A. All things considered, it was a good plan.
    - B. All things considers, it was a good plan.
    - C. All things considering, it was a good plan.
    - D. All things consider, it was a good plan.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:All things considered, it was a good plan.
  - **Q6(g-3399-q6)** There _____ no bus, we had to walk home.
    - A. was
    - B. been
    - C. is
    - D. being
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 being。句意:没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。

## 第 400 课 · g-3400:Non-restrictive relative clauses · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Non-restrictive relative clauses add supplementary explanation; a comma is essential, that is forbidden.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。
- 要点:
  - a comma separates the main clause from the clause
  - that cannot introduce a non-restrictive clause
  - who guides a person, which guides a thing
  - which can refer to the whole previous sentence
  - the clause can be omitted without affecting the main meaning
- 例句:
  - My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
    - 译:我父亲现在六十岁了,仍然努力工作。
  - The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
    - 译:我上周买的这本书非常有用。
  - He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
    - 译:他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。
  - Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - 译:北京是中国的首都,历史悠久。
  - Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
    - 译:教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。
  - The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - 译:为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3400-q1)** 「我父亲现在六十岁了,仍然努力工作。」的正确英文是?
    - A. My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
    - B. My father, that is sixty now, still works hard.
    - C. My father, whom he is sixty now, still works hard.
    - D. My father, which is sixty now, still works hard.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
  - **Q2(g-3400-q2)** The book, _____ I bought last week, is very useful.
    - A. that
    - B. what
    - C. who
    - D. which
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 which。句意:我上周买的这本书非常有用。
  - **Q3(g-3400-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He passed the exam, that made his parents happy.
    - B. He passed the exam, it made his parents happy.
    - C. He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
    - D. He passed the exam, what made his parents happy.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
  - **Q4(g-3400-q4)** 「北京是中国的首都,历史悠久。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Beijing, that is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - B. Beijing, who is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - C. Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - D. Beijing, what is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
  - **Q5(g-3400-q5)** Miss Li, _____ teaches us English, is very patient.
    - A. whom
    - B. who
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 who。句意:教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。
  - **Q6(g-3400-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The summer camp, what lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - B. The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - C. The summer camp, who lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - D. The summer camp, that lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.

## 第 401 课 · g-3401:Preposition + which / whom · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。
- 要点:
  - the preposition + which guides a thing
  - the preposition + whom guides a person
  - the preposition is determined by the collocation in the clause: live in → in which
  - in non-restrictive clauses that cannot take a preposition
  - the fixed collocation's preposition cannot be fronted
- 例句:
  - This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
    - 译:这就是我住了十年的房子。
  - The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
    - 译:和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。
  - Do you remember the day on which we first met?
    - 译:你记得我们初次见面的那天吗?
  - The way in which you study matters a lot.
    - 译:你学习的方式非常重要。
  - He is the man from whom I learned the news.
    - 译:我就是从他那里得知这个消息的。
  - The school for which I worked is very famous.
    - 译:我工作过的那所学校很有名。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3401-q1)** This is the house _____ I lived for ten years.
    - A. where in
    - B. that
    - C. which
    - D. in which
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 in which。句意:这就是我住了十年的房子。
  - **Q2(g-3401-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The friend that I traveled is a nurse.
    - B. The friend whom who I traveled is a nurse.
    - C. The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
    - D. The friend who I traveled is a nurse.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
  - **Q3(g-3401-q3)** 「你记得我们初次见面的那天吗?」的正确英文是?
    - A. Do you remember the day that we first met?
    - B. Do you remember the day which we first met?
    - C. Do you remember the day on which we first met?
    - D. Do you remember the day when on we first met?
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:Do you remember the day on which we first met?
  - **Q4(g-3401-q4)** The way _____ you study matters a lot.
    - A. that in
    - B. in which
    - C. how
    - D. which
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 in which。句意:你学习的方式非常重要。
  - **Q5(g-3401-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He is the man from whom I learned the news.
    - B. He is the man that I learned the news.
    - C. He is the man whom from I learned the news.
    - D. He is the man who I learned the news.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:He is the man from whom I learned the news.
  - **Q6(g-3401-q6)** 「我工作过的那所学校很有名。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The school that I worked is very famous.
    - B. The school why I worked is very famous.
    - C. The school which I worked is very famous.
    - D. The school for which I worked is very famous.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:The school for which I worked is very famous.

## 第 402 课 · g-3402:whose relative clauses · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。
- 要点:
  - whose + noun = the person/thing's
  - whose can guide both people and things
  - of whom / of which can replace whose
  - the noun after whose is not omitted
  - who and whose must not be confused
- 例句:
  - The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
    - 译:那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。
  - I live in a house whose windows face south.
    - 译:我住在一栋窗户朝南的房子里。
  - The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - 译:包被偷的那个女孩伤心地哭了。
  - He is the writer whose books sell well.
    - 译:他就是那位书卖得很好的作家。
  - We helped the family whose house had burned down.
    - 译:我们帮助了那个房子被烧毁的家庭。
  - The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - 译:那棵叶子变黄的树很老了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3402-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The boy who's father is a doctor is my friend.
    - B. The boy which father is a doctor is my friend.
    - C. The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
    - D. The boy who father is a doctor is my friend.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
  - **Q2(g-3402-q2)** 「我住在一栋窗户朝南的房子里。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I live in a house that windows face south.
    - B. I live in a house who's windows face south.
    - C. I live in a house which windows face south.
    - D. I live in a house whose windows face south.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:I live in a house whose windows face south.
  - **Q3(g-3402-q3)** The girl _____ bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - A. whose
    - B. which
    - C. who's
    - D. whom
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:包被偷的那个女孩伤心地哭了。
  - **Q4(g-3402-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He is the writer whose books sell well.
    - B. He is the writer who's books sell well.
    - C. He is the writer which books sell well.
    - D. He is the writer who books sell well.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:He is the writer whose books sell well.
  - **Q5(g-3402-q5)** 「我们帮助了那个房子被烧毁的家庭。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We helped the family whom house had burned down.
    - B. We helped the family who's house had burned down.
    - C. We helped the family which house had burned down.
    - D. We helped the family whose house had burned down.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:We helped the family whose house had burned down.
  - **Q6(g-3402-q6)** The tree _____ leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - A. which
    - B. who's
    - C. that
    - D. whose
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:那棵叶子变黄的树很老了。

## 第 403 课 · g-3403:Noun clauses with what · 易错辨析(第2轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:What guides a noun clause and itself serves as a subject or object inside the clause, meaning 'what/who'.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。
- 要点:
  - What he said is true.
  - what cannot be replaced by that
  - the clause uses statement word order
  - what guides the subject/predicative/object clause
  - No one knows what will happen.
- 例句:
  - What he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - 译:他在会上说的话让我们很吃惊。
  - This is what I want to tell you.
    - 译:这就是我想告诉你的。
  - We should do what we think is right.
    - 译:我们应该做自己认为对的事。
  - What matters most is practice.
    - 译:最重要的是练习。
  - I don't know what the word means.
    - 译:我不知道这个词的意思。
  - Show me what you bought in Chengdu.
    - 译:给我看看你在成都买的东西。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3403-q1)** 「他在会上说的话让我们很吃惊。」的正确英文是?
    - A. That he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - B. What did he say at the meeting surprised us.
    - C. What he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - D. Which he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:What he said at the meeting surprised us.
  - **Q2(g-3403-q2)** This is _____ I want to tell you.
    - A. it
    - B. what
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。此处应为 what。句意:这就是我想告诉你的。
  - **Q3(g-3403-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We should do which we think is right.
    - B. We should do what we think is right.
    - C. We should do that we think is right.
    - D. We should do it we think is right.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:We should do what we think is right.
  - **Q4(g-3403-q4)** 「最重要的是练习。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Which matters most is practice.
    - B. That matters most is practice.
    - C. What matters most is practice.
    - D. It matters most is practice.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:What matters most is practice.
  - **Q5(g-3403-q5)** I don't know _____ the word means.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. how
    - D. what
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。此处应为 what。句意:我不知道这个词的意思。
  - **Q6(g-3403-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Show me that you bought in Chengdu.
    - B. Show me what you bought in Chengdu.
    - C. Show me which you bought in Chengdu.
    - D. Show me them you bought in Chengdu.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:Show me what you bought in Chengdu.
