    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
  - **Q6(g-3587-q6)** 「如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I had saved money then, I can buy it today.
    - B. If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
    - C. If I had saved money then, I had bought it today.
    - D. If I had saved money then, I could have bought it today.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.

## 第 588 课 · g-3588:Inversion with fronted negative words · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
  - Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
  - Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
  - Little did he know the truth.
  - the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary
- 例句:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - 译:我从未见过这么美的日落。
  - Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
    - 译:我们刚出发就开始下雨了。
  - Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - 译:他不仅工作努力,还很善良。
  - Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - 译:她一点也不知道答案是错的。
  - Not once has he been late this year.
    - 译:今年他一次也没迟到过。
  - Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - 译:我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3588-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - B. Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - C. Never I saw such a beautiful sunset.
    - D. Never did I saw such a beautiful sunset.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
  - **Q2(g-3588-q2)** 「我们刚出发就开始下雨了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
    - B. Hardly did we start when it began to rain.
    - C. Hardly we started when it began to rain.
    - D. Hardly we had started when it began to rain.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
  - **Q3(g-3588-q3)** Not only _____ hard, but he is also kind.
    - A. does he work
    - B. he works
    - C. works he
    - D. he does work
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 does he work。句意:他不仅工作努力,还很善良。
  - **Q4(g-3588-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Little she knew that the answer was wrong.
    - B. Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - C. Little knew she that the answer was wrong.
    - D. Little she did know that the answer was wrong.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
  - **Q5(g-3588-q5)** 「今年他一次也没迟到过。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Not once did he was late this year.
    - B. Not once he has been late this year.
    - C. Not once has he been late this year.
    - D. Not once he was late this year.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not once has he been late this year.
  - **Q6(g-3588-q6)** Seldom _____ such old buildings now.
    - A. see we
    - B. we do see
    - C. do we see
    - D. we see
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 do we see。句意:我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。

## 第 589 课 · g-3589:only + adverbial inversion · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Only then did I understand.
  - Only in this way can we solve it.
  - Only when the rain stopped did we go out.
  - only modifying the subject does not invert: Only Tom knows.
  - the inversion occurs in the clause after only
- 例句:
  - Only then did I understand his words.
    - 译:直到那时我才明白他的话。
  - Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - 译:只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。
  - Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - 译:直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。
  - Only at night does the city become quiet.
    - 译:只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。
  - Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - 译:直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。
  - Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - 译:只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3589-q1)** 「直到那时我才明白他的话。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only then did I understand his words.
    - B. Only then understood I his words.
    - C. Only then I understood his words.
    - D. Only then I did understand his words.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only then did I understand his words.
  - **Q2(g-3589-q2)** Only in this way _____ the work on time.
    - A. we can finish
    - B. we finish can
    - C. can we finish
    - D. finish we can
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 can we finish。句意:只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。
  - **Q3(g-3589-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - B. Only when the teacher came they did stop talking.
    - C. Only when the teacher came stopped they talking.
    - D. Only when the teacher came they stopped talking.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
  - **Q4(g-3589-q4)** 「只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only at night becomes the city quiet.
    - B. Only at night the city does become quiet.
    - C. Only at night does the city become quiet.
    - D. Only at night the city becomes quiet.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only at night does the city become quiet.
  - **Q5(g-3589-q5)** Only after the meeting _____ me.
    - A. did he call
    - B. he called
    - C. he did call
    - D. called he
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did he call。句意:直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。
  - **Q6(g-3589-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only with your help pass I can the exam.
    - B. Only with your help I pass can the exam.
    - C. Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - D. Only with your help I can pass the exam.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only with your help can I pass the exam.

## 第 590 课 · g-3590:so / neither partial inversion · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
- 要点:
  - So do I = I do too
  - Neither do I = I don't either
  - the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
  - So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
  - the tense agrees with the previous sentence
- 例句:
  - I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - 译:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。
  - He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - 译:他不会开车,我也不会。
  - They went to the museum, and so did we.
    - 译:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。
  - I have never been to Toronto, and neither has he.
    - 译:我没去过多伦多,他也没去过。
  - She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - 译:她是护士,我也是。
  - You won't give up, and neither shall we.
    - 译:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3590-q1)** I like traveling, and _____ my sister.
    - A. does so
    - B. so do
    - C. so is
    - D. so does
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so does。句意:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。
  - **Q2(g-3590-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He can't drive, and neither can't I.
    - B. He can't drive, and can neither I.
    - C. He can't drive, and neither do I.
    - D. He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:He can't drive, and neither can I.
  - **Q3(g-3590-q3)** 「他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. They went to the museum, and so did we.
    - B. They went to the museum, and did so we.
    - C. They went to the museum, and so do we.
    - D. They went to the museum, and so were we.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:They went to the museum, and so did we.
  - **Q4(g-3590-q4)** I have never been to Toronto, and _____ he.
    - A. neither haven't
    - B. neither has
    - C. has neither
    - D. neither does
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither has。句意:我没去过多伦多,他也没去过。
  - **Q5(g-3590-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She is a nurse, and am so I.
    - B. She is a nurse, and so do I.
    - C. She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - D. She is a nurse, and so is I.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:She is a nurse, and so am I.
  - **Q6(g-3590-q6)** 「你们不会放弃,我们也不会。」的正确英文是?
    - A. You won't give up, and neither do we.
    - B. You won't give up, and shall neither we.
    - C. You won't give up, and neither will not we.
    - D. You won't give up, and neither shall we.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:You won't give up, and neither shall we.

## 第 591 课 · g-3591:Cleft sentences It is...that · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
- 要点:
  - emphasizing a person: It is...who...
  - emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
  - not the predicate can be emphasized
  - the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
  - distinguished from the formal subject It is...that
- 例句:
  - It was Tom who broke the window.
    - 译:是汤姆打破了窗户。
  - It is English that we practice every morning.
    - 译:我们每天早上练的是英语。
  - It was in January that they first met.
    - 译:他们是在一月初次见面的。
  - It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - 译:每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。
  - It was at the station that I lost my bag.
    - 译:我是在车站丢的包。
  - It is hard work that leads to success.
    - 译:是努力通向成功。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3591-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It was Tom whom broke the window.
    - B. It was Tom that whom broke the window.
    - C. It was Tom which broke the window.
    - D. It was Tom who broke the window.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was Tom who broke the window.
  - **Q2(g-3591-q2)** 「我们每天早上练的是英语。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is English that we practice every morning.
    - B. It is English what we practice every morning.
    - C. It is English which we practice every morning.
    - D. It is English who we practice every morning.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is English that we practice every morning.
  - **Q3(g-3591-q3)** It was in January _____ they first met.
    - A. what
    - B. when
    - C. that
    - D. which
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:他们是在一月初次见面的。
  - **Q4(g-3591-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is my mother whom cooks for us every day.
    - B. It is my mother which cooks for us every day.
    - C. It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - D. It is my mother whose cooks for us every day.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
  - **Q5(g-3591-q5)** 「我是在车站丢的包。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It was at the station when I lost my bag.
    - B. It was at the station which I lost my bag.
    - C. It was at the station where I lost my bag.
    - D. It was at the station that I lost my bag.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was at the station that I lost my bag.
  - **Q6(g-3591-q6)** It is hard work _____ leads to success.
    - A. who
    - B. what
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:是努力通向成功。

## 第 592 课 · g-3592:Formal subject it · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
- 要点:
  - It is important to learn English.
  - It takes time to master a skill.
  - It is said that... reportedly
  - It is + adjective + for sb to do
  - It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)
- 例句:
  - It is important to keep a diary in English.
    - 译:用英语写日记很重要。
  - It takes about an hour to get to the gym.
    - 译:到健身房大约需要一个小时。
  - It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - 译:据说这座桥历史悠久。
  - It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
    - 译:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。
  - It is kind of you to help me with science.
    - 译:你帮我学科学,真是太好了。
  - It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - 译:事后后悔是没有用的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3592-q1)** 「用英语写日记很重要。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is important keep a diary in English.
    - B. It is important keeping a diary in English.
    - C. It is important to keep a diary in English.
    - D. It is important to keeping a diary in English.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is important to keep a diary in English.
  - **Q2(g-3592-q2)** It takes about an hour _____ to the gym.
    - A. to get
    - B. get
    - C. to getting
    - D. getting
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 to get。句意:到健身房大约需要一个小时。
  - **Q3(g-3592-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. That is said the bridge has a long history.
    - B. It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - C. It says that the bridge has a long history.
    - D. It is say that the bridge has a long history.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is said that the bridge has a long history.
  - **Q4(g-3592-q4)** 「我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is necessary for us taking notes in class.
    - B. It is necessary of us to take notes in class.
    - C. It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
    - D. It is necessary us to take notes in class.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
  - **Q5(g-3592-q5)** It is kind _____ me with science.
    - A. for you to help
    - B. you to help
    - C. of you helping
    - D. of you to help
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 of you to help。句意:你帮我学科学,真是太好了。
  - **Q6(g-3592-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is no use cry over spilt milk.
    - B. It is no use to crying over spilt milk.
    - C. It is no use to cry over spilt milk.
    - D. It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is no use crying over spilt milk.

## 第 593 课 · g-3593:Formal object it · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。
- 要点:
  - find it + adjective + to do
  - think it + noun + to do
  - make it + adjective + that
  - it refers to the real object placed later
  - common verbs: find, think, make, consider
- 例句:
  - I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - 译:我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。
  - She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - 译:她认为列清单是个好习惯。
  - We make it a rule to clean the room on Friday.
    - 译:我们规定星期五打扫房间。
  - Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - 译:你认为值得再试一次吗?
  - The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - 译:噪音让人难以入睡。
  - I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
    - 译:我相信一周内完成是可能的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3593-q1)** I find _____ read aloud every morning.
    - A. it's helpful to
    - B. it helpful to
    - C. it helpful
    - D. that helpful to
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it helpful to。句意:我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。
  - **Q2(g-3593-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She thinks it's a good habit to make lists.
    - B. She thinks that a good habit to make lists.
    - C. She thinks it good habit to make lists.
    - D. She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
  - **Q3(g-3593-q3)** 「我们规定星期五打扫房间。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We make it rule to clean the room on Friday.
    - B. We make it's a rule to clean the room on Friday.
    - C. We make it a rule to clean the room on Friday.
    - D. We make that a rule to clean the room on Friday.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:We make it a rule to clean the room on Friday.
  - **Q4(g-3593-q4)** Do you consider _____ again?
    - A. that worth trying
    - B. it worth trying
    - C. it's worth trying
    - D. it worth to try
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it worth trying。句意:你认为值得再试一次吗?
  - **Q5(g-3593-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The noise made that hard to fall asleep.
    - B. The noise made it's hard to fall asleep.
    - C. The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - D. The noise made it hard fall asleep.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
  - **Q6(g-3593-q6)** 「我相信一周内完成是可能的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I believe it possible finish it in a week.
    - B. I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
    - C. I believe that possible to finish it in a week.
    - D. I believe it's possible to finish it in a week.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:I believe it possible to finish it in a week.

## 第 594 课 · g-3594:with compound structures · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。
- 要点:
  - with + noun + adjective: with the door open
  - with + noun + V-ing: active ongoing
  - with + noun + past participle: passive or completed
  - with + noun + prepositional phrase
  - independent of the sentence's subject
- 例句:
  - He slept with the window open.
    - 译:他开着窗户睡觉。
  - With the sun rising, the city became bright.
    - 译:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。
  - She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - 译:她闭着眼睛站在那里。
  - With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,我们出去玩了。
  - The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
    - 译:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。
  - He left with the lights on.
    - 译:他没关灯就走了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3594-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He slept with the window opens.
    - B. He slept with the window opening.
    - C. He slept with the window opened.
    - D. He slept with the window open.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He slept with the window open.
  - **Q2(g-3594-q2)** 「太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。」的正确英文是?
    - A. With the sun risen, the city became bright.
    - B. With the sun rises, the city became bright.
    - C. With the sun rose, the city became bright.
    - D. With the sun rising, the city became bright.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:With the sun rising, the city became bright.
  - **Q3(g-3594-q3)** She stood there with her eyes _____.
    - A. closes
    - B. closed
    - C. closing
    - D. close
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 closed。句意:她闭着眼睛站在那里。
  - **Q4(g-3594-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. With the homework doing, we went out to play.
    - B. With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - C. With the homework did, we went out to play.
    - D. With the homework do, we went out to play.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:With the homework done, we went out to play.
  - **Q5(g-3594-q5)** 「手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The girl has a book in her hand is my sister.
    - B. The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
    - C. The girl of a book in her hand is my sister.
    - D. The girl which has a book in her hand is my sister.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
  - **Q6(g-3594-q6)** He left with the lights _____.
    - A. open
    - B. opened
    - C. opening
    - D. on
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 on。句意:他没关灯就走了。

## 第 595 课 · g-3595:Absolute constructions · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。
- 要点:
  - the logical subject differs from the main clause subject
  - noun + past participle: the work finished, ...
  - noun + adjective: the floor wet, ...
  - with the absolute can be preceded by with
  - generally not used in spoken language, common in written expression
- 例句:
  - The work finished, we went home happily.
    - 译:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。
  - The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - 译:太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。
  - Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 译:天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。
  - Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
    - 译:她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。
  - All things considered, it was a good plan.
    - 译:通盘考虑,这是个好计划。
  - There being no bus, we had to walk home.
    - 译:没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3595-q1)** 「工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The work finished, we went home happily.
    - B. The work finish, we went home happily.
    - C. The work finishing, we went home happily.
    - D. The work was finished, we went home happily.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:The work finished, we went home happily.
  - **Q2(g-3595-q2)** The sun _____, we walked back in the dark.
    - A. having set
    - B. set
    - C. has set
    - D. setting
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 having set。句意:太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。
  - **Q3(g-3595-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Weather permitted, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - B. Weather permits, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - C. Weather to permit, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - D. Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
  - **Q4(g-3595-q4)** 「她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
    - B. Her voice to tremble, she told us the news.
    - C. Her voice trembled, she told us the news.
    - D. Her voice trembles, she told us the news.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
  - **Q5(g-3595-q5)** All things _____, it was a good plan.
    - A. considered
    - B. considers
    - C. considering
    - D. consider
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 considered。句意:通盘考虑,这是个好计划。
  - **Q6(g-3595-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. There been no bus, we had to walk home.
    - B. There is no bus, we had to walk home.
    - C. There being no bus, we had to walk home.
    - D. There was no bus, we had to walk home.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:There being no bus, we had to walk home.

## 第 596 课 · g-3596:Non-restrictive relative clauses · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Non-restrictive relative clauses add supplementary explanation; a comma is essential, that is forbidden.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。
- 要点:
  - a comma separates the main clause from the clause
  - that cannot introduce a non-restrictive clause
  - who guides a person, which guides a thing
  - which can refer to the whole previous sentence
  - the clause can be omitted without affecting the main meaning
- 例句:
  - My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
    - 译:我父亲现在六十岁了,仍然努力工作。
  - The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
    - 译:我上周买的这本书非常有用。
  - He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
    - 译:他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。
  - Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - 译:北京是中国的首都,历史悠久。
  - Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
    - 译:教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。
  - The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - 译:为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3596-q1)** My father, _____ is sixty now, still works hard.
    - A. whom he
    - B. that
    - C. which
    - D. who
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 who。句意:我父亲现在六十岁了,仍然努力工作。
  - **Q2(g-3596-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The book, that I bought last week, is very useful.
    - B. The book, what I bought last week, is very useful.
    - C. The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
    - D. The book, who I bought last week, is very useful.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
  - **Q3(g-3596-q3)** 「他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
    - B. He passed the exam, that made his parents happy.
    - C. He passed the exam, it made his parents happy.
    - D. He passed the exam, what made his parents happy.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
  - **Q4(g-3596-q4)** Beijing, _____ is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - A. who
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. which
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 which。句意:北京是中国的首都,历史悠久。
  - **Q5(g-3596-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Miss Li, whom teaches us English, is very patient.
    - B. Miss Li, which teaches us English, is very patient.
    - C. Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
    - D. Miss Li, that teaches us English, is very patient.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
  - **Q6(g-3596-q6)** 「为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The summer camp, what lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - B. The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - C. The summer camp, who lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - D. The summer camp, that lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.

## 第 597 课 · g-3597:Preposition + which / whom · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。
- 要点:
  - the preposition + which guides a thing
  - the preposition + whom guides a person
  - the preposition is determined by the collocation in the clause: live in → in which
  - in non-restrictive clauses that cannot take a preposition
  - the fixed collocation's preposition cannot be fronted
- 例句:
  - This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
    - 译:这就是我住了十年的房子。
  - The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
    - 译:和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。
  - Do you remember the day on which we first met?
    - 译:你记得我们初次见面的那天吗?
  - The way in which you study matters a lot.
    - 译:你学习的方式非常重要。
  - He is the man from whom I learned the news.
    - 译:我就是从他那里得知这个消息的。
  - The school for which I worked is very famous.
    - 译:我工作过的那所学校很有名。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3597-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. This is the house which I lived for ten years.
    - B. This is the house that I lived for ten years.
    - C. This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
    - D. This is the house where in I lived for ten years.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
  - **Q2(g-3597-q2)** 「和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The friend that I traveled is a nurse.
    - B. The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
    - C. The friend who I traveled is a nurse.
    - D. The friend whom who I traveled is a nurse.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
  - **Q3(g-3597-q3)** Do you remember the day _____ we first met?
    - A. when on
    - B. on which
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 on which。句意:你记得我们初次见面的那天吗?
  - **Q4(g-3597-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The way which you study matters a lot.
    - B. The way that in you study matters a lot.
    - C. The way in which you study matters a lot.
    - D. The way how you study matters a lot.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:The way in which you study matters a lot.
  - **Q5(g-3597-q5)** 「我就是从他那里得知这个消息的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He is the man that I learned the news.
    - B. He is the man who I learned the news.
    - C. He is the man whom from I learned the news.
    - D. He is the man from whom I learned the news.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:He is the man from whom I learned the news.
  - **Q6(g-3597-q6)** The school _____ I worked is very famous.
    - A. for which
    - B. that
    - C. why
    - D. which
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 for which。句意:我工作过的那所学校很有名。

## 第 598 课 · g-3598:whose relative clauses · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。
- 要点:
  - whose + noun = the person/thing's
  - whose can guide both people and things
  - of whom / of which can replace whose
  - the noun after whose is not omitted
  - who and whose must not be confused
- 例句:
  - The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
    - 译:那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。
  - I live in a house whose windows face south.
    - 译:我住在一栋窗户朝南的房子里。
  - The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - 译:包被偷的那个女孩伤心地哭了。
  - He is the writer whose books sell well.
    - 译:他就是那位书卖得很好的作家。
  - We helped the family whose house had burned down.
    - 译:我们帮助了那个房子被烧毁的家庭。
  - The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - 译:那棵叶子变黄的树很老了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3598-q1)** 「那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The boy who's father is a doctor is my friend.
    - B. The boy who father is a doctor is my friend.
    - C. The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
    - D. The boy which father is a doctor is my friend.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
  - **Q2(g-3598-q2)** I live in a house _____ windows face south.
    - A. whose
    - B. who's
    - C. which
    - D. that
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:我住在一栋窗户朝南的房子里。
  - **Q3(g-3598-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The girl whom bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - B. The girl who's bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - C. The girl which bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - D. The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
  - **Q4(g-3598-q4)** 「他就是那位书卖得很好的作家。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He is the writer who's books sell well.
    - B. He is the writer which books sell well.
    - C. He is the writer whose books sell well.
    - D. He is the writer who books sell well.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:He is the writer whose books sell well.
  - **Q5(g-3598-q5)** We helped the family _____ house had burned down.
    - A. which
    - B. whose
    - C. who's
    - D. whom
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:我们帮助了那个房子被烧毁的家庭。
  - **Q6(g-3598-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The tree which leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - B. The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - C. The tree who's leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - D. The tree that leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.

## 第 599 课 · g-3599:Noun clauses with what · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:What guides a noun clause and itself serves as a subject or object inside the clause, meaning 'what/who'.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。
- 要点:
  - What he said is true.
  - what cannot be replaced by that
  - the clause uses statement word order
  - what guides the subject/predicative/object clause
  - No one knows what will happen.
- 例句:
  - What he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - 译:他在会上说的话让我们很吃惊。
  - This is what I want to tell you.
    - 译:这就是我想告诉你的。
  - We should do what we think is right.
    - 译:我们应该做自己认为对的事。
  - What matters most is practice.
    - 译:最重要的是练习。
  - I don't know what the word means.
    - 译:我不知道这个词的意思。
  - Show me what you bought in London.
    - 译:给我看看你在伦敦买的东西。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3599-q1)** _____ at the meeting surprised us.
    - A. Which he said
    - B. What he said
    - C. What did he say
    - D. That he said
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。此处应为 What he said。句意:他在会上说的话让我们很吃惊。
  - **Q2(g-3599-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. This is it I want to tell you.
    - B. This is what I want to tell you.
    - C. This is that I want to tell you.
    - D. This is which I want to tell you.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:This is what I want to tell you.
  - **Q3(g-3599-q3)** 「我们应该做自己认为对的事。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We should do it we think is right.
    - B. We should do what we think is right.
    - C. We should do that we think is right.
    - D. We should do which we think is right.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:We should do what we think is right.
  - **Q4(g-3599-q4)** _____ matters most is practice.
    - A. Which
    - B. What
    - C. It
    - D. That
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。此处应为 What。句意:最重要的是练习。
  - **Q5(g-3599-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I don't know which the word means.
    - B. I don't know how the word means.
    - C. I don't know that the word means.
    - D. I don't know what the word means.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:I don't know what the word means.
  - **Q6(g-3599-q6)** 「给我看看你在伦敦买的东西。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Show me what you bought in London.
    - B. Show me them you bought in London.
    - C. Show me which you bought in London.
    - D. Show me that you bought in London.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:Show me what you bought in London.

## 第 600 课 · g-3600:Subject clauses with whether · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Whether guides a subject clause at the start of a sentence; if is not used; the clause uses statement word order.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。
- 要点:
  - Whether he will come is still unknown.
  - when placed at the start, only whether, not if
  - after the preposition use whether
  - the infinitive after the preposition uses whether
  - whether or not is a fixed collocation
- 例句:
  - Whether we go depends on the weather.
    - 译:我们是否去取决于天气。
  - Whether it is true remains a question.
    - 译:它是否属实仍是个问题。
  - We are talking about whether to have the party.
    - 译:我们正在讨论是否举办聚会。
  - Whether you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - 译:不管你喜欢与否,都必须完成它。
  - It depends on whether the shop is open.
    - 译:这取决于商店是否开门。
  - Whether he can pass the exam is important.
    - 译:他能否通过考试很重要。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3600-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. What we go depends on the weather.
    - B. If we go depends on the weather.
    - C. That we go depends on the weather.
    - D. Whether we go depends on the weather.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:Whether we go depends on the weather.
  - **Q2(g-3600-q2)** 「它是否属实仍是个问题。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Whether it is true remains a question.
    - B. Which it is true remains a question.
    - C. That it is true remains a question.
    - D. If it is true remains a question.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:Whether it is true remains a question.
  - **Q3(g-3600-q3)** We are talking about _____ to have the party.
    - A. whether
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. if
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。此处应为 whether。句意:我们正在讨论是否举办聚会。
  - **Q4(g-3600-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - B. When you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - C. That you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - D. Whether you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:Whether you like it or not, you must finish it.
  - **Q5(g-3600-q5)** 「这取决于商店是否开门。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It depends on what the shop is open.
    - B. It depends on that the shop is open.
    - C. It depends on whether the shop is open.
    - D. It depends on if the shop is open.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:It depends on whether the shop is open.
  - **Q6(g-3600-q6)** _____ he can pass the exam is important.
    - A. Whether
    - B. If
    - C. How
    - D. That
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。此处应为 Whether。句意:他能否通过考试很重要。

## 第 601 课 · g-3601:Subject clauses with that · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A that-clause as subject is usually replaced by the formal subject it: It is clear that...本课为要点精讲练习,核心:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。
- 要点:
  - That he came late made the teacher angry.
  - more often placed later with the formal subject it
  - that cannot be omitted
  - the clause uses statement word order
  - distinguished from the appositive clause: that explains the noun
- 例句:
  - That she passed the exam is good news.
    - 译:她通过了考试是个好消息。
  - It is clear that he is telling the truth.
    - 译:很明显他说的是实话。
  - That practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - 译:熟能生巧是一句谚语。
  - It is a pity that you can't join us.
    - 译:真遗憾你不能加入我们。
  - That the earth is round is a fact.
    - 译:地球是圆的是事实。
  - It is reported that the rain will stop soon.
    - 译:据报道雨很快会停。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3601-q1)** 「她通过了考试是个好消息。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Which she passed the exam is good news.
    - B. What she passed the exam is good news.
    - C. That she passed the exam is good news.
    - D. Whether she passed the exam is good news.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:That she passed the exam is good news.
  - **Q2(g-3601-q2)** It is clear _____ he is telling the truth.
    - A. that
    - B. which
    - C. if
    - D. what
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。此处应为 that。句意:很明显他说的是实话。
  - **Q3(g-3601-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Whether practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - B. As practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - C. That practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - D. What practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:That practice makes perfect is a proverb.
  - **Q4(g-3601-q4)** 「真遗憾你不能加入我们。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is a pity what you can't join us.
    - B. It is a pity that you can't join us.
    - C. It is a pity which you can't join us.
    - D. It is a pity if you can't join us.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:It is a pity that you can't join us.
  - **Q5(g-3601-q5)** _____ the earth is round is a fact.
    - A. That
    - B. Which
    - C. What
    - D. Whether
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。此处应为 That。句意:地球是圆的是事实。
  - **Q6(g-3601-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is reported whether the rain will stop soon.
    - B. It is reported what the rain will stop soon.
    - C. It is reported that the rain will stop soon.
    - D. It is reported which the rain will stop soon.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:It is reported that the rain will stop soon.

## 第 602 课 · g-3602:Present participles as adverbials · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A present participle phrase as adverbial; its logical subject must agree with the sentence's subject.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。
- 要点:
  - Hearing the news, she smiled.
  - expresses accompanying state: sitting there, ...
  - having done expresses a completed action
  - the negative is not doing
  - a dangling participle occurs when the logical subject is inconsistent
- 例句:
  - Hearing the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - 译:听到这个好消息,我们都高兴得跳了起来。
  - Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
    - 译:沿着街走时,我遇到了一位老朋友。
  - Having finished the homework, he went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,他出去玩了。
  - The children ran out of the classroom, talking and laughing.
    - 译:孩子们说着笑着跑出了教室。
  - Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
    - 译:因为不认识路,他问了警察。
  - Sitting by the window, she watched the rain.
    - 译:她坐在窗边看着雨。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3602-q1)** _____ the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - A. To hear
    - B. Hear
    - C. Hearing
    - D. Heard
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。此处应为 Hearing。句意:听到这个好消息,我们都高兴得跳了起来。
  - **Q2(g-3602-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Walk along the street, I met an old friend.
    - B. Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
    - C. Walked along the street, I met an old friend.
    - D. To walk along the street, I met an old friend.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
  - **Q3(g-3602-q3)** 「做完作业后,他出去玩了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Have finished the homework, he went out to play.
    - B. Having finished the homework, he went out to play.
    - C. To finish the homework, he went out to play.
    - D. Finished the homework, he went out to play.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Having finished the homework, he went out to play.
  - **Q4(g-3602-q4)** The children ran out of the classroom, _____ and laughing.
    - A. talking
    - B. talked
    - C. talk
    - D. to talk
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。此处应为 talking。句意:孩子们说着笑着跑出了教室。
  - **Q5(g-3602-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
    - B. Didn't know the way, he asked a policeman.
    - C. Not know the way, he asked a policeman.
    - D. Not to know the way, he asked a policeman.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
  - **Q6(g-3602-q6)** 「她坐在窗边看着雨。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Sitting by the window, she watched the rain.
    - B. Sat by the window, she watched the rain.
    - C. Seat by the window, she watched the rain.
    - D. To sit by the window, she watched the rain.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。正确句:Sitting by the window, she watched the rain.

## 第 603 课 · g-3603:Past participles as adverbials · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A past participle phrase as adverbial, the logical subject passively receives the action.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。
- 要点:
  - Seen from the hill, the city looks small.
  - expressing a completed state
  - having been done emphasizes a completed passive
  - the negative is not done
  - the relation to the subject is passive
- 例句:
  - Seen from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - 译:从飞机上看,田野像方块。
  - Given more time, we could do it better.
    - 译:如果给我们更多时间,我们能做得更好。
  - Tired from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - 译:旅途劳累,她早早睡了。
  - Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - 译:这本书是用简单英语写的,容易读。
  - Not invited to the party, he stayed at home.
    - 译:由于没被邀请参加聚会,他待在家里。
  - Lost in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - 译:陷入沉思,他没听到铃声。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3603-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Seen from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - B. To see from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - C. Seeing from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - D. See from the plane, the fields look like squares.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Seen from the plane, the fields look like squares.
  - **Q2(g-3603-q2)** 「如果给我们更多时间,我们能做得更好。」的正确英文是?
    - A. To give more time, we could do it better.
    - B. Giving more time, we could do it better.
    - C. Given more time, we could do it better.
    - D. Give more time, we could do it better.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Given more time, we could do it better.
  - **Q3(g-3603-q3)** _____ from the trip, she went to bed early.
    - A. Tire
    - B. Tiring
    - C. Tired
    - D. To tire
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。此处应为 Tired。句意:旅途劳累,她早早睡了。
  - **Q4(g-3603-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - B. Wrote in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - C. To write in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - D. Writing in simple English, the book is easy to read.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
  - **Q5(g-3603-q5)** 「由于没被邀请参加聚会,他待在家里。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Not invited to the party, he stayed at home.
    - B. Not to invite to the party, he stayed at home.
    - C. Didn't invite to the party, he stayed at home.
    - D. Not inviting to the party, he stayed at home.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。正确句:Not invited to the party, he stayed at home.
  - **Q6(g-3603-q6)** _____ in thought, he didn't hear the bell.
    - A. Lose
    - B. To lose
    - C. Lost
    - D. Losing
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。此处应为 Lost。句意:陷入沉思,他没听到铃声。

## 第 604 课 · g-3604:Perfect infinitives · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The perfect infinitive expresses an action that happened before the predicate verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。
- 要点:
  - I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
  - seems/appears + to have done
  - would like to have done (an unrealized wish)
  - the passive of the perfect infinitive to have been done
  - it is the action order that is being examined
- 例句:
  - I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
    - 译:很抱歉让你等了这么久。
  - He seems to have forgotten my name.
    - 译:他似乎忘记了我的名字。
  - She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
    - 译:她是第一个登上这座山的人。
  - I would like to have joined your trip.
    - 译:我本想参加你们的旅行的。
  - The novel is said to have been translated into many languages.
    - 译:据说这部小说已被翻译成多种语言。
  - We are glad to have finished the work on time.
    - 译:我们很高兴按时完成了工作。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3604-q1)** 「很抱歉让你等了这么久。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I am sorry to keeping you waiting so long.
    - B. I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
    - C. I am sorry to keep you waiting so long.
    - D. I am sorry keeping you waiting so long.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
  - **Q2(g-3604-q2)** He seems _____ my name.
    - A. forgetting
    - B. to forget
    - C. to forgetting
    - D. to have forgotten
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。此处应为 to have forgotten。句意:他似乎忘记了我的名字。
  - **Q3(g-3604-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
    - B. She was the first to climb the mountain.
    - C. She was the first climb the mountain.
    - D. She was the first climbing the mountain.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
  - **Q4(g-3604-q4)** 「我本想参加你们的旅行的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I would like to have joined your trip.
    - B. I would like joining your trip.
    - C. I would like to join your trip.
    - D. I would like join your trip.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:I would like to have joined your trip.
  - **Q5(g-3604-q5)** The novel is said _____ into many languages.
    - A. to translate
    - B. to have been translated
    - C. translated to
    - D. to be translating
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。此处应为 to have been translated。句意:据说这部小说已被翻译成多种语言。
  - **Q6(g-3604-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We are glad to finish the work on time.
    - B. We are glad to have finished the work on time.
    - C. We are glad to finishing the work on time.
    - D. We are glad finishing the work on time.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:We are glad to have finished the work on time.

## 第 605 课 · g-3605:as concession inversion · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The as-concession inversion: Young as he is, he knows a lot.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。
- 要点:
  - adjective + as + subject + verb
  - the noun is singular and takes no article: Child as he is, ...
  - the adverb can also be fronted
  - equivalent to although
  - though can replace as in this structure, but not although
- 例句:
  - Young as he is, he knows a lot.
    - 译:他虽然年轻,但懂得很多。
  - Tired as she was, she kept working.
    - 译:她虽然累了,仍继续工作。
  - Child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - 译:他虽然是个孩子,但能自己穿衣服。
  - Hard as he tried, he failed again.
    - 译:尽管他很努力,还是又失败了。
  - Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
    - 译:虽然我很喜欢它,但不会买。
  - Strange as it sounds, the story is true.
    - 译:这故事虽然听起来奇怪,但是真实的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3605-q1)** _____, he knows a lot.
    - A. As young he is
    - B. Young as he is
    - C. Young as is he
    - D. As he is young
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。此处应为 Young as he is。句意:他虽然年轻,但懂得很多。
  - **Q2(g-3605-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. As she was tired, she kept working.
    - B. As tired she was, she kept working.
    - C. Tired as she was, she kept working.
    - D. Tired as was she, she kept working.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Tired as she was, she kept working.
  - **Q3(g-3605-q3)** 「他虽然是个孩子,但能自己穿衣服。」的正确英文是?
    - A. As he is child, he can dress himself.
    - B. Child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - C. Child as is he, he can dress himself.
    - D. A child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Child as he is, he can dress himself.
  - **Q4(g-3605-q4)** _____, he failed again.
    - A. Hard as did he try
    - B. Hard as he tried
    - C. As he tried hard
    - D. As hard he tried
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。此处应为 Hard as he tried。句意:尽管他很努力,还是又失败了。
  - **Q5(g-3605-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. As I like much it, I won't buy it.
    - B. Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
    - C. Much as I do like it, I won't buy it.
    - D. As much I like it, I won't buy it.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
  - **Q6(g-3605-q6)** 「这故事虽然听起来奇怪,但是真实的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Strange as does it sound, the story is true.
    - B. As strange it sounds, the story is true.
    - C. As it sounds strange, the story is true.
    - D. Strange as it sounds, the story is true.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Strange as it sounds, the story is true.

## 第 606 课 · g-3606:while / whereas contrast · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:while used at the start of a sentence means 'whereas', connecting two contrasting clauses.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。
- 要点:
  - Whereas some like tea, others like coffee.
  - while + continuous action
  - whereas is more formal than while
  - while can express 'as long as'
  - note the distinction from the time sense
- 例句:
  - While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - 译:有些学生喜欢运动,而另一些更喜欢阅读。
  - He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
    - 译:他很高,而他哥哥很矮。
  - While I understand you, I can't agree.
    - 译:尽管我理解你,但不能同意。
  - She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
    - 译:她喜欢城市生活,而他热爱乡村。
  - While the phone is old, it works well.
    - 译:这部手机虽然旧,但很好用。
  - Some plants need much water, whereas others need little.
    - 译:有些植物需要大量水,而另一些几乎不需要。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3606-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. As some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - B. While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - C. When some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - D. Whenever some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
  - **Q2(g-3606-q2)** 「他很高,而他哥哥很矮。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He is tall, wherever his brother is short.
    - B. He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
    - C. He is tall, as his brother is short.
    - D. He is tall, when his brother is short.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
  - **Q3(g-3606-q3)** _____ I understand you, I can't agree.
    - A. Since
    - B. As
    - C. When
    - D. While
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。此处应为 While。句意:尽管我理解你,但不能同意。
  - **Q4(g-3606-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She enjoys city life, whilst that he loves the countryside.
    - B. She enjoys city life, when he loves the countryside.
    - C. She enjoys city life, as he loves the countryside.
    - D. She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
  - **Q5(g-3606-q5)** 「这部手机虽然旧,但很好用。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Unless the phone is old, it works well.
    - B. While the phone is old, it works well.
    - C. When the phone is old, it works well.
    - D. As the phone is old, it works well.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:While the phone is old, it works well.
  - **Q6(g-3606-q6)** Some plants need much water, _____ others need little.
    - A. when
    - B. as
    - C. whereas
    - D. wherever
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。此处应为 whereas。句意:有些植物需要大量水,而另一些几乎不需要。

## 第 607 课 · g-3607:Compound sentences and semicolons · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。
- 要点:
  - S1; S2 two parallel clauses
  - S1; however, S2
  - a comma alone cannot join two complete sentences
  - therefore/thus express result
  - meanwhile/moreover express simultaneity or addition
- 例句:
  - The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
    - 译:这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。
  - He tried his best; therefore, he won the prize.
    - 译:他尽了最大努力;因此,他获奖了。
  - Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
    - 译:时间紧迫;因此,我们必须立刻出发。
  - I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
    - 译:我喜欢阅读;然而,我妹妹喜欢画画。
  - The rain stopped; meanwhile, the sun came out.
    - 译:雨停了;与此同时,太阳出来了。
  - It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.
    - 译:天黑了,所以我们只好停下来休息。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3607-q1)** 「这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
    - B. The plan sounds good; besides, it costs too much.
    - C. The plan sounds good; therefore, it costs too much.
    - D. The plan sounds good; moreover, it costs too much.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
  - **Q2(g-3607-q2)** He tried his best; _____, he won the prize.
    - A. besides
    - B. otherwise
    - C. however
    - D. therefore
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。此处应为 therefore。句意:他尽了最大努力;因此,他获奖了。
  - **Q3(g-3607-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Time is short; instead, we must start at once.
    - B. Time is short; however, we must start at once.
    - C. Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
    - D. Time is short; meanwhile, we must start at once.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
  - **Q4(g-3607-q4)** 「我喜欢阅读;然而,我妹妹喜欢画画。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I like reading; my sister, thus, likes drawing.
    - B. I like reading; my sister, therefore, likes drawing.
    - C. I like reading; my sister, hence, likes drawing.
    - D. I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
  - **Q5(g-3607-q5)** The rain stopped; _____, the sun came out.
    - A. however
    - B. meanwhile
    - C. therefore
    - D. otherwise
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。此处应为 meanwhile。句意:雨停了;与此同时,太阳出来了。
  - **Q6(g-3607-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.
    - B. It was getting dark, because we had to stop and rest.
    - C. It was getting dark, but we had to stop and rest.
    - D. It was getting dark, or we had to stop and rest.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.

## 第 608 课 · g-3608:Appositives · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。
- 要点:
  - Tom, my best friend, ...
  - a noun of identity directly follows
  - the appositive clause that explains an abstract noun: the news that ...
  - that in the appositive clause has no meaning and cannot be omitted
  - an appositive can be introduced by namely
- 例句:
  - Mr. Wang, our English teacher, is very humorous.
    - 译:我们的英语老师王先生非常幽默。
  - The news that our team won made us excited.
    - 译:我们队获胜的消息让我们兴奋。
  - We have one goal, namely to win.
    - 译:我们只有一个目标,即获胜。
  - The fact that he lied surprised everyone.
    - 译:他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。
  - Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
    - 译:北京,中国的首都,是一座大城市。
  - My friend Lily lives near the gym.
    - 译:我的朋友莉莉住在健身房附近。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3608-q1)** Mr. Wang, _____, is very humorous.
    - A. our English teacher
    - B. our teacher English
    - C. ours English teacher
    - D. he is our English teacher
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 our English teacher。句意:我们的英语老师王先生非常幽默。
  - **Q2(g-3608-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The news who our team won made us excited.
    - B. The news that our team won made us excited.
    - C. The news which our team won made us excited.
    - D. The news what our team won made us excited.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:The news that our team won made us excited.
  - **Q3(g-3608-q3)** 「我们只有一个目标,即获胜。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We have one goal, that is to saying to win.
    - B. We have one goal, namely to win.
    - C. We have one goal, it is to win.
    - D. We have one goal, namable to win.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:We have one goal, namely to win.
  - **Q4(g-3608-q4)** The fact _____ he lied surprised everyone.
    - A. whom
    - B. that
    - C. which
    - D. what
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 that。句意:他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。
  - **Q5(g-3608-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
    - B. Beijing, which the capital of China, is a big city.
    - C. Beijing, capital of China it, is a big city.
    - D. Beijing, it the capital, is a big city.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
  - **Q6(g-3608-q6)** 「我的朋友莉莉住在健身房附近。」的正确英文是?
    - A. My friend who Lily lives near the gym.
    - B. My friend Lily she lives near the gym.
    - C. My friend she Lily lives near the gym.
    - D. My friend Lily lives near the gym.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:My friend Lily lives near the gym.

## 第 609 课 · g-3609:Parentheticals · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
- 要点:
  - I think / I believe inserted in the middle
  - to be frank frankly speaking
  - believe it or not believe it or not
  - as a result / in fact
  - a parenthetical is separated from the sentence by commas
- 例句:
  - This book, I think, is worth reading.
    - 译:这本书,我认为,值得一读。
  - To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - 译:坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。
  - Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - 译:信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。
  - The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
    - 译:答案,事实上,非常简单。
  - He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
    - 译:他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。
  - This way, I believe, is much better.
    - 译:这种方法,我相信,要好得多。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3609-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. This book, I do think, is worth reading.
    - B. This book, I think, is worth reading.
    - C. This book, think I, is worth reading.
    - D. This book, do I think, is worth reading.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This book, I think, is worth reading.
  - **Q2(g-3609-q2)** 「坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Frankly to, the plan is too expensive.
    - B. To frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - C. Being frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - D. To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
  - **Q3(g-3609-q3)** _____, he finished it in an hour.
    - A. Believe or not
    - B. Believed it or not
    - C. Believe it or not
    - D. Believing it or not
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 Believe it or not。句意:信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。
  - **Q4(g-3609-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The answer, in the fact, is quite simple.
    - B. The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
    - C. The answer, at fact, is quite simple.
    - D. The answer, on fact, is quite simple.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
  - **Q5(g-3609-q5)** 「他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
    - B. He was late again, in result, he missed the train.
    - C. He was late again, as a result of, he missed the train.
    - D. He was late again, as result, he missed the train.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
  - **Q6(g-3609-q6)** This way, _____, is much better.
    - A. I do believe
    - B. do I believe
    - C. I believe
    - D. believe I
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 I believe。句意:这种方法,我相信,要好得多。

## 第 610 课 · g-3610:Ellipsis in adverbial clauses · 要点精讲(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Ellipsis in adverbial clauses: when the subject is the same and be is present, omit 'subject + be', keeping only the conjunction + complement.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。
- 要点:
  - When (you are) in doubt, ask the teacher.
  - While (I was) reading, I fell asleep.
  - as if a child as if a child
  - if possible / if necessary are fixed ellipses
  - only when the subject is the same as the main clause can ellipsis occur
- 例句:
  - When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - 译:遇到困难时,向朋友求助。
  - While reading the book, I took many notes.
    - 译:读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。
  - If necessary, I will come earlier.
    - 译:如果有必要,我会早点来。
  - He stood as if rooted to the ground.
    - 译:他站在那里,像生了根一样。
  - Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
    - 译:除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。
  - Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - 译:报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3610-q1)** 「遇到困难时,向朋友求助。」的正确英文是?
    - A. When are in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - B. When being trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - C. When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - D. When you in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
  - **Q2(g-3610-q2)** _____ the book, I took many notes.
    - A. While read
    - B. While reading
    - C. While I reading
    - D. While was reading
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 While reading。句意:读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。
  - **Q3(g-3610-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If it necessary, I will come earlier.
    - B. If is necessary, I will come earlier.
    - C. If necessary, I will come earlier.
    - D. If being necessary, I will come earlier.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:If necessary, I will come earlier.
  - **Q4(g-3610-q4)** 「他站在那里,像生了根一样。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He stood as if rooted to the ground.
    - B. He stood as if was rooted to the ground.
    - C. He stood as if rooting to the ground.
    - D. He stood as if root to the ground.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:He stood as if rooted to the ground.
  - **Q5(g-3610-q5)** _____, I won't go to the party.
    - A. Unless am invited
    - B. Unless invited
    - C. Unless invite
    - D. Unless inviting
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 Unless invited。句意:除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。
  - **Q6(g-3610-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - B. Once print, the report cannot be changed.
    - C. Once is printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - D. Once printing, the report cannot be changed.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:Once printed, the report cannot be changed.

## 第 611 课 · g-3611:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 基础巩固(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - if + past (be uniformly were)
  - main clause would/could/might + base verb
  - expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
  - were is used for all persons
  - if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go
- 例句:
  - If I were you, I would take the chance.
    - 译:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - If he had more time, he would learn math.
    - 译:如果他有更多时间,他会学数学。
  - If I were a bird, I could fly to Tokyo.
    - 译:如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到东京。
  - If we started now, we would catch the train.
    - 译:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - 译:如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。
  - If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - 译:如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3611-q1)** If I _____ you, I would take the chance.
    - A. would be
    - B. am
    - C. were
    - D. was
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 were。句意:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - **Q2(g-3611-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If he had more time, he learned math.
    - B. If he had more time, he would learn math.
    - C. If he had more time, he will learn math.
    - D. If he had more time, he would learned math.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn math.
  - **Q3(g-3611-q3)** 「如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到东京。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I were a bird, I will fly to Tokyo.
    - B. If I were a bird, I can fly to Tokyo.
    - C. If I were a bird, I could fly to Tokyo.
    - D. If I were a bird, I could flew to Tokyo.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were a bird, I could fly to Tokyo.
  - **Q4(g-3611-q4)** If we _____ now, we would catch the train.
    - A. would start
    - B. start
    - C. will start
    - D. started
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 started。句意:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - **Q5(g-3611-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If she knows the answer, she would tell us.
    - B. If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - C. If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
    - D. If she has known the answer, she would tell us.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
  - **Q6(g-3611-q6)** 「如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I had the money, I bought a new computer.
    - B. If I had the money, I will buy a new computer.
    - C. If I had the money, I would bought a new computer.
    - D. If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.

## 第 612 课 · g-3612:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 基础巩固(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
- 要点:
  - if + had + past participle
  - main clause would/could have + past participle
  - expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
  - if omitted, invert: Had I known...
  - mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb
- 例句:
  - If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - 译:如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。
  - If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - 译:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。
  - If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
    - 译:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - 译:如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。
  - Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - 译:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。
  - If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
    - 译:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3612-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
    - B. If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
    - C. If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
    - D. If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
  - **Q2(g-3612-q2)** 「如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - B. If he had left earlier, he had caught the train.
    - C. If he had left earlier, he will have caught the train.
    - D. If he had left earlier, he would catch the train.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
  - **Q3(g-3612-q3)** If we had taken a map, we _____ lost.
    - A. hadn't got
    - B. wouldn't have got
    - C. won't get
    - D. wouldn't get
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 wouldn't have got。句意:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - **Q4(g-3612-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - B. If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
    - C. If she had studied harder, she could pass.
    - D. If she had studied harder, she had passed.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
  - **Q5(g-3612-q5)** 「要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Did I see you, I would have said hello.
    - B. Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - C. If I would see you, I would have said hello.
    - D. Have I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
  - **Q6(g-3612-q6)** If it _____, we would have gone out.
    - A. wouldn't rain
    - B. didn't rain
    - C. hasn't rained
    - D. hadn't rained
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 hadn't rained。句意:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

## 第 613 课 · g-3613:Subjunctive mood after wish · 基础巩固(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
- 要点:
  - wish + subject + past (a present wish)
  - wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
  - wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
  - were is used for all persons
  - if only = how I wish
- 例句:
  - I wish I had more free time.
    - 译:真希望我有更多空闲时间。
  - She wishes she had studied harder before.
    - 译:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - 译:真希望我和哥哥一样高。
  - He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - 译:他真希望自己会开飞机。
  - If only I had taken your advice!
    - 译:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - We wish we had visited Paris last year.
    - 译:真希望我们去年去了巴黎。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3613-q1)** 「真希望我有更多空闲时间。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I wish I would have more free time.
    - B. I wish I had more free time.
    - C. I wish I having more free time.
    - D. I wish I have more free time.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I had more free time.
  - **Q2(g-3613-q2)** She wishes she _____ harder before.
    - A. has studied
    - B. studied
    - C. had studied
    - D. would study
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had studied。句意:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - **Q3(g-3613-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I wish I was as tall as my brother.
    - B. I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - C. I wish I am as tall as my brother.
    - D. I wish I will be as tall as my brother.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I were as tall as my brother.
  - **Q4(g-3613-q4)** 「他真希望自己会开飞机。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He wishes he flew a plane.
    - B. He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - C. He wishes he could flew a plane.
    - D. He wishes he can fly a plane.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:He wishes he could fly a plane.
  - **Q5(g-3613-q5)** If only I _____ your advice!
    - A. would take
    - B. have taken
    - C. had taken
    - D. took
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had taken。句意:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - **Q6(g-3613-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We wish we visited Paris last year.
    - B. We wish we have visited Paris last year.
    - C. We wish we would visit Paris last year.
    - D. We wish we had visited Paris last year.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited Paris last year.

## 第 614 课 · g-3614:Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 基础巩固(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
- 要点:
  - suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
  - should can be omitted
  - the negative is (should) not + base verb
  - the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
  - insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense
- 例句:
  - The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
    - 译:医生建议他多锻炼。
  - She insisted that we be there on time.
    - 译:她坚持要我们准时到。
  - The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
    - 译:老师要求今天交作业。
  - It is important that everyone follow the rules.
    - 译:每个人都遵守规则很重要。
  - He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - 译:他命令立刻完成工作。
