    - D. Lost
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。此处应为 Lost。句意:陷入沉思,他没听到铃声。

## 第 772 课 · g-3772:Perfect infinitives · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The perfect infinitive expresses an action that happened before the predicate verb.本课为综合测试练习,核心:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。
- 要点:
  - I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
  - seems/appears + to have done
  - would like to have done (an unrealized wish)
  - the passive of the perfect infinitive to have been done
  - it is the action order that is being examined
- 例句:
  - I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
    - 译:很抱歉让你等了这么久。
  - He seems to have forgotten my name.
    - 译:他似乎忘记了我的名字。
  - She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
    - 译:她是第一个登上这座山的人。
  - I would like to have joined your trip.
    - 译:我本想参加你们的旅行的。
  - The novel is said to have been translated into many languages.
    - 译:据说这部小说已被翻译成多种语言。
  - We are glad to have finished the work on time.
    - 译:我们很高兴按时完成了工作。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3772-q1)** 「很抱歉让你等了这么久。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I am sorry to keep you waiting so long.
    - B. I am sorry to keeping you waiting so long.
    - C. I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
    - D. I am sorry keeping you waiting so long.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
  - **Q2(g-3772-q2)** He seems _____ my name.
    - A. to have forgotten
    - B. to forget
    - C. forgetting
    - D. to forgetting
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。此处应为 to have forgotten。句意:他似乎忘记了我的名字。
  - **Q3(g-3772-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She was the first climbing the mountain.
    - B. She was the first climb the mountain.
    - C. She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
    - D. She was the first to climb the mountain.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:She was the first to have climbed the mountain.
  - **Q4(g-3772-q4)** 「我本想参加你们的旅行的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I would like to join your trip.
    - B. I would like to have joined your trip.
    - C. I would like joining your trip.
    - D. I would like join your trip.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:I would like to have joined your trip.
  - **Q5(g-3772-q5)** The novel is said _____ into many languages.
    - A. to have been translated
    - B. to be translating
    - C. translated to
    - D. to translate
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。此处应为 to have been translated。句意:据说这部小说已被翻译成多种语言。
  - **Q6(g-3772-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We are glad finishing the work on time.
    - B. We are glad to finish the work on time.
    - C. We are glad to finishing the work on time.
    - D. We are glad to have finished the work on time.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。正确句:We are glad to have finished the work on time.

## 第 773 课 · g-3773:as concession inversion · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The as-concession inversion: Young as he is, he knows a lot.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。
- 要点:
  - adjective + as + subject + verb
  - the noun is singular and takes no article: Child as he is, ...
  - the adverb can also be fronted
  - equivalent to although
  - though can replace as in this structure, but not although
- 例句:
  - Young as he is, he knows a lot.
    - 译:他虽然年轻,但懂得很多。
  - Tired as she was, she kept working.
    - 译:她虽然累了,仍继续工作。
  - Child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - 译:他虽然是个孩子,但能自己穿衣服。
  - Hard as he tried, he failed again.
    - 译:尽管他很努力,还是又失败了。
  - Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
    - 译:虽然我很喜欢它,但不会买。
  - Strange as it sounds, the story is true.
    - 译:这故事虽然听起来奇怪,但是真实的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3773-q1)** _____, he knows a lot.
    - A. Young as he is
    - B. As he is young
    - C. As young he is
    - D. Young as is he
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。此处应为 Young as he is。句意:他虽然年轻,但懂得很多。
  - **Q2(g-3773-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Tired as was she, she kept working.
    - B. As tired she was, she kept working.
    - C. As she was tired, she kept working.
    - D. Tired as she was, she kept working.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Tired as she was, she kept working.
  - **Q3(g-3773-q3)** 「他虽然是个孩子,但能自己穿衣服。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Child as is he, he can dress himself.
    - B. A child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - C. Child as he is, he can dress himself.
    - D. As he is child, he can dress himself.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Child as he is, he can dress himself.
  - **Q4(g-3773-q4)** _____, he failed again.
    - A. Hard as he tried
    - B. As he tried hard
    - C. As hard he tried
    - D. Hard as did he try
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。此处应为 Hard as he tried。句意:尽管他很努力,还是又失败了。
  - **Q5(g-3773-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. As much I like it, I won't buy it.
    - B. Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
    - C. Much as I do like it, I won't buy it.
    - D. As I like much it, I won't buy it.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Much as I like it, I won't buy it.
  - **Q6(g-3773-q6)** 「这故事虽然听起来奇怪,但是真实的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. As strange it sounds, the story is true.
    - B. Strange as does it sound, the story is true.
    - C. Strange as it sounds, the story is true.
    - D. As it sounds strange, the story is true.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。正确句:Strange as it sounds, the story is true.

## 第 774 课 · g-3774:while / whereas contrast · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:while used at the start of a sentence means 'whereas', connecting two contrasting clauses.本课为综合测试练习,核心:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。
- 要点:
  - Whereas some like tea, others like coffee.
  - while + continuous action
  - whereas is more formal than while
  - while can express 'as long as'
  - note the distinction from the time sense
- 例句:
  - While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - 译:有些学生喜欢运动,而另一些更喜欢阅读。
  - He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
    - 译:他很高,而他哥哥很矮。
  - While I understand you, I can't agree.
    - 译:尽管我理解你,但不能同意。
  - She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
    - 译:她喜欢城市生活,而他热爱乡村。
  - While the phone is old, it works well.
    - 译:这部手机虽然旧,但很好用。
  - Some plants need much water, whereas others need little.
    - 译:有些植物需要大量水,而另一些几乎不需要。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3774-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - B. When some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - C. As some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - D. Whenever some students like sports, others prefer reading.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:While some students like sports, others prefer reading.
  - **Q2(g-3774-q2)** 「他很高,而他哥哥很矮。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He is tall, as his brother is short.
    - B. He is tall, when his brother is short.
    - C. He is tall, wherever his brother is short.
    - D. He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:He is tall, whereas his brother is short.
  - **Q3(g-3774-q3)** _____ I understand you, I can't agree.
    - A. When
    - B. As
    - C. While
    - D. Since
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。此处应为 While。句意:尽管我理解你,但不能同意。
  - **Q4(g-3774-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
    - B. She enjoys city life, when he loves the countryside.
    - C. She enjoys city life, as he loves the countryside.
    - D. She enjoys city life, whilst that he loves the countryside.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:She enjoys city life, while he loves the countryside.
  - **Q5(g-3774-q5)** 「这部手机虽然旧,但很好用。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Unless the phone is old, it works well.
    - B. As the phone is old, it works well.
    - C. While the phone is old, it works well.
    - D. When the phone is old, it works well.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。正确句:While the phone is old, it works well.
  - **Q6(g-3774-q6)** Some plants need much water, _____ others need little.
    - A. wherever
    - B. whereas
    - C. when
    - D. as
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查while connects two clauses expressing contrast。此处应为 whereas。句意:有些植物需要大量水,而另一些几乎不需要。

## 第 775 课 · g-3775:Compound sentences and semicolons · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。
- 要点:
  - S1; S2 two parallel clauses
  - S1; however, S2
  - a comma alone cannot join two complete sentences
  - therefore/thus express result
  - meanwhile/moreover express simultaneity or addition
- 例句:
  - The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
    - 译:这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。
  - He tried his best; therefore, he won the prize.
    - 译:他尽了最大努力;因此,他获奖了。
  - Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
    - 译:时间紧迫;因此,我们必须立刻出发。
  - I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
    - 译:我喜欢阅读;然而,我妹妹喜欢画画。
  - The rain stopped; meanwhile, the sun came out.
    - 译:雨停了;与此同时,太阳出来了。
  - It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.
    - 译:天黑了,所以我们只好停下来休息。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3775-q1)** 「这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The plan sounds good; moreover, it costs too much.
    - B. The plan sounds good; besides, it costs too much.
    - C. The plan sounds good; therefore, it costs too much.
    - D. The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
  - **Q2(g-3775-q2)** He tried his best; _____, he won the prize.
    - A. otherwise
    - B. therefore
    - C. however
    - D. besides
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。此处应为 therefore。句意:他尽了最大努力;因此,他获奖了。
  - **Q3(g-3775-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
    - B. Time is short; however, we must start at once.
    - C. Time is short; meanwhile, we must start at once.
    - D. Time is short; instead, we must start at once.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:Time is short; therefore, we must start at once.
  - **Q4(g-3775-q4)** 「我喜欢阅读;然而,我妹妹喜欢画画。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I like reading; my sister, thus, likes drawing.
    - B. I like reading; my sister, therefore, likes drawing.
    - C. I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
    - D. I like reading; my sister, hence, likes drawing.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:I like reading; my sister, however, likes drawing.
  - **Q5(g-3775-q5)** The rain stopped; _____, the sun came out.
    - A. therefore
    - B. otherwise
    - C. meanwhile
    - D. however
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。此处应为 meanwhile。句意:雨停了;与此同时,太阳出来了。
  - **Q6(g-3775-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.
    - B. It was getting dark, but we had to stop and rest.
    - C. It was getting dark, or we had to stop and rest.
    - D. It was getting dark, because we had to stop and rest.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:It was getting dark, so we had to stop and rest.

## 第 776 课 · g-3776:Appositives · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为综合测试练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。
- 要点:
  - Tom, my best friend, ...
  - a noun of identity directly follows
  - the appositive clause that explains an abstract noun: the news that ...
  - that in the appositive clause has no meaning and cannot be omitted
  - an appositive can be introduced by namely
- 例句:
  - Mr. Wang, our English teacher, is very humorous.
    - 译:我们的英语老师王先生非常幽默。
  - The news that our team won made us excited.
    - 译:我们队获胜的消息让我们兴奋。
  - We have one goal, namely to win.
    - 译:我们只有一个目标,即获胜。
  - The fact that he lied surprised everyone.
    - 译:他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。
  - Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
    - 译:北京,中国的首都,是一座大城市。
  - My friend Lily lives near the gym.
    - 译:我的朋友莉莉住在健身房附近。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3776-q1)** Mr. Wang, _____, is very humorous.
    - A. our teacher English
    - B. ours English teacher
    - C. our English teacher
    - D. he is our English teacher
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 our English teacher。句意:我们的英语老师王先生非常幽默。
  - **Q2(g-3776-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The news what our team won made us excited.
    - B. The news that our team won made us excited.
    - C. The news who our team won made us excited.
    - D. The news which our team won made us excited.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:The news that our team won made us excited.
  - **Q3(g-3776-q3)** 「我们只有一个目标,即获胜。」的正确英文是?
    - A. We have one goal, namely to win.
    - B. We have one goal, it is to win.
    - C. We have one goal, namable to win.
    - D. We have one goal, that is to saying to win.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:We have one goal, namely to win.
  - **Q4(g-3776-q4)** The fact _____ he lied surprised everyone.
    - A. which
    - B. whom
    - C. that
    - D. what
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 that。句意:他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。
  - **Q5(g-3776-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Beijing, capital of China it, is a big city.
    - B. Beijing, which the capital of China, is a big city.
    - C. Beijing, it the capital, is a big city.
    - D. Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
  - **Q6(g-3776-q6)** 「我的朋友莉莉住在健身房附近。」的正确英文是?
    - A. My friend who Lily lives near the gym.
    - B. My friend Lily lives near the gym.
    - C. My friend she Lily lives near the gym.
    - D. My friend Lily she lives near the gym.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:My friend Lily lives near the gym.

## 第 777 课 · g-3777:Parentheticals · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
- 要点:
  - I think / I believe inserted in the middle
  - to be frank frankly speaking
  - believe it or not believe it or not
  - as a result / in fact
  - a parenthetical is separated from the sentence by commas
- 例句:
  - This book, I think, is worth reading.
    - 译:这本书,我认为,值得一读。
  - To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - 译:坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。
  - Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
    - 译:信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。
  - The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
    - 译:答案,事实上,非常简单。
  - He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
    - 译:他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。
  - This way, I believe, is much better.
    - 译:这种方法,我相信,要好得多。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3777-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. This book, do I think, is worth reading.
    - B. This book, think I, is worth reading.
    - C. This book, I think, is worth reading.
    - D. This book, I do think, is worth reading.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This book, I think, is worth reading.
  - **Q2(g-3777-q2)** 「坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Being frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - B. Frankly to, the plan is too expensive.
    - C. To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - D. To frank, the plan is too expensive.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
  - **Q3(g-3777-q3)** _____, he finished it in an hour.
    - A. Believed it or not
    - B. Believe or not
    - C. Believe it or not
    - D. Believing it or not
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 Believe it or not。句意:信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。
  - **Q4(g-3777-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
    - B. The answer, in the fact, is quite simple.
    - C. The answer, at fact, is quite simple.
    - D. The answer, on fact, is quite simple.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
  - **Q5(g-3777-q5)** 「他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He was late again, as result, he missed the train.
    - B. He was late again, in result, he missed the train.
    - C. He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
    - D. He was late again, as a result of, he missed the train.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
  - **Q6(g-3777-q6)** This way, _____, is much better.
    - A. I do believe
    - B. believe I
    - C. do I believe
    - D. I believe
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 I believe。句意:这种方法,我相信,要好得多。

## 第 778 课 · g-3778:Ellipsis in adverbial clauses · 综合测试(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Ellipsis in adverbial clauses: when the subject is the same and be is present, omit 'subject + be', keeping only the conjunction + complement.本课为综合测试练习,核心:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。
- 要点:
  - When (you are) in doubt, ask the teacher.
  - While (I was) reading, I fell asleep.
  - as if a child as if a child
  - if possible / if necessary are fixed ellipses
  - only when the subject is the same as the main clause can ellipsis occur
- 例句:
  - When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - 译:遇到困难时,向朋友求助。
  - While reading the book, I took many notes.
    - 译:读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。
  - If necessary, I will come earlier.
    - 译:如果有必要,我会早点来。
  - He stood as if rooted to the ground.
    - 译:他站在那里,像生了根一样。
  - Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
    - 译:除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。
  - Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - 译:报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3778-q1)** 「遇到困难时,向朋友求助。」的正确英文是?
    - A. When are in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - B. When you in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - C. When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - D. When being trouble, ask your friends for help.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
  - **Q2(g-3778-q2)** _____ the book, I took many notes.
    - A. While reading
    - B. While read
    - C. While I reading
    - D. While was reading
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 While reading。句意:读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。
  - **Q3(g-3778-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If being necessary, I will come earlier.
    - B. If necessary, I will come earlier.
    - C. If is necessary, I will come earlier.
    - D. If it necessary, I will come earlier.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:If necessary, I will come earlier.
  - **Q4(g-3778-q4)** 「他站在那里,像生了根一样。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He stood as if root to the ground.
    - B. He stood as if rooted to the ground.
    - C. He stood as if was rooted to the ground.
    - D. He stood as if rooting to the ground.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:He stood as if rooted to the ground.
  - **Q5(g-3778-q5)** _____, I won't go to the party.
    - A. Unless invited
    - B. Unless inviting
    - C. Unless am invited
    - D. Unless invite
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 Unless invited。句意:除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。
  - **Q6(g-3778-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Once is printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - B. Once printing, the report cannot be changed.
    - C. Once print, the report cannot be changed.
    - D. Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:Once printed, the report cannot be changed.

## 第 779 课 · g-3779:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为高频真题练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - if + past (be uniformly were)
  - main clause would/could/might + base verb
  - expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
  - were is used for all persons
  - if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go
- 例句:
  - If I were you, I would take the chance.
    - 译:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - If he had more time, he would learn math.
    - 译:如果他有更多时间,他会学数学。
  - If I were a bird, I could fly to Sydney.
    - 译:如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到悉尼。
  - If we started now, we would catch the train.
    - 译:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - 译:如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。
  - If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - 译:如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3779-q1)** If I _____ you, I would take the chance.
    - A. am
    - B. was
    - C. were
    - D. would be
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 were。句意:如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。
  - **Q2(g-3779-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If he had more time, he learned math.
    - B. If he had more time, he would learned math.
    - C. If he had more time, he would learn math.
    - D. If he had more time, he will learn math.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn math.
  - **Q3(g-3779-q3)** 「如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到悉尼。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I were a bird, I will fly to Sydney.
    - B. If I were a bird, I could fly to Sydney.
    - C. If I were a bird, I can fly to Sydney.
    - D. If I were a bird, I could flew to Sydney.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were a bird, I could fly to Sydney.
  - **Q4(g-3779-q4)** If we _____ now, we would catch the train.
    - A. started
    - B. would start
    - C. will start
    - D. start
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 started。句意:如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。
  - **Q5(g-3779-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
    - B. If she has known the answer, she would tell us.
    - C. If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
    - D. If she knows the answer, she would tell us.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
  - **Q6(g-3779-q6)** 「如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If I had the money, I will buy a new computer.
    - B. If I had the money, I would bought a new computer.
    - C. If I had the money, I bought a new computer.
    - D. If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.

## 第 780 课 · g-3780:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为高频真题练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
- 要点:
  - if + had + past participle
  - main clause would/could have + past participle
  - expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
  - if omitted, invert: Had I known...
  - mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb
- 例句:
  - If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - 译:如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。
  - If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - 译:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。
  - If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
    - 译:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - 译:如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。
  - Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - 译:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。
  - If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
    - 译:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3780-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
    - B. If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
    - C. If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
    - D. If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
  - **Q2(g-3780-q2)** 「如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
    - B. If he had left earlier, he will have caught the train.
    - C. If he had left earlier, he would catch the train.
    - D. If he had left earlier, he had caught the train.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
  - **Q3(g-3780-q3)** If we had taken a map, we _____ lost.
    - A. hadn't got
    - B. won't get
    - C. wouldn't have got
    - D. wouldn't get
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 wouldn't have got。句意:如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。
  - **Q4(g-3780-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
    - B. If she had studied harder, she could pass.
    - C. If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
    - D. If she had studied harder, she had passed.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
  - **Q5(g-3780-q5)** 「要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Have I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - B. Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
    - C. Did I see you, I would have said hello.
    - D. If I would see you, I would have said hello.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
  - **Q6(g-3780-q6)** If it _____, we would have gone out.
    - A. didn't rain
    - B. wouldn't rain
    - C. hadn't rained
    - D. hasn't rained
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 hadn't rained。句意:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

## 第 781 课 · g-3781:Subjunctive mood after wish · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为高频真题练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
- 要点:
  - wish + subject + past (a present wish)
  - wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
  - wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
  - were is used for all persons
  - if only = how I wish
- 例句:
  - I wish I had more free time.
    - 译:真希望我有更多空闲时间。
  - She wishes she had studied harder before.
    - 译:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - 译:真希望我和哥哥一样高。
  - He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - 译:他真希望自己会开飞机。
  - If only I had taken your advice!
    - 译:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - We wish we had visited Toronto last year.
    - 译:真希望我们去年去了多伦多。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3781-q1)** 「真希望我有更多空闲时间。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I wish I have more free time.
    - B. I wish I having more free time.
    - C. I wish I had more free time.
    - D. I wish I would have more free time.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I had more free time.
  - **Q2(g-3781-q2)** She wishes she _____ harder before.
    - A. studied
    - B. would study
    - C. has studied
    - D. had studied
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had studied。句意:她真希望以前更努力学习。
  - **Q3(g-3781-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I wish I will be as tall as my brother.
    - B. I wish I was as tall as my brother.
    - C. I wish I were as tall as my brother.
    - D. I wish I am as tall as my brother.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I were as tall as my brother.
  - **Q4(g-3781-q4)** 「他真希望自己会开飞机。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He wishes he flew a plane.
    - B. He wishes he could flew a plane.
    - C. He wishes he can fly a plane.
    - D. He wishes he could fly a plane.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:He wishes he could fly a plane.
  - **Q5(g-3781-q5)** If only I _____ your advice!
    - A. took
    - B. had taken
    - C. would take
    - D. have taken
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had taken。句意:要是我听了你的建议就好了!
  - **Q6(g-3781-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We wish we have visited Toronto last year.
    - B. We wish we visited Toronto last year.
    - C. We wish we would visit Toronto last year.
    - D. We wish we had visited Toronto last year.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited Toronto last year.

## 第 782 课 · g-3782:Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
- 要点:
  - suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
  - should can be omitted
  - the negative is (should) not + base verb
  - the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
  - insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense
- 例句:
  - The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
    - 译:医生建议他多锻炼。
  - She insisted that we be there on time.
    - 译:她坚持要我们准时到。
  - The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
    - 译:老师要求今天交作业。
  - It is important that everyone follow the rules.
    - 译:每个人都遵守规则很重要。
  - He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - 译:他命令立刻完成工作。
  - My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
    - 译:我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3782-q1)** The doctor suggested that he _____ more exercise.
    - A. take
    - B. took
    - C. taking
    - D. takes
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 take。句意:医生建议他多锻炼。
  - **Q2(g-3782-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She insisted that we be there on time.
    - B. She insisted that we being there on time.
    - C. She insisted that we are there on time.
    - D. She insisted that we were there on time.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:She insisted that we be there on time.
  - **Q3(g-3782-q3)** 「老师要求今天交作业。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The teacher demanded that the homework is handed in today.
    - B. The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
    - C. The teacher demanded that the homework been handed in today.
    - D. The teacher demanded that the homework was handed in today.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
  - **Q4(g-3782-q4)** It is important that everyone _____ the rules.
    - A. following
    - B. follows
    - C. follow
    - D. followed
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 follow。句意:每个人都遵守规则很重要。
  - **Q5(g-3782-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He ordered that the work is finished at once.
    - B. He ordered that the work be finished at once.
    - C. He ordered that the work been finished at once.
    - D. He ordered that the work was finished at once.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:He ordered that the work be finished at once.
  - **Q6(g-3782-q6)** 「我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。」的正确英文是?
    - A. My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
    - B. My mother suggested that I didn't watch too much TV.
    - C. My mother suggested that I not watching too much TV.
    - D. My mother suggested that I not to watch too much TV.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.

## 第 783 课 · g-3783:Mixed subjunctive moods · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为高频真题练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
- 要点:
  - past condition + present result
  - if + had done, main clause would do
  - present condition + past result is rare
  - judge the time by the context
  - were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted
- 例句:
  - If I had taken that job, I would be in Paris now.
    - 译:如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在巴黎了。
  - If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - 译:如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。
  - If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - 译:如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。
  - Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - 译:如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。
  - If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
    - 译:如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。
  - If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
    - 译:如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3783-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. If I had taken that job, I would be in Paris now.
    - B. If I had taken that job, I will be in Paris now.
    - C. If I had taken that job, I would have been in Paris now.
    - D. If I had taken that job, I had been in Paris now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had taken that job, I would be in Paris now.
  - **Q2(g-3783-q2)** 「如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If he hasn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - B. If he wouldn't miss the bus, he would be here now.
    - C. If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
    - D. If he didn't miss the bus, he would be here now.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
  - **Q3(g-3783-q3)** If I _____ smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
    - A. was
    - B. had been
    - C. were
    - D. would be
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 were。句意:如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。
  - **Q4(g-3783-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Did you ask me then, I would help you even now.
    - B. Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - C. Have you asked me then, I would help you even now.
    - D. If you would ask me then, I would help you even now.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
  - **Q5(g-3783-q5)** 「如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
    - B. If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't have been tired now.
    - C. If she had gone to bed early, she won't be tired now.
    - D. If she had gone to bed early, she hadn't been tired now.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
  - **Q6(g-3783-q6)** If I had saved money then, I _____ it today.
    - A. can buy
    - B. could have bought
    - C. could buy
    - D. had bought
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 could buy。句意:如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。

## 第 784 课 · g-3784:Inversion with fronted negative words · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
  - Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
  - Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
  - Little did he know the truth.
  - the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary
- 例句:
  - Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - 译:我从未见过这么美的日落。
  - Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
    - 译:我们刚出发就开始下雨了。
  - Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - 译:他不仅工作努力,还很善良。
  - Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - 译:她一点也不知道答案是错的。
  - Not once has he been late this year.
    - 译:今年他一次也没迟到过。
  - Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - 译:我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3784-q1)** 「我从未见过这么美的日落。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - B. Never did I saw such a beautiful sunset.
    - C. Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
    - D. Never I saw such a beautiful sunset.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
  - **Q2(g-3784-q2)** Hardly _____ when it began to rain.
    - A. we had started
    - B. we started
    - C. had we started
    - D. did we start
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 had we started。句意:我们刚出发就开始下雨了。
  - **Q3(g-3784-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Not only he does work hard, but he is also kind.
    - B. Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
    - C. Not only he works hard, but he is also kind.
    - D. Not only works he hard, but he is also kind.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
  - **Q4(g-3784-q4)** 「她一点也不知道答案是错的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
    - B. Little knew she that the answer was wrong.
    - C. Little she did know that the answer was wrong.
    - D. Little she knew that the answer was wrong.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
  - **Q5(g-3784-q5)** Not once _____ late this year.
    - A. did he was
    - B. he has been
    - C. he was
    - D. has he been
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 has he been。句意:今年他一次也没迟到过。
  - **Q6(g-3784-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Seldom we see such old buildings now.
    - B. Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
    - C. Seldom we do see such old buildings now.
    - D. Seldom see we such old buildings now.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Seldom do we see such old buildings now.

## 第 785 课 · g-3785:only + adverbial inversion · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。
- 要点:
  - Only then did I understand.
  - Only in this way can we solve it.
  - Only when the rain stopped did we go out.
  - only modifying the subject does not invert: Only Tom knows.
  - the inversion occurs in the clause after only
- 例句:
  - Only then did I understand his words.
    - 译:直到那时我才明白他的话。
  - Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - 译:只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。
  - Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - 译:直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。
  - Only at night does the city become quiet.
    - 译:只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。
  - Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - 译:直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。
  - Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - 译:只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3785-q1)** Only then _____ his words.
    - A. I understood
    - B. understood I
    - C. did I understand
    - D. I did understand
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did I understand。句意:直到那时我才明白他的话。
  - **Q2(g-3785-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only in this way we finish can the work on time.
    - B. Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
    - C. Only in this way finish we can the work on time.
    - D. Only in this way we can finish the work on time.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
  - **Q3(g-3785-q3)** 「直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only when the teacher came they did stop talking.
    - B. Only when the teacher came they stopped talking.
    - C. Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
    - D. Only when the teacher came stopped they talking.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
  - **Q4(g-3785-q4)** Only at night _____ quiet.
    - A. does the city become
    - B. the city does become
    - C. becomes the city
    - D. the city becomes
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 does the city become。句意:只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。
  - **Q5(g-3785-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Only after the meeting he called me.
    - B. Only after the meeting he did call me.
    - C. Only after the meeting called he me.
    - D. Only after the meeting did he call me.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only after the meeting did he call me.
  - **Q6(g-3785-q6)** 「只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Only with your help I pass can the exam.
    - B. Only with your help can I pass the exam.
    - C. Only with your help pass I can the exam.
    - D. Only with your help I can pass the exam.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only with your help can I pass the exam.

## 第 786 课 · g-3786:so / neither partial inversion · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为高频真题练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
- 要点:
  - So do I = I do too
  - Neither do I = I don't either
  - the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
  - So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
  - the tense agrees with the previous sentence
- 例句:
  - I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - 译:我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。
  - He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - 译:他不会开车,我也不会。
  - They went to the museum, and so did we.
    - 译:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。
  - I have never been to Tokyo, and neither has he.
    - 译:我没去过东京,他也没去过。
  - She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - 译:她是护士,我也是。
  - You won't give up, and neither shall we.
    - 译:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3786-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I like traveling, and so does my sister.
    - B. I like traveling, and so is my sister.
    - C. I like traveling, and does so my sister.
    - D. I like traveling, and so do my sister.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I like traveling, and so does my sister.
  - **Q2(g-3786-q2)** 「他不会开车,我也不会。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He can't drive, and neither can I.
    - B. He can't drive, and can neither I.
    - C. He can't drive, and neither can't I.
    - D. He can't drive, and neither do I.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:He can't drive, and neither can I.
  - **Q3(g-3786-q3)** They went to the museum, and _____ we.
    - A. did so
    - B. so were
    - C. so did
    - D. so do
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so did。句意:他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。
  - **Q4(g-3786-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I have never been to Tokyo, and neither haven't he.
    - B. I have never been to Tokyo, and neither has he.
    - C. I have never been to Tokyo, and neither does he.
    - D. I have never been to Tokyo, and has neither he.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I have never been to Tokyo, and neither has he.
  - **Q5(g-3786-q5)** 「她是护士,我也是。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She is a nurse, and so am I.
    - B. She is a nurse, and so is I.
    - C. She is a nurse, and so do I.
    - D. She is a nurse, and am so I.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:She is a nurse, and so am I.
  - **Q6(g-3786-q6)** You won't give up, and _____ we.
    - A. neither will not
    - B. shall neither
    - C. neither do
    - D. neither shall
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither shall。句意:你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

## 第 787 课 · g-3787:Cleft sentences It is...that · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为高频真题练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
- 要点:
  - emphasizing a person: It is...who...
  - emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
  - not the predicate can be emphasized
  - the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
  - distinguished from the formal subject It is...that
- 例句:
  - It was Tom who broke the window.
    - 译:是汤姆打破了窗户。
  - It is English that we practice every morning.
    - 译:我们每天早上练的是英语。
  - It was in August that they first met.
    - 译:他们是在八月初次见面的。
  - It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - 译:每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。
  - It was at the station that I lost my bag.
    - 译:我是在车站丢的包。
  - It is hard work that leads to success.
    - 译:是努力通向成功。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3787-q1)** 「是汤姆打破了窗户。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It was Tom who broke the window.
    - B. It was Tom that whom broke the window.
    - C. It was Tom whom broke the window.
    - D. It was Tom which broke the window.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was Tom who broke the window.
  - **Q2(g-3787-q2)** It is English _____ we practice every morning.
    - A. that
    - B. which
    - C. what
    - D. who
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:我们每天早上练的是英语。
  - **Q3(g-3787-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It was in August when they first met.
    - B. It was in August which they first met.
    - C. It was in August what they first met.
    - D. It was in August that they first met.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It was in August that they first met.
  - **Q4(g-3787-q4)** 「每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is my mother whom cooks for us every day.
    - B. It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
    - C. It is my mother whose cooks for us every day.
    - D. It is my mother which cooks for us every day.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
  - **Q5(g-3787-q5)** It was at the station _____ I lost my bag.
    - A. which
    - B. when
    - C. where
    - D. that
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 that。句意:我是在车站丢的包。
  - **Q6(g-3787-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is hard work who leads to success.
    - B. It is hard work which leads to success.
    - C. It is hard work what leads to success.
    - D. It is hard work that leads to success.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is hard work that leads to success.

## 第 788 课 · g-3788:Formal subject it · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为高频真题练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
- 要点:
  - It is important to learn English.
  - It takes time to master a skill.
  - It is said that... reportedly
  - It is + adjective + for sb to do
  - It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)
- 例句:
  - It is important to keep a diary in English.
    - 译:用英语写日记很重要。
  - It takes about an hour to get to the zoo.
    - 译:到动物园大约需要一个小时。
  - It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - 译:据说这座桥历史悠久。
  - It is necessary for us to take notes in class.
    - 译:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。
  - It is kind of you to help me with art.
    - 译:你帮我学美术,真是太好了。
  - It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - 译:事后后悔是没有用的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3788-q1)** It is important _____ a diary in English.
    - A. to keeping
    - B. keeping
    - C. keep
    - D. to keep
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 to keep。句意:用英语写日记很重要。
  - **Q2(g-3788-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It takes about an hour to get to the zoo.
    - B. It takes about an hour get to the zoo.
    - C. It takes about an hour to getting to the zoo.
    - D. It takes about an hour getting to the zoo.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It takes about an hour to get to the zoo.
  - **Q3(g-3788-q3)** 「据说这座桥历史悠久。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is said that the bridge has a long history.
    - B. It says that the bridge has a long history.
    - C. It is say that the bridge has a long history.
    - D. That is said the bridge has a long history.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is said that the bridge has a long history.
  - **Q4(g-3788-q4)** It is necessary _____ notes in class.
    - A. for us to take
    - B. for us taking
    - C. of us to take
    - D. us to take
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 for us to take。句意:我们有必要在课堂上记笔记。
  - **Q5(g-3788-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is kind you to help me with art.
    - B. It is kind of you helping me with art.
    - C. It is kind of you to help me with art.
    - D. It is kind for you to help me with art.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is kind of you to help me with art.
  - **Q6(g-3788-q6)** 「事后后悔是没有用的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is no use to cry over spilt milk.
    - B. It is no use to crying over spilt milk.
    - C. It is no use crying over spilt milk.
    - D. It is no use cry over spilt milk.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。正确句:It is no use crying over spilt milk.

## 第 789 课 · g-3789:Formal object it · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。
- 要点:
  - find it + adjective + to do
  - think it + noun + to do
  - make it + adjective + that
  - it refers to the real object placed later
  - common verbs: find, think, make, consider
- 例句:
  - I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - 译:我发现每天早晨朗读很有帮助。
  - She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - 译:她认为列清单是个好习惯。
  - We make it a rule to clean the room on Thursday.
    - 译:我们规定星期四打扫房间。
  - Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - 译:你认为值得再试一次吗?
  - The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - 译:噪音让人难以入睡。
  - I believe it possible to finish it in a week.
    - 译:我相信一周内完成是可能的。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3789-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I find it's helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - B. I find that helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - C. I find it helpful read aloud every morning.
    - D. I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:I find it helpful to read aloud every morning.
  - **Q2(g-3789-q2)** 「她认为列清单是个好习惯。」的正确英文是?
    - A. She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
    - B. She thinks it's a good habit to make lists.
    - C. She thinks it good habit to make lists.
    - D. She thinks that a good habit to make lists.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:She thinks it a good habit to make lists.
  - **Q3(g-3789-q3)** We make _____ to clean the room on Thursday.
    - A. it rule
    - B. it's a rule
    - C. it a rule
    - D. that a rule
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it a rule。句意:我们规定星期四打扫房间。
  - **Q4(g-3789-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Do you consider it's worth trying again?
    - B. Do you consider it worth to try again?
    - C. Do you consider that worth trying again?
    - D. Do you consider it worth trying again?
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:Do you consider it worth trying again?
  - **Q5(g-3789-q5)** 「噪音让人难以入睡。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
    - B. The noise made that hard to fall asleep.
    - C. The noise made it's hard to fall asleep.
    - D. The noise made it hard fall asleep.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。正确句:The noise made it hard to fall asleep.
  - **Q6(g-3789-q6)** I believe _____ finish it in a week.
    - A. it's possible to
    - B. that possible to
    - C. it possible
    - D. it possible to
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。此处应为 it possible to。句意:我相信一周内完成是可能的。

## 第 790 课 · g-3790:with compound structures · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为高频真题练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。
- 要点:
  - with + noun + adjective: with the door open
  - with + noun + V-ing: active ongoing
  - with + noun + past participle: passive or completed
  - with + noun + prepositional phrase
  - independent of the sentence's subject
- 例句:
  - He slept with the window open.
    - 译:他开着窗户睡觉。
  - With the sun rising, the city became bright.
    - 译:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。
  - She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - 译:她闭着眼睛站在那里。
  - With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,我们出去玩了。
  - The girl with a book in her hand is my sister.
    - 译:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。
  - He left with the lights on.
    - 译:他没关灯就走了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3790-q1)** 「他开着窗户睡觉。」的正确英文是?
    - A. He slept with the window opens.
    - B. He slept with the window open.
    - C. He slept with the window opening.
    - D. He slept with the window opened.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He slept with the window open.
  - **Q2(g-3790-q2)** With the sun _____, the city became bright.
    - A. rises
    - B. risen
    - C. rose
    - D. rising
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 rising。句意:太阳升起时,城市亮了起来。
  - **Q3(g-3790-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. She stood there with her eyes closes.
    - B. She stood there with her eyes closed.
    - C. She stood there with her eyes closing.
    - D. She stood there with her eyes close.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:She stood there with her eyes closed.
  - **Q4(g-3790-q4)** 「做完作业后,我们出去玩了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. With the homework done, we went out to play.
    - B. With the homework did, we went out to play.
    - C. With the homework do, we went out to play.
    - D. With the homework doing, we went out to play.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:With the homework done, we went out to play.
  - **Q5(g-3790-q5)** The girl _____ a book in her hand is my sister.
    - A. of
    - B. which has
    - C. has
    - D. with
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。此处应为 with。句意:手里拿着书的那个女孩是我妹妹。
  - **Q6(g-3790-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. He left with the lights open.
    - B. He left with the lights opening.
    - C. He left with the lights on.
    - D. He left with the lights opened.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。正确句:He left with the lights on.

## 第 791 课 · g-3791:Absolute constructions · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。
- 要点:
  - the logical subject differs from the main clause subject
  - noun + past participle: the work finished, ...
  - noun + adjective: the floor wet, ...
  - with the absolute can be preceded by with
  - generally not used in spoken language, common in written expression
- 例句:
  - The work finished, we went home happily.
    - 译:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。
  - The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - 译:太阳落山后,我们在黑暗中走回来。
  - Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 译:天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。
  - Her voice trembling, she told us the news.
    - 译:她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。
  - All things considered, it was a good plan.
    - 译:通盘考虑,这是个好计划。
  - There being no bus, we had to walk home.
    - 译:没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3791-q1)** The work _____, we went home happily.
    - A. was finished
    - B. finished
    - C. finishing
    - D. finish
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 finished。句意:工作完成后,我们高兴地回家了。
  - **Q2(g-3791-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The sun has set, we walked back in the dark.
    - B. The sun set, we walked back in the dark.
    - C. The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
    - D. The sun setting, we walked back in the dark.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:The sun having set, we walked back in the dark.
  - **Q3(g-3791-q3)** 「天气允许的话,我们明天去爬山。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - B. Weather to permit, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - C. Weather permitted, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - D. Weather permits, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:Weather permitting, we'll climb the hill tomorrow.
  - **Q4(g-3791-q4)** Her voice _____, she told us the news.
    - A. trembles
    - B. to tremble
    - C. trembled
    - D. trembling
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。此处应为 trembling。句意:她声音颤抖地告诉我们这个消息。
  - **Q5(g-3791-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. All things considered, it was a good plan.
    - B. All things considers, it was a good plan.
    - C. All things considering, it was a good plan.
    - D. All things consider, it was a good plan.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:All things considered, it was a good plan.
  - **Q6(g-3791-q6)** 「没有公交车了,我们只好走回家。」的正确英文是?
    - A. There is no bus, we had to walk home.
    - B. There was no bus, we had to walk home.
    - C. There been no bus, we had to walk home.
    - D. There being no bus, we had to walk home.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。正确句:There being no bus, we had to walk home.

## 第 792 课 · g-3792:Non-restrictive relative clauses · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Non-restrictive relative clauses add supplementary explanation; a comma is essential, that is forbidden.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。
- 要点:
  - a comma separates the main clause from the clause
  - that cannot introduce a non-restrictive clause
  - who guides a person, which guides a thing
  - which can refer to the whole previous sentence
  - the clause can be omitted without affecting the main meaning
- 例句:
  - My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
    - 译:我父亲现在六十岁了,仍然努力工作。
  - The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
    - 译:我上周买的这本书非常有用。
  - He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
    - 译:他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。
  - Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - 译:北京是中国的首都,历史悠久。
  - Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
    - 译:教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。
  - The summer camp, which lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - 译:为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3792-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. My father, that is sixty now, still works hard.
    - B. My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
    - C. My father, which is sixty now, still works hard.
    - D. My father, whom he is sixty now, still works hard.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:My father, who is sixty now, still works hard.
  - **Q2(g-3792-q2)** 「我上周买的这本书非常有用。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The book, what I bought last week, is very useful.
    - B. The book, that I bought last week, is very useful.
    - C. The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
    - D. The book, who I bought last week, is very useful.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:The book, which I bought last week, is very useful.
  - **Q3(g-3792-q3)** He passed the exam, _____ made his parents happy.
    - A. what
    - B. that
    - C. it
    - D. which
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 which。句意:他通过了考试,这让他的父母很高兴。
  - **Q4(g-3792-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Beijing, who is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - B. Beijing, what is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - C. Beijing, that is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - D. Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Beijing, which is the capital of China, has a long history.
  - **Q5(g-3792-q5)** 「教我们英语的李老师非常耐心。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Miss Li, whom teaches us English, is very patient.
    - B. Miss Li, that teaches us English, is very patient.
    - C. Miss Li, which teaches us English, is very patient.
    - D. Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。正确句:Miss Li, who teaches us English, is very patient.
  - **Q6(g-3792-q6)** The summer camp, _____ lasted a week, ended yesterday.
    - A. which
    - B. that
    - C. who
    - D. what
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。此处应为 which。句意:为期一周的夏令营昨天结束了。

## 第 793 课 · g-3793:Preposition + which / whom · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为高频真题练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。
- 要点:
  - the preposition + which guides a thing
  - the preposition + whom guides a person
  - the preposition is determined by the collocation in the clause: live in → in which
  - in non-restrictive clauses that cannot take a preposition
  - the fixed collocation's preposition cannot be fronted
- 例句:
  - This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
    - 译:这就是我住了十年的房子。
  - The friend with whom I traveled is a nurse.
    - 译:和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。
  - Do you remember the day on which we first met?
    - 译:你记得我们初次见面的那天吗?
  - The way in which you study matters a lot.
    - 译:你学习的方式非常重要。
  - He is the man from whom I learned the news.
    - 译:我就是从他那里得知这个消息的。
  - The school for which I worked is very famous.
    - 译:我工作过的那所学校很有名。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3793-q1)** 「这就是我住了十年的房子。」的正确英文是?
    - A. This is the house that I lived for ten years.
    - B. This is the house which I lived for ten years.
    - C. This is the house where in I lived for ten years.
    - D. This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:This is the house in which I lived for ten years.
  - **Q2(g-3793-q2)** The friend _____ I traveled is a nurse.
    - A. who
    - B. whom who
    - C. that
    - D. with whom
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 with whom。句意:和我一起旅行的那个朋友是一名护士。
  - **Q3(g-3793-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Do you remember the day that we first met?
    - B. Do you remember the day when on we first met?
    - C. Do you remember the day on which we first met?
    - D. Do you remember the day which we first met?
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:Do you remember the day on which we first met?
  - **Q4(g-3793-q4)** 「你学习的方式非常重要。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The way how you study matters a lot.
    - B. The way that in you study matters a lot.
    - C. The way in which you study matters a lot.
    - D. The way which you study matters a lot.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:The way in which you study matters a lot.
  - **Q5(g-3793-q5)** He is the man _____ I learned the news.
    - A. from whom
    - B. who
    - C. that
    - D. whom from
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。此处应为 from whom。句意:我就是从他那里得知这个消息的。
  - **Q6(g-3793-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. The school for which I worked is very famous.
    - B. The school why I worked is very famous.
    - C. The school which I worked is very famous.
    - D. The school that I worked is very famous.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。正确句:The school for which I worked is very famous.

## 第 794 课 · g-3794:whose relative clauses · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为高频真题练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。
- 要点:
  - whose + noun = the person/thing's
  - whose can guide both people and things
  - of whom / of which can replace whose
  - the noun after whose is not omitted
  - who and whose must not be confused
- 例句:
  - The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
    - 译:那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。
  - I live in a house whose windows face south.
    - 译:我住在一栋窗户朝南的房子里。
  - The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - 译:包被偷的那个女孩伤心地哭了。
  - He is the writer whose books sell well.
    - 译:他就是那位书卖得很好的作家。
  - We helped the family whose house had burned down.
    - 译:我们帮助了那个房子被烧毁的家庭。
  - The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - 译:那棵叶子变黄的树很老了。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3794-q1)** The boy _____ father is a doctor is my friend.
    - A. whose
    - B. which
    - C. who's
    - D. who
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。
  - **Q2(g-3794-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. I live in a house which windows face south.
    - B. I live in a house that windows face south.
    - C. I live in a house whose windows face south.
    - D. I live in a house who's windows face south.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:I live in a house whose windows face south.
  - **Q3(g-3794-q3)** 「包被偷的那个女孩伤心地哭了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The girl which bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - B. The girl who's bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - C. The girl whom bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - D. The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:The girl whose bag was stolen cried sadly.
  - **Q4(g-3794-q4)** He is the writer _____ books sell well.
    - A. who's
    - B. who
    - C. whose
    - D. which
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:他就是那位书卖得很好的作家。
  - **Q5(g-3794-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We helped the family whose house had burned down.
    - B. We helped the family whom house had burned down.
    - C. We helped the family who's house had burned down.
    - D. We helped the family which house had burned down.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:We helped the family whose house had burned down.
  - **Q6(g-3794-q6)** 「那棵叶子变黄的树很老了。」的正确英文是?
    - A. The tree which leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - B. The tree that leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - C. The tree who's leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - D. The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。正确句:The tree whose leaves turned yellow is very old.

## 第 795 课 · g-3795:Noun clauses with what · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:What guides a noun clause and itself serves as a subject or object inside the clause, meaning 'what/who'.本课为高频真题练习,核心:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。
- 要点:
  - What he said is true.
  - what cannot be replaced by that
  - the clause uses statement word order
  - what guides the subject/predicative/object clause
  - No one knows what will happen.
- 例句:
  - What he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - 译:他在会上说的话让我们很吃惊。
  - This is what I want to tell you.
    - 译:这就是我想告诉你的。
  - We should do what we think is right.
    - 译:我们应该做自己认为对的事。
  - What matters most is practice.
    - 译:最重要的是练习。
  - I don't know what the word means.
    - 译:我不知道这个词的意思。
  - Show me what you bought in Paris.
    - 译:给我看看你在巴黎买的东西。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3795-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. What he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - B. What did he say at the meeting surprised us.
    - C. That he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - D. Which he said at the meeting surprised us.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:What he said at the meeting surprised us.
  - **Q2(g-3795-q2)** 「这就是我想告诉你的。」的正确英文是?
    - A. This is which I want to tell you.
    - B. This is that I want to tell you.
    - C. This is what I want to tell you.
    - D. This is it I want to tell you.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:This is what I want to tell you.
  - **Q3(g-3795-q3)** We should do _____ we think is right.
    - A. that
    - B. it
    - C. which
    - D. what
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。此处应为 what。句意:我们应该做自己认为对的事。
  - **Q4(g-3795-q4)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Which matters most is practice.
    - B. It matters most is practice.
    - C. That matters most is practice.
    - D. What matters most is practice.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:What matters most is practice.
  - **Q5(g-3795-q5)** 「我不知道这个词的意思。」的正确英文是?
    - A. I don't know how the word means.
    - B. I don't know what the word means.
    - C. I don't know that the word means.
    - D. I don't know which the word means.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。正确句:I don't know what the word means.
  - **Q6(g-3795-q6)** Show me _____ you bought in Paris.
    - A. them
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. which
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。此处应为 what。句意:给我看看你在巴黎买的东西。

## 第 796 课 · g-3796:Subject clauses with whether · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:Whether guides a subject clause at the start of a sentence; if is not used; the clause uses statement word order.本课为高频真题练习,核心:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。
- 要点:
  - Whether he will come is still unknown.
  - when placed at the start, only whether, not if
  - after the preposition use whether
  - the infinitive after the preposition uses whether
  - whether or not is a fixed collocation
- 例句:
  - Whether we go depends on the weather.
    - 译:我们是否去取决于天气。
  - Whether it is true remains a question.
    - 译:它是否属实仍是个问题。
  - We are talking about whether to have the party.
    - 译:我们正在讨论是否举办聚会。
  - Whether you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - 译:不管你喜欢与否,都必须完成它。
  - It depends on whether the shop is open.
    - 译:这取决于商店是否开门。
  - Whether he can pass the exam is important.
    - 译:他能否通过考试很重要。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3796-q1)** 「我们是否去取决于天气。」的正确英文是?
    - A. That we go depends on the weather.
    - B. What we go depends on the weather.
    - C. Whether we go depends on the weather.
    - D. If we go depends on the weather.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:Whether we go depends on the weather.
  - **Q2(g-3796-q2)** _____ it is true remains a question.
    - A. If
    - B. Whether
    - C. Which
    - D. That
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。此处应为 Whether。句意:它是否属实仍是个问题。
  - **Q3(g-3796-q3)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. We are talking about what to have the party.
    - B. We are talking about that to have the party.
    - C. We are talking about if to have the party.
    - D. We are talking about whether to have the party.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:We are talking about whether to have the party.
  - **Q4(g-3796-q4)** 「不管你喜欢与否,都必须完成它。」的正确英文是?
    - A. When you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - B. That you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - C. If you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - D. Whether you like it or not, you must finish it.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:Whether you like it or not, you must finish it.
  - **Q5(g-3796-q5)** It depends on _____ the shop is open.
    - A. if
    - B. that
    - C. what
    - D. whether
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。此处应为 whether。句意:这取决于商店是否开门。
  - **Q6(g-3796-q6)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. How he can pass the exam is important.
    - B. If he can pass the exam is important.
    - C. That he can pass the exam is important.
    - D. Whether he can pass the exam is important.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。正确句:Whether he can pass the exam is important.

## 第 797 课 · g-3797:Subject clauses with that · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A that-clause as subject is usually replaced by the formal subject it: It is clear that...本课为高频真题练习,核心:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。
- 要点:
  - That he came late made the teacher angry.
  - more often placed later with the formal subject it
  - that cannot be omitted
  - the clause uses statement word order
  - distinguished from the appositive clause: that explains the noun
- 例句:
  - That she passed the exam is good news.
    - 译:她通过了考试是个好消息。
  - It is clear that he is telling the truth.
    - 译:很明显他说的是实话。
  - That practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - 译:熟能生巧是一句谚语。
  - It is a pity that you can't join us.
    - 译:真遗憾你不能加入我们。
  - That the earth is round is a fact.
    - 译:地球是圆的是事实。
  - It is reported that the rain will stop soon.
    - 译:据报道雨很快会停。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3797-q1)** _____ she passed the exam is good news.
    - A. Which
    - B. Whether
    - C. That
    - D. What
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。此处应为 That。句意:她通过了考试是个好消息。
  - **Q2(g-3797-q2)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. It is clear if he is telling the truth.
    - B. It is clear which he is telling the truth.
    - C. It is clear that he is telling the truth.
    - D. It is clear what he is telling the truth.
    - 答案:C
    - 解析:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:It is clear that he is telling the truth.
  - **Q3(g-3797-q3)** 「熟能生巧是一句谚语。」的正确英文是?
    - A. Whether practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - B. As practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - C. What practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - D. That practice makes perfect is a proverb.
    - 答案:D
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:That practice makes perfect is a proverb.
  - **Q4(g-3797-q4)** It is a pity _____ you can't join us.
    - A. that
    - B. which
    - C. if
    - D. what
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。此处应为 that。句意:真遗憾你不能加入我们。
  - **Q5(g-3797-q5)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
    - A. Which the earth is round is a fact.
    - B. That the earth is round is a fact.
    - C. What the earth is round is a fact.
    - D. Whether the earth is round is a fact.
    - 答案:B
    - 解析:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:That the earth is round is a fact.
  - **Q6(g-3797-q6)** 「据报道雨很快会停。」的正确英文是?
    - A. It is reported that the rain will stop soon.
    - B. It is reported whether the rain will stop soon.
    - C. It is reported which the rain will stop soon.
    - D. It is reported what the rain will stop soon.
    - 答案:A
    - 解析:考查That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。正确句:It is reported that the rain will stop soon.

## 第 798 课 · g-3798:Present participles as adverbials · 高频真题(第3轮)

- 级别:B2 | 题数:6
- 摘要:A present participle phrase as adverbial; its logical subject must agree with the sentence's subject.本课为高频真题练习,核心:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。
- 要点:
  - Hearing the news, she smiled.
  - expresses accompanying state: sitting there, ...
  - having done expresses a completed action
  - the negative is not doing
  - a dangling participle occurs when the logical subject is inconsistent
- 例句:
  - Hearing the good news, we all jumped with joy.
    - 译:听到这个好消息,我们都高兴得跳了起来。
  - Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
    - 译:沿着街走时,我遇到了一位老朋友。
  - Having finished the homework, he went out to play.
    - 译:做完作业后,他出去玩了。
  - The children ran out of the classroom, talking and laughing.
    - 译:孩子们说着笑着跑出了教室。
  - Not knowing the way, he asked a policeman.
    - 译:因为不认识路,他问了警察。
  - Sitting by the window, she watched the rain.
    - 译:她坐在窗边看着雨。
- 练习题:
  - **Q1(g-3798-q1)** 下面哪一句是正确的?
